Summary: You get what you pay for and maybe less!
Text:
Yes, PoP more than doubled the price of this tea after Dr. Mehmet Oz talked about it's health benefits, but the high-quality Pu-erh teas found elsewhere cost several times more, and for good reason. Prince of Peace can barely get away with calling this Pu-erh because it is of such low quality. If you really want to enjoy an exquisite cup of Pu-erh, try the higher quality loose or cake type Pu-erh. It's a little more work to brew properly but the benefits and superior taste are well worth the cost and your time. In a pinch, you can brew the tea leaves in a drip coffee maker. When the brewing stops, carefully lift out the coffee filter with the wet leaves, tie it closed with a piece of string and hang it over the side of the pot so the packet is in the tea. Steep it for 3 to 5 minutes on the heat plate of the coffee maker.

As for the health benefits, I've never experienced such dramatic results so quickly. The second day after I started drinking a better quality Pu-erh tea my high blood pressure was gone and so was my expensive prescription! I was absolutely amazed at the fast results and an added benefit is that it is the best tasting tea on the planet. I have never found any tea that has the natural sweetness of Pu-erh and the exotic, earthy taste is almost intoxicating. I expected something this healthy to taste awful or, at best, tolerable but the opposite was true. Some of the other health benefits may take longer to become obvious, but even if my lowered blood pressure is the only benefit that results from drinking this tea, I will be overjoyed. If you've never tried it, do yourself a favor and shell out the bucks for the high-quality Pu-erh. If you are drinking it to loose weight or burn fat, try brewing a 6-cup pot using equal parts Pu-erh, white and green teas. They are all beneficial to your health and will help you attain your weight loss goals faster. They taste great together too but you can drink them separately if you prefer. Then drink a cup or two of chickweed tea in the afternoon to help remove the toxins from your colon.

I wanted to give this product one star because of the low quality, but since it is Pu-erh and the taste is acceptable, I am giving it two stars. If you want to try the better quality Pu-erh, buy a package from rishi-tea.com or teagarden.com. I like the option of buying different sized packages of tea offered by rishi-tea.com. I also recommend the brewing instructions video on YouTube by Doctor Tea. Try the real deal and you won't mind paying more.

Until just recently, I had an English boss that got me hooked on English and Irish tea--and I shall be forever grateful! Just about any British tea that I've tried is much better than anything you get off the shelves in our American markets.

PG Tips is England's best-selling tea--and no wonder! Just open the box and take a good whiff. I've not found its match in Lipton, Luzianne (which is usually dead on the vine), or Red Rose--and that's just its unbrewed fragrance! But wait 'till you taste it: a much richer, deeper, stronger flavor than any American supermarket tea. No, PG Tips is not premium tea, but I have yet to find a premium tea that I like better.

Please note: all British tea is stronger than American--probably so that it stands up to the milk that practically all Englishmen take in their tea--so I would recommend you start with one teaspoon of loose tea per 10 oz. of water and let it brew for 3-4 minutes, then adjust the strength from there.

The only thing I don't like about this tea is the small size of the leaves. Unfortunately most of the world now prefers tea bags, which make an insipid, and often bitter, brew. Because that's where the demand is, most tea plantations don't bother with whole leaves anymore. The processing is more labor intensive, and since the leaves will be cut up into doodle dust to fit the bags, why bother? This process yields NO whole leaves, so even the loose tea from non-premium brands like PG Tips is strictly flakes of mutilated leaves. Even so, their loose tea makes better hot or iced tea than their bags.

By all means, buy some PG. And wave good-bye to Lipton!

Summary: PG Tips is great tea, but you're not getting any benefit from the loose leaf version
Text:
This review applies specifically to the loose leaf variety of PG Tips. I would give the bagged version five stars.

Following the directions printed on the box to use 1tsp of tea per serving, the loose leaf variety of PG Tips does not offer substantial savings over the bagged variety. These 250G boxes contain as much tea as the eighty-bag boxes, and this six-pack of 250G loose leaf boxes contains as much tea as the two-pack of 240 bags also offered here on Amazon. The price difference? Three dollars.

The savings is negligible for such a large quantity of tea, and, as far as I can tell, the loose leaf form of PG Tips is actually the same exact stuff that is inside PG Tips teabags. That's disappointing. When you pop open one of these loose leaf boxes, you may be disappointed to find that the contents aren't really leaves at all. Rather, you get finely ground (or perhaps more accurately "pulverized") clippings of tea leaves--the same dusty powder you'll find if you rip open a PG Tips teabag. Factor in the need for some kind of infuser or tea filter and you've already overstepped the price line between the bags and the loose "leaves." Then you also have the extra effort of filling your infuser and washing it afterward to deal with.

To make matters worse, this stuff is hard as crap to brew even with an infuser. The fineness of the tea particles is, well, too fine. These little clippings have a tendency to escape from whatever you put them in and get into your cuppa, and it's not very pleasant to get a mouthful of them at the bottom of the cup. There are two working solutions I have found. One is to use spice bags made out of cheesecloth. These can be homemade, but I purchased mine at Bed Bath and Beyond. Reusable bags take a few minutes to clean after each use but are inexpensive and can last a good long while. Alternatively, there are premade paper tea filters out there that are exactly like tea bags. If you buy these, you will pay more than the cost of just buying the already-bagged version of the tea. Either way, regular infusers probably won't cut it.

The flavor of PG Tips--both bagged and loose--is perfect. It's the best black tea I've had. It's basically a very strong English breakfast tea that brews very dark but does not get bitter (even if oversteeped). This tea also makes great iced tea. Something like four teaspoons of this or four bags of the bagged variety steeped in three to three and a half liters of water with a quarter cup sugar added makes iced black tea that tastes very much like something you would get at a restaurant. Though the loose leaf version of PG Tips makes the same excellent tea that the bagged version does, I cannot rate it above one star because it is essentially a less convenient and more expensive version of a similar product. I'm disappointed.

This is supposed to be England's favorite tea, and I can see why. I like my tea strong, and had been drinking another brand of Earl Grey. Now and then I'd try some other brand to save money, but it just didn't have the taste. Then my supermarket started carrying PG Tips. It was a good price, so I started using it. Eventually I decided to buy bergamot oil to make my own version of Earl Grey. I bought this loose tea because I thought I could save even more money by buying tea in bulk. You get 6 8.8 ounce boxes of loose tea, and the price per ounce is way better than the supermarket price for bagged PG Tips. I think the bagged tea may be a little stronger because it is powdered. (Hey, maybe I should grind my tea in a mortar and pestle before steeping!) At any rate, this is good tasting tea at a better price. I highly recommend it, especially if you like strong tea. Oh, the boxes are "hermetically" sealed, so to speak. There is thick foil solidly affixed to the opening under the cardboard lid, so until you peel back this foil, the tea is going to stay fresh. When I open a box, I pour the tea into an old tea tin to keep it fresh while in use.
This was our third order of 6 boxes.  We brew it in an InginuiTEA pot making about a third of the 16oz pot and discarding it quickly which results in a smoother brew in subsequent batches.

Summary: PG Tips Loose tea-tastes good but much too finely ground
Text: PG Tips is by far my favorite tea. The taste lives up to its outstanding reviews in every way, but the fine grind of the loose tea was not what I expected. This is not what I would call loose tea; instead, it is tea dust. It makes for a cloudy, murky brew (looks like a mud puddle). I guess I could use paper filters, but for me the point of loose tea is that I can eliminate the need for the filter. Not only for environmental reasons, but because tea and coffee just taste better when brewed without paper filters. Against all odds, though, the tea still tastes great. Summary: This tea is fine, but it is not a fine tea
Text: Based on reviews, I expected something better. This tea does beat Lipton yellow bag, but it is not better than some of the better bagged teas. It is nowhere near as good as some other loose teas. It is OK, if you need your caffeine fix without offending your taste buds, but that's about it. If you can appreciate this analogy, it is like a very high quality cigarette: better than low quality cigarette, but not as good a a cigar or a pipe.

Two primary reasons I didn't like this tea:

1) Very small size of the leaf. Actually, I don't think it's even leaf - it looks more like dust. The tea is very strong but the taste is questionable. I would put it in the Lipton league, despite all the excitement from some other comments. However, taste is a subjective matter.
2) Poor packaging. Good teas usually come in foil or metal packaging, which preserves the freshness of the tea. This tea comes just in paperboard box. No wonder somebody was complaining about lack of fresh taste despite the expiration date. I think this is very important item, since this offer requires to buy in bulk.
A little messy for loose tea use because it is so finely cut.  Good flavor.  Does anyone know where a good teapot steeper is?

In 2010 I have been in London (UK), and bought in a grocery store PG tips loose tea. It has been labeled "Rainforest Alliance CERTIFIED minimum 50% certified content". It was The GREIT TEA! All PG tea sold in UK have the same label. The tea I ordered on Amazon.com in September of this, 2011 year, came in very similar but not exactly the same boxes, without certification, and with taste and aroma of the cheapest assan tea.
Overall, I like sop on Amazon.com, and will be very appreciated if you help me to find source to buy the real (certified, english) PG tips loose tea. Thx, much.
Victor

Summary: What can I say?  They're good!

What else is there to say? They are just really good.

When I received them, they were soft and just as good as the ones I  used to buy in my araea.  When I ordered them, I was concerned that they would be hard but they were packed well and very fresh.  I'm happy.
Of all twisslers flavors, this is the best. The bag I purchased was fresh and chewy-- almost ate whole bag in one setting! If u like watermelon, I would recommend this candy. Enjoy!

If the expiration lasts long enough, I might give them away at the Christmas gag party.

This is too soft and too chewy. The texture is almost like gummy worms.
And the flavor isn't really watermelon. I didn't taste watermelon but it tastes more like I was eating soap or something.
It gets a bit sticky in my hand also unlike the regular strawberry twists.
Just didn't taste like watermelon to me. Had a weird, almost medicine-like flavor. Love the texture of Twizzlers, but I won't order watermelon again.

These replaced a prescription medication I was taking for incontinence and they work at least as well.  The pumpkin can give me a stomachache but I'm thinking that will go away and to make sure I take it with food.  No side effects of any consequence.  And MUCH safer than artifical drugs.
I've been on this product for almost 6 weeks now and I have been feeling an improvement.  Hopefully it will get better with more time.

My milk production was almost down to nothing and this gave me the boost I needed to get it up again. Tastes great and the way it's packaged is perfect for a fresh taste. Also, my son and I seem to be having fewer tummy troubles. I would definately recommend to anyone who is nursing.

This product worked instantly! However I am not very good with following directions. Directions say one tablspoon to one cup of water. I figured if I used 2 cups of water use 2 tablspoons of tea....DONT do this. My supply went up very fast and then dropped very fast!!! Not following the directions to this tea is like not following directions to a perscription, and by not following the directions this tea made my supply dwindle to almost nothing :/... Dont make the same mistake I did, dont drink more then 1 cup a day. It took me 2 weeks to get my supply back after I stopped drinking the tea. It definately works, but try to do it the natural way, your body will make what your baby needs, theres really no need to make more then that.

Another thing, it did help with gas, however it gave me and my baby some serious poops!

This product works very effectively. I noticed a huge difference in my milk production from when I use it to when I do not. I don't think it's a requirement to take this tea, because personally I think that mother nature takes care of providing the mother exactly what the baby needs. But with today's reality, and as a working mom, I went back to work and had to use a pump. I am told that the baby gets 50% more milk when the baby feeds directly, than from what you can express in a pump. Thus,pumping is a very inefficient method of milk expression. I found that with the tea, I could pump more than enough and was able to not only pump, but also feed her in the evenings/weekends, and also express enough extra milk to be able to freeze some in case of 'emergency'. I highly recommend this product.

I have tried this tea as well as the Mother's milk tea.  I LOVE this tea better than Mother's milk tea.  I didn't really see a difference in my milk production with the mother's milk tea, within 2 days of taking Nursing Time tea and pumping every 2 hours my milk came in enough that my son didn't need to be supplemented with formula.  I am also taking the Nursing Blend supplement that Fairhaven Health also makes.  I just started taking that, so I know that the tea really makes a difference with milk supply even without the Nursing Blend supplement.  I have recommended this tea to many nursing friends and have heard great things from them as well.

Summary: Best nursing tea on the market!
Text: While this tea is fabulous for ANY nursing mama in supporting breast health, it's also great for the mother who might be struggling to produce. I've tried every brand of nursing tea that I know of and while they all work great, this tea is the most effective in boosting milk production. As with any nursing tea, if you're trying to boost your supply, you cannot drink 1-2 cups a day and expect amazing results. I have a condition called Insufficient Glandular Tissue (a.k.a. IGT) and the only way I can manage to make enough to feed my babies has been herbal supplements along with nursing tea, this one being the most effective for me. Of course, if you're worried about production the most important thing to worry about is nursing your baby on demand but for mama's like me, or maybe mamas who pump while their away from their baby and need an extra boost, this tea is WONDERFUL!

We had the runs for 2 days and bad tummy aches. Needless to say i did not take another dose. I do not know if it would have increase my milk supply but i know our body was rejecting the product.
I attempted twice to write my review on fairview website and my reviews were never posted. Looking at the website i see all positive review, but my negative review did not get posted. ah?

Summary: Great way to increase milk production
Text: I was introduced to this tea at the hospital after giving birth to my daughter.  A lactation specialist highly recommended it.  I didn't think I needed it so I filed the recommendation in my brain like all of the other advice given to me about caring for a newborn!  Well, fast forward four months.  My daughter's growth was beginning to slow and I was concerned about my milk production.  I remembered the lactation specialist's advice and bought the tea from Amazon.  I have been drinking just one cup of tea a day since and it has significantly helped!  You will feel the difference.

I've tried the pills to increase milk supply and they did nothing. This tea works though.  I notice that my milk supply will nearly double when I drink it.  It will drop a lot if I don't drink it though.  Luckily it tastes good and is all natural.  Its important for me to pump as much milk as possible as I'm a working mom. I highly recommend this tea!
Helped my wife sustain her supply longer than she expected,would strongly recommend to any new parents who plan to have their baby breastfed.

Summary: Works better than any other I tried and tastes better
Text: Nursing became a big drama.  It looked like I was done (had tried other options and techniques).  Use of this tea with regular pumping really helped. Cons: For me the taste does NOT taste lemony. This tea contains anise which has an over powering licorice taste - which I personally hate. So for me, the tea is not good tasting. I gave up breastfeeding before the tea arrived so I don't know if it works or not.

For those who don't know what a trifle is it's a layered dessert with sponge cake or lady fingers on the bottom covered with fruit cocktail then covered with custard or pudding then covered with whipped cream. I make a traditional English Sherry Trifle where the lady fingers are doused with (a bit of) sherry wine.

My friend has celiac autoimmune disease, so I always try to make a gluten-free dish for her when we're at parties together. I came across these Schar Gluten Free Lady Fingers and thought I'd try a gluten-free Trifle (by the way, there is a recipe for gluten-free tiramisu on the packaging). They are stiffer than regular ladyfingers and at first I was worried. They are more like cookies out of the box than cake - you can't cut into them without breaking them into pieces. I was worried that soaking them with liquid would turn them to mush, but I only added a bit to coat each one and several hours later (and even next day) they kept their form and was even spongy (and tasty). I don't recommend drenching them or they will likely go to mush!

The dish was a complete success, both in taste and in structure. A very good product!

The lady fingers held up well and tasted great.  I made it in an 8x8 glass dish but did not go all the way to the sides, a little smaller dish would've been better.  I will order these again, it was just enough to hit the spot!

I bought these to make tiramisu for a friend who has celiac disease, and not only did she love it, but it turned out so much better than with regular lady fingers. These lady fingers are much harder, and hold up much better after soaking. I'm never going back to regular lady fingers.

Summary: Oysters are great food, but cottonseed oil is bad for you.
Text:
These oysters taste good, no question, but cottonseed oil is unhealthful. If you want details (you should), google on, for example, "Dr Weil cottonseed oil". I'll quote a tiny bit: "[Cottonseed oil is] definitely not [OK]. [...] in my book, [...] one of the first things I ask readers to do is to go through their pantry shelves and throw out anything made with cottonseed oil. I regard it as unhealthy because it is too high in saturated fat and too low in monounsaturated fat. What's more, cottonseed oil may contain natural toxins and probably has unacceptably high levels of pesticide residues (cotton is not classified as a food crop, and farmers use many agrichemicals when growing it)."

So there you have it.

When buying oysters (or sardines, or tuna, or whatever) in oil, I use the following heuristic: either olive oil, or no oil at all (go for water, or tomato sauce, or similar). If you want oysters, go with Crown Prince oysters, which are packed in pure olive oil and can be had from Trader Joe's for two-twenty-nine a tin (I'm not affiliated with them in any way, shape, or form: this is my personal opinion based on direct experience with the product that I bought myself with me own good money).

I have eaten Reese's Smoked Oysters for years. I am sorry to say that their recent cans have not been as good tasting as they used to be. I started looking at where they are from, and suspect that the source of the oysters may have contributed.  In general we have been avoiding eating foods from Thailand, China, and some other Asian countries. With all the problems with items from China in particular, we prefer to eat USA produced foods and buy locally as much as possible
I've had several different kinds of smoked oysters.  By far, these are the best.  Not only are they great tasting, they are packed in spring water and not in oil.  A definite plus in my book!

First, if you don't like seaweed, be forewarned, you won't like these. They have a strong seaweed taste. Think like the seaweed that is used to make sushi, only since it's dried, its flavor is intensified. There is a strong 'fishy' scent to the seaweed snacks too.

My first reaction wasn't positive, to be honest. They were super, super thin and brittle and the scent of seaweed and fishiness was a bit strong upon first opening the package. I took a tiny tentative bite from the edge and did not taste any wasabi or heat level at all. I finally broke down and put the whole thin crisp in my mouth and wow! The wasabi was nice and strong, but not super hot hot. There was a good crisp flavor and yet the crispy snack sort of melted in my mouth too.

Each package is individually wrapped, perfect for packing for a lunch or taking somewhere for a snack, storing at the office, etc. Great for a healthier snack alternative. I like the flavor, once I got the wasabi kick. Seaweed is supposed to be really good for thyroid health and other phyto and micro-nutrients too. I was really pleased with these snacks and I think I'm going to buy more of them and maybe try some other flavors. They were surprisingly good. I've been considering ways they might be able to be used in cooking, as I think they'll reconstitute well too. I will update my review if I happen to give that a try.

If you like seaweed or have enjoyed the sushi seaweed wrap, these are flavorful and you'll probably enjoy them too. I don't think they are for everybody (my son hated them), but sushi lovers will probably enjoy these quite a bit.

I discovered these in a local health food store when I began searching for seaweed products as a way to add some iodine to my diet. The store carried lots of products, but most were processed with nasty canola oil which I try to avoid as I do all the high-PUFA oils. Then I found SeaSnax which use olive oil!

I bought some and the rest was history. Now I buy them in bulk from amazon because the price is much better. Yes, they do have a slightly fishy odor and flavor - but I *like* that. You may not like them as much as I do if that bothers you. But for me they are the perfect snack - great taste, a nice crunchy mouth-feel, low in carbs and calories. No matter what your eating goals or eating style - low carb, low cal, low fat, vegan, etc. these snacks can fill the bill, but you *must* like that slightly fishy taste and scent. However in my case I do!

The wasabi flavor has a small bit of "bite" but I would not call them overly spicy. Just a faint hint of something extra there, but it does add a little extra dimension to the taste above and beyond the plain.

I have used this sauce for my Pad Thai for over 10 yrs and it is one of the best I've tried.  Added to the very end of your stir-fry, the sauce keeps its thickness and imbues the lovely sweet flavour that Pad-Thai is known for.  For even more authenticity, you can add a 1/2 cup of smooth peanut butter to the sauce and warm it together over the stove.  Be sure to whisk them together well and you'll get very close to the sweet/peanutty flavour of an authentic Pad Thai sauce.  This is an excellent product.

Summary: Thai Kitchen means No Thai in the Kitchen
Text:
I have been really disappointed with some kind of change in the Thai Kitchen line. All the sauces, curry pastes, some of which I used to use about a decade ago, have been turned into tasteless muck.

So it's also true of the Pad Thai sauce. This sauce isn't even the right color. I made up their recipe (which was more or less right except it added the peanuts at the wrong point) and I got a brown mess (should have been more reddish in color) that tasted vaguely sour--only because I added lime juice. It was as flavorless as milk and water. The same is true of their red or green curry paste. Totally taste-free.

I suppose they mixed up new recipes to suit "American" tastes and the mixtures that passed a broad taste panel had no taste; not everyone likes Thai food. But this Pad Thai mix is absolutely garbage.

Go find a recipe--it's not that hard to make and skip this sauce. It's bad. I tasted one forkful and the entire batch went directly into the garbage can.

Summary: New Orleans Jambalaya Soup + added ingredients
Text:
I just made a soup using this mix. It's one of the best soups I've ever made and it made a ton of soup. I boiled down a turkey carcass left from Christmas and picked off the meat (not all that much). I let the stock cool (about a gallon), skimmed off the fat and added the recommended can of diced tomatoes, some cut up celery, cut up carrots, a few pealed pearl onions and a little ham chopped up from the butt end plus the end of the ham bone. I also added four small red-skin potatoes cut into chunks. I boiled all this stuff with the soup mix for 25 minutes and added about a cup of chopped cilantro. You might need to add some salt depending on your additions, but really nothing else. It has a little spiciness as is.

Really, I think you could add just about any vegetables and chopped meat and this would be an excellent soup. And, when made with left-overs, it cost next to nothing.

My family loves this soup but it is quite pricey when all the ingredients are added. Besides the recommended additions, I used extra fresh wild gulf shrimp, an extra can of tomatoes and a cup of frozen okra slices.  This evening I did a taste test and found the soup to be a little spicy. I added a few drops of balsamic vinegar to smooth it out.  Served it with cornbread and slaw for a hearty meal.  Raves from the family!

What a wonderful find!  I have been enjoying Taylors of Harrogate tea for years (orange and gold boxes), but their black label teas are even better!  The English tea is smooth and flavorable - good any time of day!!

While traveling in Ireland I was served this wonderful tea..
ever since I got back (2yrs ago) I have enjoyed this tea
daily..Very smooth and bite...so when you want to relax with
a good cup of tea, this is the one I would suggest.
Very seldom you find an excellent product for an exceptional price and then receive fast shipping.

A good solid taste of strong British Tea, the secret is to warm the teapot first with a sluicing through of boiled water.

When you make the tea, one bag for every two people is required and stir the brew and let it stand or "mash" for 2-3mins before pouring. NEVER, NEVER, EVER make it directly in a cup or mug. If you are not following these simple guidelines then you really are wasting your time and money.

I have a family member currently living in Herrogate, England. He sent me some of this tea and I was immediately in love! I have been drinking tea my entire life and consider myself fairly schooled on teas. This is simply the best English Breakfast tea I have ever tasted! There is no bitter aftertaste and it is in no way a weak tea. My mother in law is currently in England and is bringing me back more of this lovely tea. It is great to know that when I run out again I can order it straight from my favorite online store, Amazon!

I never really understood the obsession with english breakfast tea, but it seems that was because I hadn't tried Taylors of Harrogate EB.  Oh my wow, I am a converted EB tea drinker now.  A couple of cups every evening, it just makes you feel like everything is gonna be okay.

I'm going through a tea comparison phase.
I drink both hot and cold tea, and I add lemon to the cold tea.
All the Taylor bagged teas I've tried have been top quality; the English Breakfast is a very good tasting tea, but I prefer the Scottish Breakfast tea, which has a more distinct flavor. This is a matter of taste more than a matter of quality.

Summary: First thing in the morning, every day
Text: Call it either being in a rut or being smart enough to stay with something good, I have some form of Taylor's of Harrogate "... Breakfast" tea first thing every morning. I've mostly stuck with the British Isles with the English, Irish and Scottish Breakfast teas. Can't say I hugely prefer one over the other; they all give just the right taste and kick for the morning. I like the big 2-cup bags too. I just make an oversize cup of tea for myself and it lasts a bit longer.

Summary: Rich tea for someone who loves tea
Text: I love Taylors of Harrogate teas.  There was only one local store which carried it, and as they stopped, I'm going to have to break down and buy it on-line with shipping.  This tea is so rich.  I know it is sacrilege to say this, but in the interest of cost savings, I sometimes reuse teabags.  Taylors of Harrogate is the only brand where you can get two good cups of tea from one teabag.  It is simply lovely.

Summary: $24.47, lasted six months but lacks the fragrance and depth of St. James
Text:
This is a tolerable tea similar to Twinings.

I regret this purchase.

Summary: Worst Purchase Ever Made on Amazon
Text: This English Breakfast tea is terrible and to think that I bought 300 tea bags. It has no flavor even with  major steeping time, it's simply dull! I have purchased Taylors of Harrogate English Breakfast tea in the past but this one is a dud. If you want a cup of bracing English Breakfast tea, this is not the product - from a 30 years tea drinker.
It's tea and its tart. I guess you can add suger but the flavor just does't quite work hot or cold. Not my favorite.

Yes I believe these were natural from the smell and small bite I took, but I dont think that Pigs are supposed to eat them. After many attempts I ended up grinding them into tiny bits and soaking them in warm water for 3 hours then poured some grain and oats on the mixture the pigs ate it all up. The pack I ordered did not come with any dog treats which is fine because I dont have any dogs.

Summary: Pug who loves to chew---loves em!
Text: My sweet pug puppy who can't get enough chewing loves these. They are recommended over rawhide, and seem to last pretty well. They are supposedly easily digested...so better than rawhide. It took him hours to really get a dent in them too. It comes with quite a few decent sized ears. They are also made in the USA so I heard that is safer for pet products.

These pods do not fit easily into my Seneo coffee maker. I had to use the double pod holder which was a bit too much room.  As a result the coffee was not as rich or frothy as I had hoped.  Also, at least 3 pods were not properly sealed in each box and had to be tossed out.

I got a couple of these jelly-filled pods in a variety pack from a third party vendor. My first impression was, quite simply, how could this possibly be good? Boy was I in for a shock.

The fact that I'm giving a five-star review on a coffee pod should speak volumes. I like my coffee freshly roasted and ground, but when some flavors are added to coffee, the experience takes on an entirely different level. I had no idea that the flavor of jelly could be infused with the flavor of coffee to create such a blissful experience. Let's just say that it's a good thing that my variety pack only came with two pods of this flavor. Otherwise, I might have drunk the whole package in a single day.

The flavor and the aroma are somehow familiar, but I can't quite place them. What I do know is that they both just simply put a smile on my face. I would gladly go the rest of my life drinking no other coffee but this. That's how much I like it.

And the other thing I think needs to be pointed out is the fact that when I use Senseo pods, I have to use two pods on the single cup setting to get a decently strong result. With the Donut Shop coffees, I can use a single pod on the single cup setting to get a decently strong result.

Summary: ordering the wrong coffee - no image available
Text: I went into K-cups to order K-cups.  This product didn't have an image and I didn't read the product carefully - after all I went into K-cups - why would there be another product in K-cups or why wasn't there an image.  Also didn't read that this item is nonreturnable.  Now I have coffee that I can't use.  Lesson learned - don't order when there is no image available and read the fine print!

Summary: best popcorn and customer service I have ever had
Text:
This company not only has the best tasting popcorn, but also the best customer service I have ever experienced in any business.

My order was small but the customer service dept treated my order as if it was a million dollar order. I needed it fast and they made every effort to get it to me faster than I requested. After receiving it early they followed up with a phone call to make sure I received it and was happy with my order as well.

I will purchase my popcorn for work events and gifts from this company many more times......!

thanks

I'll admit it, I have something of a blue raspberry fetish going on. It probably goes back to the blue raspberry snow cones I had as a child, but at 50 it doesn't seem to have diminished.

These gummy bears are fresh, soft, taste delicious, and ten pounds of them seem truly decadent. The guilt only lasts for a second, though. :)

I used this candy for the candy bar at my wedding. Everyone loved them. They were far better than the average gummy bears. The day after the wedding I had three people leave messages on my Facebook account to ask me to ask where I had gotten them. I got jelly beans from this company as well and they were awesome too.

I was afraid these would arrive hard and too chewy. I opened the bag and they smelled and felt fresh. they taste delicious too. Highly recommend these when they come back in stock. I ordered the last four bags this morning.

This was the exact right color I needed for a birthday party and you get 2 huge bags for a pretty good price. I couldn't find this color in stores and even if I had, I would have spent a fortune. These bags are a good size!
We are VERY please with this product. My daughter is getting married and having a candy bar at the wedding. These blue gummy bears are perfect. Thanks!

I was searching for affordable blue candy for a candy buffet at a wedding.  These were gone before any of the other candy and my children want more! They taste very good and arrived in perfect condition!
Very delicious gummy bears.  They are sweet but have a tart taste to them.  That was a pleasant surprise.  Yummy!!

I ordered these in red and blue to use as party favors for my son's birthday.  They arrived a day before they were promised to my surprise and they were very soft and fresh (I figured they would be hard especially since it's about 20degrees here) For the price you can't go wrong with these and the kids are going to love them!

Summary: Very good and the price is incredible
Text: I love raspberry. Very nice flavor. Not too sweet and not too sour. Can't beat the price less than 1.50 a pound for bulk and free shipping!

Summary: Full of Flavor, Perfect Texture, Nice and Juicy!
Text:
I am so in love with Albanese Gummi Candy. The consistency is not too soft and not too hard. It is definitely a little softer than Haribo, but is much, much juicier and has more flavor. It is not as soft as a Fruit Slice by any means. There is a good chew to this gummi and the flavor releases as you chew. I do like Haribo, but, sometimes it feels like chewing and sweet rubber; you will not have that feeling with the Albanese brand. The Blue Raspberry flavor is very strong and just sweet enough. I've always loved Blue candy and especially the Blue Raspberry flavor, maybe because it turns your tongue blue. These gummies will turn your tongue blue, but it won't turn your lips blue, like blue gum that you get out of the vending machine, darn it! Hehehehe. Ah, the things we carry over from our childhood.

So, if you are a gummi bear lover and a blue raspberry lover, get this candy. The price is phenomenal. You get two bags of five pounds each for a total of ten pounds! That's a lot of candy. I always have candy out in pretty clear containers at my home so that my friends will feel comfortable taking what they want. They all seem to gravitate to the Albanese Gummi Bears. I seem to love most of the flavors.

The gummi bears are really cute too! They were shipped in perfect condition and there was no melting and I am in Florida. They were a bit warm, but they quickly come to room temperature and are perfect.

These would be cute for a blue themed party, wedding treats and a candy bar too. This is a candy everyone can enjoy, young and old!

Think twice before ordering, a great dissappointment for candy lovers.
This candy was not fresh, could hardly taste blue raspberry, and very rubbery.

Ordered for candy buffet...

These arrived quickly and taste amazing. Perfectly soft! Would order again! 100% Quality! :)

Well I didn't understand if there was going to be 1 or 2 bags but to my delight, there were 2 (5 lbs) bags of this delicious Blue Rasberry Gummis. These were actually fresh and not melted, hazed or funny looking. We will be using this for a baby shower in a favor bag but I can see how you could mix this with other color gummis to make other treat bags. I'm not sure if all of the gummis will last but I know where to get more!
These are excellent gummies, just chewy enough and the perfect amount of tartness.  It's difficult to find the blue gummies, and these are really delicious.  Great product for the price!

Summary: FLAVOR LEFT AFTERTASTE I DON'T LIKE THE BLUE COLORING
Text: The flavor of the Raspberry Gummi left a lingering awful aftertaste in my mouth (for hours).  The most awful aspect of these Blue Raspberry Gummi Bears is that of the blue food coloring ..... way too much for my digestive system. I have an ostomy and  I don't like the way it looks when processed by my body.  Awful to see the blue!  Even if they removed the color and made them clear.... the taste is still there.  I threw away 10 lbs. I purchased.... wouldn't give it anyone else.

Summary: Not what I was hoping for
Text: I've had German Chocolate Cake coffee from a company no longer availabe in my area.  This one did not match up for me. I think the packaging was mislabled??? While perhaps mildly chocolate in flavor, not a hint of coconut. But the price was good for the coffee (as a regular coffee).  I'm just disappointed that I cannot get my hands on a good "German Chocolate Cake" flavor.

Summary: German Chocolate Cake in a cup
Text: This coffee tastes just like German chocolate cake but not too sweet.  The rich blend of milk chocolate and vanilla with a little bit of coconut tastes great!  I would definitely buy this product again.  It is one of the best I've tasted from Coffee Masters.
I expected a little more coconut flavor and a little less dark chocolate....but overall a nice flavored coffee.

Summary: Great crackers but the quality date is an issue
Text: I love these crackers and felt the price was good.  Still, I was HIGHLY disappointed when I received them to see I only had 4 1/2 months to consume six boxes of these (best if used by date was 12/30 of the current year) & we got another flavor pak of 6.  Eight months to a year should be anticipated or it should be clearly specified.

I can not imagine not having this most delicious and relaxing beverage. I take mine in the evening and always become relaxed and then spend beautiful time with my family and friends. Simply the best for a calm close of the day.
As with most products directly from England this Kit Kat was superior to the American counter part. A pity that they alter the taste when we get it here.

Needed some bulk quantity jelly beans to fill small jars for baby shower favors.  Buying them this way saved a lot of money over buying them by the pound at the local candy store.  As stated in another review, the jelly beans just come in an unlined cardboard box.  This seemed a bit odd, but there were 2 sheets of wax paper, I guess to prevent dust, etc from getting into the box through the top and bottom.  Not much else to say, they're Jelly Belly's at about half the cost of the local guy!

I was shocked to see that the bulk version of these Jelly Belly's are just in a cardboard box, no plastic, no nothing. Doesn't seem overly hygienic. Since I didn't open the box for a few months the Jelly Belly's were getting softer and crystallizing [unbeknownst to me] because we live in a wet climate. Hmmm...just be aware that the packaging should be upgraded

Summary: Salmon Stuffed with Spinach and Cheese
Text:
I was at first skeptical about how this would taste. I took it out of the box and it was so small. I said to myself, I am going to need 2 of these to fill me up...was I wrong.

I popped it in the microwave and found, not only was it delicious but very filling also. Would highly recommend especially if you are dieting and doing portion control.

Can't wait to try out their other selections.

Summary: Tasty but don't cook in micro
Text: I really enjoyed my first dish of the salmon. I baked it slowly in the oven and it was quite good. Tonight I cooked it in the microwave, for the least amount of time recommended and it tasted like a leather boot. So, for me, I'm sticking with the regular oven. I'm going to try some of Oven Poppers' other items, too.

These are really tasty stuffed salmon.  There are 2 in a box, which costs a little under $7.00. Takes about 5 minutes to heat in the micro. The cheese and spinach filling is very flavorful. I eat 2 a week for the Omega-3 benefits, but they are delicious as well. The one problem I have is when cooking in the microwave I've tried different timing but the bottom is crusty.  Even so I love 'em!

Summary: great but oil bottom of fish
Text: I love these. I used to get them at BJ's in a four pack but they stopped carrying them. They used to be $14/box. I couldn't find them anywhere so I got them here, misunderstanding just how few I was getting. While I love the product (be sure to really oil the bottom of the fish before cooking in micro for 5 mins.), they're too expensive on Amazon. I found them here in NJ in Stop 'N Shop for between $6 and $7 for a two-pack. So now I can eat them without going broke. By the way, these are great for diabetics or anyone looking to watch their carb intake.
I can't live without knowing these are in my freezer and ready for consumption!!!!!!!  All ingredients are good for your health!

Summary: I was fooled by this Company's Omission
Text:
S-Adenosyl-100 (SAMe) for Small Dogs and Cats by Vitality SystemsI order this product for my dog. My vet wants me to give one pill per day for his aging liver. When I ordered this product, I assumed it would be 60 pills for the price since I paid approximately the same amount for 60 pills eight times before. My big mistake was ordering the Vitality Systems company selling the product on Amazon. I guess I inadvertently switched vendors on this order without realizing this.

When I received the order it was 30 pills for over $22.00. I ordered from the wrong company who cleverly omitted the total number of pills in their description. (I would also hide this vital info. if my intention was to fool (really cheat) customers!)

I know that often Amazon is not very good with providing vital information on products and I often have to go to other websites to find out more about the products I am shopping for. (A good number of times they lost my business when other websites selling the same product had a similar price with less postage costs.)

There should not be certain companies who omit things that other companies selling the same product state up front. Amazon needs to have more uniformity in displaying the products they handle and/or sell.

After diapers & wipes, these are the most important thing in my diaper bag! I'm breastfeeding my son, but we supplement with this formula so my husband can feed the baby (I don't always have enough pumped for a bottle) and for convenience. It is very helpful to have a bottle handy when I'm waiting at the register at the supermarket and the baby is crying to be fed. I love these little, ready-made bottles because they are the perfect size and there is no mixing needed - just shake, open, screw on a nipple, and feed the baby.

These don't come with nipples, but you can use regular bottle nipples or get disposable nipples separately. You can buy about 50 disposable Similac nipples from the Abbott store online or use Enfamil disposable nipples (I've used these - they fit fine), which they sell on Amazon.com in packs of 10 or 25.

I have two nipples in a ziplock bag and 4 bottles in my diaper bag at all times. There are cheaper feeding options, but for convenience I can't recommend these enough!

These bottles helped tremendously in adjusting to daycare for a pumping mother.  My daycare used these bottles at the end of the day when baby was hungry and there was no breast milk left.  I call them a jumper bottle--they satisfied her hunger until I could pick her up and nurse her and 2ozs wouldn't significantly reduce my production. They are ready to use - which allows them to be stored at daycare per state daycare guidelines--I simply provide a bag of ready to attach nipples.  Priced exactly like local but no sales tax to pay and delivered to my door!

Summary: A must have for the first few weeks!
Text: These bottles are the same product used in the hospital. I found them to be invaluable during the first few weeks when newborns are eating constantly. Its a great way to avoid constant bottle washing when you are so tired. I don't heat the formula so that saves even more time. Later, these bottles are great for the diaper bag and any use away from home. Nipples are not included but I found them to be much cheaper at my postpartum clinic than they are online.

Summary: Great but would not ship them in the summer
Text: This product is awesome. The only problem is that I would not have them shipped in the summer!  They can only take temperatures of 100 degrees or more for 24 hours. If it is 85 or 90 degrees the formula could be exposed to 100 degree temperatures which would spoil the formula.  Just be careful

The summary: my daughter likes the taste, the small size minimizes waste and makes it easy to travel with, but it's relatively expensive compared with powders and larger bottles.
The 2oz bottles are a perfect amount for a supplement. You can easily use more bottles, but the 2oz amount helps minimize waste. This is an expensive way to buy formula if you are feeding formula exclusively, but it's great if you just need it for traveling or to 'top up' your baby when he/she doesn't get enough from breastfeeding. In theory, you can add a nipple and ring and feed your baby directly from the bottle, but I tend to use baby bottles that help reduce the amount your baby swallows (I use Born Free, because it is also BPA-free).
Also, the small bottles fit easily in the side of a diaper bag (most bags will hold 2 in a side pocket). My daughter seems to like the taste. She is primarily breastfed and has no problem getting breastmilk sometimes and this formula sometimes.
I do notice that it tends to stain my daughters clothing, but I don't know if that's unique to this brand or common to all formulas.
We used these for supplemental feeding in the first months and as a ready to go bottle. They were extremely convenient until the baby was ready for a consistent 4oz feeding.

Similac is a well known product and I was given this to feed my baby in the the hospital. This particular size and amount is great. These boxes come with eight 2 oz bottles and one re-useable nipple and ring. It is the perfect amount to start a newborn off with when supplementing. I have had a breast reduction and I am supplementing with some formula as my milk amount fluctuates. Although I agree with others reviewers that it is a huge amount of plastic bottles to throw away, it is very convenient for on the go and supplementing in general. eventually will also move up to the 8 oz bottles and larger as my baby grows. shipped on time and well packaged.

Summary: Exactly what we ordered and needed
Text: We used these in the hospital and several staff members "hooked us up" before we came home so we had some for a little while. They were perfect for feeding our son when we first brought him home because he was taking less than 2 ounces at first. They're great for the middle of the night feedings as well b/c they don't need to be heated up. You just pop the nipple on and it's ready. The box only comes with one nipple...that's the only drawback. However, we bought the Enfamil nipples to go with them on the recommendation of some other reviewers and they worked perfectly.

I love these little bottles. My baby would not take formula AT ALL and upon suggestion bought these and she loved them. I use the $5 off coupons that similac mails me and buy a
pack for only $1.67. She's about 80% breastfed but these are a great option.

My baby is 2 weeks old. I'm breastfeeding, but he gets fussy waiting for the milk to "let down". My doctor recommended I try a ready-to-go formula like this one that required no additional effort on my end. When he's fussy but needs to eat, this is quick. It also smells more like breastmilk than other formulas. I packed a few in my diaper bag. We go through 1-2 of these a day. (He's drinking breast milk otherwise).

I love the little Similac bottles for many reasons. The first one is because even when I was breastfeeding I still used them, especially in the middle of the night. This way my husband could have his turn feeding the baby too and I had my turn for sleep. But the less work in the middle of the night the better. All you have to do is open it and put a nipple on it. We are all for the least amount of work between 12 and 6 am. Secondly when we are out somewhere and need to give the baby a bottle its is ready and handy. I don't have to worry about finding water measuring formula ect. And lastly because when you have a baby sitter (even baby sitters like grandma's ) you don't have to worry about them remembering how many scoops of formula with how many ounces of water. Even though my baby drinks 4 oz I just give her 2 bottles. They are handy to carry around and it is just one less thing to worry about when you are out and about. They are kind of expensive but if you break it down and join the amazon mom club it is less than $1 a bottle and piece of mind and convenience are totally worth it.

Summary: Fantastic for when you bring home newborn baby
Text: I ordered 2 cases in a few weeks before baby was born (also I did it early for free shipping since the case is heavy) I LOVE having these around for the late night/3am feedings for baby.  Also, a hint for the nipples on these bottles-They do not sell the similiac nipples BUT the enfamil disposable nipples fit PERFECT, and they sell those on amazon as well.  Along with these small bottles being awesome for the night feedings, they are great to throw in your diaper bag to take anywhere.  Another hint, I asked the hospital nurse for extras to take home and then I had 2 cases of the 2 oz at home and I will tell you, the first 2 weeks home has been a breeze with feeding!  Good luck and I hope this helps

Tiny bottles perfect for night feeding! A little pricey but well worth it... just shake and ready... bottle fits all nipples so you can just use a reusable standard one! Be sure to ask the hospital for extra when you're headed home... they get them for free for promotion :)
We've been feeding our infants this formula since they were born and these compact bottles are very useful, especially, when traveling with the babies.  A must-have for any new parents!
These little guys are, of course, a little pricey, but well worth it when out and about with an infant.  I wish they had a 4oz size instead of having to jump to the 8oz.

Summary: Good product. Some problem with packaging
Text: My LO and I like Similac. It's a good product and very convenient. The only problem I have with it is that some of packaging I ordered recently came with 7 bottles per box. Not sure why this could happen.

Awesome product for newborns - great for on the go or when you don't have time to make bottles from powdered formula. The shape of the pre-mix bottle is also good - fits nicely in your hand. My 6-week old baby boy will only feed nicely on Similac nipples that come with the pre-made bottles - so much so that I have bought larger bottles for powdered formula that fit those nipples!

This is the same formula that the hospital provided after our daughter was born. We did not nurse so we continued to use these for two weeks until they became too small for our daughter as she is up to 3 + ounces per feeding after two weeks. The only negative is that each box of 8 only comes with one nipple. She does have some re flux and gas however I can not say it is because of the formula make up.

We received a few of these at the hospital when our son was born. They were great to just throw in the diaper bag to have on hand when out and about. I had to take a last minute trip by airplane and decided that these would be easier than powered formula during travel. Purchased these on Amazon with Prime delivery for a decent price. They worked great for the airplane as I didn't have to mess with making bottles when my little guy decided he was hungry NOW. I just wish they would make a 4 oz size as the 2 oz is now too small, but the 8 oz is too big. I'd rather use a few of the smaller size right now than risk wasting part of the 8 oz bottle.

Summary: Great for newborns and diaper bags.
Text: These are wonderful for newborns, who don't drink large amounts.  Small nipples, so they fit the newborn mouths well, and no mixing during that overwhelming time when they are first born.  Save the nipples and rings so you can use them on new bottles, and recycle the empty bottles.  Also good for diaper bags for when the babies are small (and don't need large amounts yet).
Very convenient to use and to have these delivered in 2 days or less with Amazon Prime is great.  Who has time to go out and get formula?  Found the best price for the formula @ amazon.

Great for traveling! Very nice Idea!!! My baby love them... if you want to have time for your self, go and get them... My only complain is that in the box they shoul give you at least 6 nipples, it only comes with one, I bought a box with another 50.

These nursette bottles are such a lifesaver for nighttime feedings!!!! Just shake it, open it and screw on a collar ring with nipple.  These packages only come with one nipple.  I found that the Gerber essentials bottles nipples and rings will fit these nursette bottles wonderfully!!!  A 3 pack of those bottles only costs a little over 3 bucks at the big box store.  I purchased 9 of them to make sure I had nipples on hand to use just for these nursette bottles.  The formula works fine for my baby and these bottles are just so handy. No mixing, or cleaning bottles.  I'd highly recommend them.  Another point is that these come in an 8 pack and Enfamil's version only has 6 in a box and are a buck or 2 more expensive.

CONVENIENT! Great for on-the-go. My newborn love this and so do I. However, these are pricey compared to the powdered formula. At $40, you get 96oz worth. With the powder formula (from Sams Club), at $27, you get 244oz. We're currently using both types for our newborn. She seems to favor the Ready-to-Go better than the powder.

These are great for travel.  I am breastfeeding my 6 mo old baby but starting to wind down a little.  With just 2 ounces, they are great for supplementing without filling him up too much.  They are pricy but work good for travel when you don't have time or water to mix formula.  My baby actually eats this "ready to feed" product better than any other formula that we mix up.

I WISH I WOULD HAVE START COLLECTING THESE BEFORE I HAD MY 1ST BABT 100% LIFE SAVERS FOR ANY TIME OF DAY ON THE GO AND 1AM FEEDINGS A MUST HAVE!!! THE ENFAMIL ARE GREAT TOO! AND THIS IS A GREAT VALUE IF YOU CAN FIND A COUPON. WOULD AND DOES RECOMMEND...
These 2 oz bottles are perfect for on-the-go. No preparation needed, no mess. Put some in your diaper bag and you're ready for baby's emergency hunger pangs.

If you are formula feeding - this is a must-have. My lactation consultant gave us trial versions of this formula. I'm using it to supplement my breastfeeding and for the times when I'm either too sore to feed or just too tired at night. These 2 ounce bottles are perfect for quick painless feeding in the wee hours of the night. It comes with a single reusable nipple per box. This is a staple in our nursery for rush feedings.

I should point out that this has milk + soy as well as iron supplements. My baby seems to have done fine and hasn't had any negative reactions to this formula. It doesn't even make her poos smell like some of the other formulas we've tried.
Great set to have during travel or outdoor. No need to worry about freezing or heating up the milk. Wish the nipple comes with fast or standard flow for older baby.

We started supplementing her with Enfamil when she was 2 months, but she started spitting up. We changed to Similac and no more spit ups. She loves it. The new born ready-to-be-feed 2 ounce bottle is very handy , just put on the nipple and is all ready to feed. Medella nipples also fit on these bottles.

My first baby refused to take the bottle, so I breastfed exclusively. Although I wanted to breasfeed my second child exclusively, my milk did not come in as it did with my first born. So I had to try bottle feeding to supplement my milk supply. Since I was given a case of Similac Advance Newborn Ready to Feed at the hospital, that is what I ended up feeding her. She seems to like the product, except that she was always very gassy. I did some research and then eventually switched to Similac for fussiness and gas. That did the trick and she is gas free. I would recommend this product for busy moms, as it is already mix (does not need to be warmed, or mixed). I use the ready mix while at church and other places away from home.
These are great for airplanes!  We took a 5 hour flight when our son was 3months old and these were a lifesaver for take off and landing.

My daughter is almost 10 months old. She gets hungry at night and this helps a lot.

By the way, a pack of 8 comes with only 1 nipple. My daughter, for some reason, refuses to use the Similac nipple. However, I use the evenflo glass bottles which come with nipples and rings and they fit perfectly on these ready to feed bottles. The evenflo nipple and ring also fits on the Enfamil 6oz or 2oz ready to feed bottles. As a result, I didn't have to buy the disposable nipples/rings.

I ordered this item and received it in less than 7 days, I was very happy because I have a newborn who is now 1 month old and this item saved me a lot of money, I still have a whole case left, I will definately recommend anyone who needs simiilac advance to order from here
