Barney Butter is ever so slightly sweet (just enough, I think) and close enough in taste to PB that my BF likes it, yet it's missing that indefinable something that makes me dislike peanut butter so much. Plus, the Barney Butter is WAY healthier... compare the nutritional info on the jar of Barney Butter to your standard jar of Jif or Skippy. I know it isn't quite as pure as some nut butters since this still contains palm oil, BUT all of the No-Stir nut butters contain palm oil...it's a compromise I can live with if it means not having to stir anything with the consistency of cement... that just too much work for a sandwich. Anyhoo..this stuff is fabulous and I can't keep my spoon out of the jar!!! I was very glad to see the 3-pack on Amazon. I'm ordering it right now!!

UPDATE: My initial enthusiasm for Barney Butter has not waned. Peanut Butter has never made it back into our house since. I use the Barney Butter in baked goodies, candies, smoothies, on toast, and on plain old spoons :). I actually buy 6 jars at a time from Amazon. LOVE IT!

I cannot say enough about this delicious butter. Our family purchased this because we have a child with severe peanut allegy and this is made in a peanut free facility! I can only describe this almond butter as being fabulous, like a grown up peanut butter. I highly recommend!

Summary: Taste just like the expensive stuff
Text: For years now we've eaten MaraNatha organic almond butter because I have a terrible peanut allergy.  I came on to amazon to see if I could order it cheap and found Barney Butter.  It's made in a peanut free facility (which is really hard to find these day)!!  And, it tastes just as good.  I will admit it is runner than MaraNatha but due to it's consistency it's easier to spread on bread.  I did have to stir it a little but not like normal almond butter.  I gave it five stars because it takes great and is much cheaper than MaraNatha.  Not to mention the almond only facility.  I will definitely be buying Barney Butter from now on.  I might try the crunchy next time too!!

I have kids with peanut allergies and I found the perfect substitute for peanut butter.  It is easy to spread and tastes great.  The only thing you need to watch out is that there is some separation of the paste and the oil.  To avoid this problem just stir the almond butter before you spread it.  This product is really the best out there.  I'm very happy that Amazon is selling it online too.

Summary: Barney Butter is the best way outside of making your own.
Text:
I am trying to get more natural and healthy foods and that started me on a journey to finding Barney Butter. First I started with natural peanut butters but found that peanuts are a natural inflammatory product. I don't want to promote inflammation or add to pains I already have so someone suggested almond butter.

I tried a variety of almond butters but I have my own taste expectations. I started looking for something that was made in an almond only facility, did not have to be stirred, had a little bit of sweetness, was NOT gritty, and had the "right" kind of palm oil. The palm "fruit" oil is the good healthy kind of oil and the palm "kernel" oil is the bad. Most of the non stir butters have the palm kernel oil.

In my Googling I eventually found barney butter and it had all my requirements. It already has a touch of sweetness added to it and all I had left to taste it and see if it lived up to what I was expecting. I found it at my local Publix grocery store and tried it. I give it a big thumbs up! Right out of the jar, with no "doctoring up" it tastes ready to eat. No stirring and slightly sweet. A real winner.

The grocery does not seen to stock it very well and is often out of stock, so now I am buying it on Amazon and that makes it even easier. The purists who want nothing but almonds can find that in another brand, but I always had to FIX those brands in my Vitamix and doctor them up to be blended well and taste right. Now I just buy the Barney Butter and I'm done. They deserve the business. They use the almonds ONLY with no husk, the right and healthy kind of palm oil that is actually good for us to eat, and add a twinge of sweetness to it. It's a terrific product - well done.

If you have a peanut allergy and have struggled to find the perfect alternative nut butter, this is it. Barney Butter delivers the same smooth, creamy texture of peanut butter with all the delicious flavor and nutritional benefits we expect from almond butter. It's a staple in our house for packing school lunches. It's also one of very, very few nut butters produced in an almond-only facility.

I have food allergies and have really missed being able to eat peanut butter due to my peanut allergy. I get almond butter from time to time, but it is always disappointing because it's dry and difficult to stir. Even after stirring the texture is usually dry and somewhat gritty. Barney butter smooth almond butter has the same texture as peanut butter, if not even a little bit smoother. It looks like peanut butter and tastes even better than peanut butter. It is made in a plant that does not process peanuts, so it's safe for those who are allergic to peanuts. I really love this product!

We have searched everywhere for a delicious almond butter that's peanut free since my son has a major peanut allergy.  Finally!  And the whole family loves it - soon after I ordered our first 3 pack I was back to Amazon for more and have even ordered some for extended family.  The best part is that it never separates.  Our 2 year old son loves "Bowny Butter."  He asks for it several times a week, which makes us very happy :)  We purchased Barney Butter based on the great reviews and we're glad we did!

I used to be allergic to peanuts as a child, and I have a strong taste aversion to peanuts and peanut butter, but I love almond butter. After hearing rave reviews for Barney Butter, I decided to try out their version. I don't know how they do it, but somehow Barney Butter tastes EXACTLY like peanut butter! I know that this is a plus for some, but if you like peanut butter, why wouldn't you just buy peanut butter? Why make perfectly good almonds taste like peanuts? If I buy almond butter, I want it to taste like almonds.

Summary: I can't believe it's not peanut butter!
Text: That might be a slight exaggeration, however, I would just as soon eat Barney Butter as peanut butter.  Plus, it's healthier and not a problem for my daughter with peanut allergies.  Although, I do have to add that she does not like it.  But the rest of the family does.  Bottom line, if you want an almond butter that is almost peanut butter, this is it.

I have tried several different brands of almond butter and nothing is better than this one. It is sweeter than the others. I went thru one jar in a week! It is so good! I like to mix with a little bit of chocolate spread and put it on toast and dip apples in it. Very yummy! It is hard to find and now it is sold out so I have to wait. You won't be disappointed.

Love, Love, Love this almond butter!  Way smoother than both Justin's and Maranatha brands, which I've also tried.  I think this is better due to it being made from blanched almonds, which makes it stick to the roof of your mouth smooth like PB.  It's so good it has spoiled peanut butter for me as I like this even better and I used to love PB, but now, I choose this every time.  In fact, I ate a whole 16 oz jar by myself just last week after being without it for a week due to lack of a local supply!  I eat it almost every day on apple slices, pear slices and bananas, Yum Yum!  Now if they could just bring down the price just a little...or if I could just keep my spoon out of the jar, seriously!

Barney Butter almond butter is great tasting, better than multiple other almond butters I've tried, and it's also nice that it doesn't need refrigeration.
I recomend it very highly.

ProfileName: J. Hall "juan rodriguez alejandro pena guadalupe"
Text: This is the first almond butter I have ever tried, and I will not need to try anything else. This stuff tastes better than most peanut butter, and it is way healthier. It is sweet and has its own distinct flavor. Try it you will probably like it.

This is my second purchase of this product.  Actually for my wife who eats peanut butter on a daily basis.  A friend suggested this almond butter as an alternative.  The taste is better both in my opinion and my wife's.  I've purchased almond butter before at Costco and was not impressed.  For whatever reason Barney Butter is better tasting.  This product is unavailable in stores in my area, so I believe I will continue ordering from amazon for some time.

I've been reading about the health benefits of almond butter, so decided to get some.  This price was very reasonable compared to store prices.  The flavor is really good, and when I run out of these 3 jars, I'll get it again.

This stuff is addicting. I've had a lot of other almond butters but this one takes the cake. I got almond butter to try and be healthier but I chased an entire container with chocolate covered pretzels! I don't regret it. Buy this product!

I've tried many Almond butters in hope of finding one that tastes very near to my dear Skippy PB.  This one is even better that Skippy.  My son likes it a lot and that's saying something b/c he hated all the others we tried (can't blame him.) So, if you're looking for a good substitute due to allergies, this is your ticket.  The only downside is that it is expensive.  Its cheaper here at amazon but its not like you can use a coupon when its on sale and get it for $1 like Skippy/Jif brands.

Summary: Good, but I liked the crunchy better
Text:
It seems strange because I've never been a "crunchy" kind of guy.

This one is good. But I don't find myself wanting to spoon it morning, noon, and night, like the crunchy version.

All and all, it's far better than the store bought brands so you can't really go wrong.

Summary: Best Almond Butter I have every tried
Text:
I lead a healthy lifestyle and have always substituted almond butter in place of peanut butter. I have tried many brands but when I was recently placing an order for a few things on Amazon I keyed in Almond Butter and after reading the reviews decided on a 3 pack of Smooth Barney Butter. It arrived yesterday and I almost ate the whole jar! It is smooth, rich, creamy and had a roasted almond taste. It was amazing! I will definitely continue to purchase this product and recommend to friends.

I cant wait to throw a few scoops into a protein shake.

Summary: Like peanut butter?  Give this a try!
Text:
I first tried Barney Butter by buying a few squeeze packets at my local Whole Foods and fell in love, but I found the price hard to swallow. So I headed on over to Amazon and picked up this three pack which, per jar, is a few dollars cheaper than my local WFM. The label doesn't lie, it certainly is no stir! It's very smooth and creamy, perhaps a little too creamy. My jars are so creamy that I can remove the top, turn them over, and the delicious almond butter will pour out on its own. I suspect that this extra creaminess is from the cane evaporated cane juice, but I don't care either way, it's so very tasty. If you like almonds, you'll love this. Unless of course, you like your almond butter crunchy.

Tonight, my girlfriend tried this for the first time and summed up exactly how I feel about Barney Butter, to quote: It tastes just like peanut butter. That's the same thing I said the first time I ever had this and it's kept me coming back time and time again. Since buying this, I've stopped purchasing peanut butter altogether, something I'd never though would happen.

If you're unsure if you'll like this, grab some of the squeeze packs and give it a try!
I really like this item.  The "no stirring", is actually true.  It is not oily and it has a very good flavor.

Summary: Very smooth, Lot better than Costco/supermarket brands
Text: If you are looking for the butter smooth peanut butter like consistency, this is it. It has a mild sweetness, and great aroma. They removed the other skins of the almond, so there is no grit like in other brands. I'm sure this is taking away some of the nutritional content and fiber, but hey it taste damn good.  I would classify this as true peanut butter replacement! And becasue this is made in an "Almond ONLY Facility", this removes any concerns with folks that have peanut allergies.

Summary: Amazing -  best almond butter I've ever tried
Text: I became an almond butter fan years ago because of all the health benefits.  It wasn't until I tried Barney Butter that I totally abandoned peanut butter all together - this stuff is amazing - and you can cook with it too - use it in place of anything calling for peanut butter for a much healthier alternative.

My son has a peanut allergy so we were thrilled to find this peanut butter that is manufactured in an "almond only" facility.  It is SO smooth with just a hint of sweetness so it really appeals to younger kids.  A+ !

Barney's Smooth Almond Butter is a very tasty nut Butter.  I sent a case to my son who let me know that it tasted better than peanut butter. It remains smooth from start to finish...it doesn't get dried out at the bottom of the jar.  I use it to make a banana sandwich or eat a tablespoon of it,  when I feel like something to munch on. It is a very satisfying and nutritious food. Everyone who has sampled it at my home has loved it.

Summary: An Excellent Magnesium & Vitamin E Food Source
Text: I have compared other almond butter products, and so far have found that Barney Butter contains a higher amount of magnesium and vitamin E.  It's delicious and gluten free...  Just food for thought....
I sent this as a gift to a friend, and he absolutely loves it. Will order again.

I WAS LOOKING FOR A PEANUT BUTTER SUBSTITUTE AND DECIDED TO TRY THIS ALMOND BUTTER. IT IS CREAMY, SMOOTH, JUST SWEET ENOUGH AND MUCH HEALTHIER FOR ME THAN PEANUT BUTTER. THIS IS A VERY GOOD PRODUCT AND I FIND MYSELF CRAVING IT THROUGHOUT THE DAY AS A LITTLE SNACK. GREAT PRICE CONSIDERING THE QUALITY OF THE PRODUCT. I HOPE AMAZON WILL CONTINUE TO OFFER THIS 3 PACK AS I AM GOING TO BE A REPEAT CUSTOMER! BEST OF THE BEST!
After years of not being able to have peanut butter in my home due to a child with a severe peanut allergy we finally found a replacement.  This is delicous and almost tastes like peanut butter.

The product tastes just fine, but contains more than just ground almonds and I wish I had pursued getting better product contents information before ordering several jars.  It also arrived in plastic containers that were all dented and distorted when they arrived which made me wonder if they had gotten overheated and some things just taste better in a glass jar.  It would be awesome to have a similar product without the palm oil and cane juice.

I love almonds and I read other reviews and thought I'd try it.. It takes getting use to it has a thicker texture than peanut butter.. I love peanut butter but I sometimes get heartburn after eating it, I haven't had this problem with the Barney butter! I'm thinking of using it as cake frosting. Its fun watching peoples reactions to the taste test like mine different and good.. Worth trying!!

This is one time I seem to be in the minority, all the other reviewers seem to love this almond butter, I'm sorry I really don't. I just got mine today and while I've heard about almond butter for years I've never tried it until now. I figured since I like almonds and almond extract (flavoring) I'd like almond butter too but I guess I was wrong. I wasn't sure what to expect but I'm kind of disappointed with it. It's like peanut butter only blander so the taste is so-so. I made an almond butter and jam sandwich with it and what I really don't like are the texture and consistency. Yes it's smooth but it's drier than peanut butter (maybe because it's got less oil I don't know). So with the texture I think it's a bit harder to spread than peanut butter too, and it was just I don't know, I guess "gunky" would be the word for it. It seems like it's got thicker globs throughout and it's not as creamy as peanut butter either. I just don't care for the texture, I think it's probably just a case of personal preference though. While I'd say the taste is good the overall texture and consistency don't appeal to me. And then there seems to be a problem with the packaging. The 3 jars came in a bag which was then inside a box. I opened the box and then the bag and the inside of the plastic bag and the outside of the jars was oily, I had to wash my hands off afterwards. I'm assuming it's almond oil, but the jars are all sealed so I'm not sure how any oil leaked out of them but it seems to have done that and I'm not thrilled about that either. But I will say I think they charge a fair price for the 3 jars. I'm not sure I'd by this or any other brand of almond butter again. But like I said maybe it's just me. If you like almond butter in general go ahead and try this brand. But I think I'll stick with peanut butter thank you very much.

I was very hesitant to try another brand of almond butter since I've been buying MaraNatha religiously for years. MaraNatha has a grainy taste and tends to clump in the jar, and also has to be refrigerated after opening. But, once I find a product that is good I stick with it. However, I started to make homemade granola bars, and the MaraNatha almond butter was somehow missing from store shelves in my town. Enter Barney Butter on Amazon. I am so glad that I chose to buy a case. I cannot say enough good things about this almond butter! It is incredibly smooth, the consistency is even better than peanut butter. The grainy taste, tendency to clump, and ubiquitous oil at the top of the jar are nonexistent in the jars of Barney Butter I received! I love it, my kids love it, you will love it!
Found this butter in Market Basket (that place rocks), but sadly I haven't been able to find it closer where I live (shaws u suck).. Anyways, Almond > Peanut anyday of the week.

We have a peanut allergy in our household, which otherwise loves peanut butter!  After many attempts to find a substitute, even making our own almond butter, we found and settled on Barney Butter.  Actually we really like our homemade almond butter but the only almonds we found and could afford that were not processed with peanuts later had a statement appear on the package that said "processed in a plant with peanuts".  So though this may not be quite as"healthy" as our own, it is fantastic and totally peanut-free!  I don't think you could get any closer to the taste, consistancy, color of peanut butter.  It works in all of our baking in which we used to use pb.  I think it is so close that it would be important to train a little one with a peanut allergy that while they may eat Barney Butter, there is something almost exactly like it (peanut butter) that they can not eat.  Sorry to offend any health-interested people out there, this review is simply based on someone looking for a substitute for pb and finding the absolute best one.  BTW, comparing the nutrition info of this to pb, it seems to be healthier than peanut butter.)

After developing a peanut allergy two years ago, I despaired of my ever eating anything as delicious ever again. I tried to substitute almond butter but failed--I bought a bottle of expensive crap that sat in the back of my fridge for a year before I tossed it. The other day I decided to try Barney Butter when I saw it at Whole Foods and I couldn't believe it. I kept checking the outside of the jar, wondering how it could possibly NOT be peanut butter. I'm about to buy my first three-pack, and I can't believe I can enjoy my favorite snacks again (apples and Barney Buter, now!) without worrying about my allergy.

This stuff is crack for the peanut-loving who have a peanut allergy. HOORAY!
My mom & I didn't know where to find almond butter, we heard about it. I knew I'd find it on Amazon.com. Barney's is the best so far for us. Thank you.

My daughter is allergic to peanuts, so of course we don't keep any peanut butter around.  Barney butter was given to us to try since it is made in a peanut free facility.  I have to say it is delicious and worked great in an almond butter and jelly sandwich and on a banana so far.  I have now ordered the individual portions for us to take when we travel.  My daughter hasn't tried it yet (she's 3), but she is a little picky and usually has to warm up to something before she tries it.  Will definitely keep ordering!

Barney Butter is rockin goodness. Of course, we choose the smooth version. It does come in two different varieties, the smooth and crunchy versions. We just LOVE Barney Butter. It has no weird after taste that so many others have.
I highly recommend it!

I'll assume most people looking to buy almond butter on Amazon already know how much healthier it is than peanut butter. If not, Google can tell you in five seconds. (Remember, almonds are nuts, peanuts are not.) But for those of you still picking peanut butter because it tastes better, stop here. Barney Butter tastes as good as peanut butter and, in my opinion, tastes even better. Buy this butter and be healthier. That is all.

P.S. Most every almond butter I've tried always has oil at the top of the jar. Yucky. You have to stir it until you break your hand to get it mixed back in with the butter. And then the next time you get into the jar you have to do it all over again. Not so with Barney Butter. No oil. No yucky. Just good eating.

I am allergic to peanuts and love peanut butter.  This is the only nut butter or nonpeanut butter ( I have tried soy and others) that I really enjoy the flavor.  I have used it in cooking cookies instead of peanut butter.

Just found this almond butter and my family is in love!!!! It is peanut free for those with an allergy, but you are really not sacrificing anything. It is the same texture as peanut butter and so much better for you. I have also bought it directly from their website at an even better discount - [...]. I also love their snack packs, so great for travel and to throw in the kids' lunch box!! Barney Butter Almond Butter 90 Calorie Snack Packs, (Pack of 24)

I live in an area where I cannot get Almond Butter at a reasonable price. So I found this offer online and thought I would give it a try. While it does have cane sugar, it is gluten-free. I highly recommend Barney Butter because it tastes great! I will be buying more when this runs out.

One of the best tasting Almond Butters, non peanut allergy kids like it too, wouldn't buy anything else for my son who is allergic to every nut except almonds, thank you for making in a almond only facility, would love to see them make other almond exclusive snacks.
Not a big peanut butter fan but this almond butter is just as good and lower in carbs which is what I wanted.

I still like the taste peanut butter better, but Barney almond butter is a nice alternative that is growing on me. Great on Saltines or Ritz crackers or on apple slices. In our non-AC house, I've been keeping the open jar in the refrigerator. Letting it come to room temp not only makes it easier to spread, it also allows for fuller flavor.
Barney Butter worked great in all my recipes calling for almond butter. i ever substituted it in some of the recipes that called for peanut butter.

Summary: Allergic to Peanuts?  This is the trick.
Text:
My daughter and my nephew are both terribly allergic to peanuts, but they can eat almonds. Kids have loved PB&J sandwiches as long as I can remember - heck, I still love them! This is a great alternative for those who cannot eat peanut butter. It's not as sweet as the conventional peanut butters, which is probably a good thing considering all the corn syrup in them, but it tastes great!

We keep a couple of jars in the house, and I just sent a few to my nephew, who loves it too. You do have to stir it a bit, but that's an okay trade off in my opinion.

Great job Barney Butter!

I have loved PBJ's all my life. Until my son was discovered to have a peanut allergy, bye bye PBJ! Hello Barney Butter!
We have tried all the replacements out there. This is the BEST for texture and flavor substitute. My two kids ate over half a jar the day this arrived! That was at 3pm and it was gone before bed time! That is just with spoons dipped right in.
I am unable to tell the difference when having a BBJ. My husband is thrilled, since we both loved PB but have not had it in over 3 years.
I am back today to order more since it is on sale now to stock my pantry! Thanks be to Barney for making this in a almond only facility. That is awesome!

Summary: Finally a peanut free almond butter!
Text: We have a 6 year old that is severely allergic to peanuts, so we have tried sunbutter, soy butter and they all tasted horrible.  I found Barney Butter a few years ago and contacted the company to find out if it was a peanut free facility.  Jennifer Barney promptly wrote me back and said that she was working on it.  I am very happy they are now peanut free and we were able to try almond butter for the first time with our son and he loved it!  We will be buying more.  Thank you!
I love this stuff. I like it much better than peanut butter. I like it for breakfast or a snack. This was the second time that I orderd a three pack and will be ordering more.

I saw Barney Butter at Whole Foods and something made me buy it!  We gave up peanut butter three years ago when our son was diagnosed with a life-threatening peanut allergy.  We found almond butter that worked but it just wasn't close to peanut butter.  After trying Barney Butter, we are addicted!  My husband brings the whole jar to work and has it on toast for breakfast!  Barney Butter is the perfect consistency and taste and I love that it is made in a peanut-free facility (this can be hard to find with almond butter).  I highly recommend it!!!  I no longer miss peanut butter.

Summary: one star for NONEXISTENT customer service
Text:
so my family was looking for something similar to peanut butter but w/o the peanuts. we were also looking for something that did not use roasted nuts b/c roasting is not as healthy compared to raw nuts. after looking on amazon i came across this brand. i wanted to find out more about how it was prepared so i wrote to their customer service on their website. after you submit you question a friendly message pops up basically saying "we'll reply within 24-48 hours" etc.

days passed. no reply. so i try another time. more days pass. again no reply.

since we wanted to order some soon i go ahead and buy some based on the picture they posted on amazon. i trusted that their picture listed an accurate portrayal of their item they were selling. the picture did not show anything about roasted nuts. well we get the item in and open it up. what do i see? their packaging changed. on the front of the label lists roasted and blanched nuts.

as far as taste? nothing exceptional. tastes just like all the other stuff we've bought before. needless to say we wont be buying this product again.

ps. we bought this item on july 3rd and have yet to get a reply from this company. i would have to say that their "customer support" is truly pathetic.
Barney Butter is the best tasting almond butter I have ever had.  Plus my family likes it too and they don't like almond butter.

Why why why ruin this product with "evaporated cane juice" and palm oil -- among the most unhealthy oils -- pure saturated fat!  Almond butter, due to its monounsaturated fats and ldl cholesterol, can and should be a very nutritious substitute for peanut butter and even butter. That's why people buy it (aside from its amazing flavor)!  What are these people thinking?  So disappointing (and gross).  I don't know if I can give this stuff away.

I LOVE Barney Butter Almond Butter and like buying it in bulk.  But, it does not save me money to get 2 good jars and one damaged jar that I cannot return, which is what happened when I ordered here through Amazon.  It is just too risky for me to purchase it here, because I don't know if I'm going to get three good jars or 2...or 1...or none!  And then there is nothing I can do about it.  Grocery items are not returnable and there is no way to contact anyone about it.  As far as the Almond butter, it is perfect!  We eat it on everything, toast, english muffins, waffles, graham crackers, apples, pretzels, tortillas .  It's smooth and easy to spread without being drippy.  It's not too sweet or bitter.  I'm just thankful there were 2 good jars!!  But, that made them $12 a piece...yikes!
Like the product but shipping mishap left a broken lid and oily goo all over.  No area to request refund or replacement. Not sure I'd order this again in warm weather.

Summary: Warning- check the ingredient list if you can find it
Text: This product was recommended.  I usually make my own almond butter in a food processor with quality almonds.  That is not always convenient.  Barney's product was on another website with fibre products I purchase.  It was very hard to determine what the ingredients were - reading the label when there is sugar I want to know the source... I got curious - no ingredient list means MORE research because they are hiding something.  This has other ingredients, palm oil it appears and cane sugar... That's probably why it tastes good.  Advice:  Read the labels if you want to know what you are putting into your body.

Barney Butter is okay, but not great in my opinion.  But that's my fault, not theirs....I am used to mainstream peanut butter, which is sweeter.  Barney Butter is an almond butter and not as sweet.  But if you're used to a healthy nut butter, you'll probably love this.  When I put it on toast or a rice cake/kamut cake, I have to add banana or jam or agave to sweeten it a little more.  But I'm simply used to Peter Pan and Jif. Otherwise, the texture is great.  It's slightly oily, but not icky messy.  And you don't have to keep it refrigerated.

I have been buying natural nut butters for YEARS, and I have never, EVER seen on that has so much oil in it. Even when fully mixed, this was too runny to really use on bread, which in itself is ok since I don't EAT bread, but not at all what I expect from anything other than Tahini!

Is this NORMAL for this stuff, or did I get a bad batch. Just asking because I won't buy again if this is normal.....

Summary: Don't like the taste at all
Text: No it does not taste like peanut butter has a very distinct wang would only eat if I was Starving

Summary: Barney Butter takes the lowest of the low roads
Text:
Another product bites the dust.....Barney Butter almond butter. I used to enjoy this...now they are putting adulterants in it. Evaporated cane juice (?) and PALM OIL (!!!)

The clearing and burning of rainforest in Indonesia, Malaysia and other parts of Asia for palm oil plantations is destroying the habitat of endangered species. It is the main reason there may be no Orangutans in 20 years. When they venture into the plantations because they are hungry the mothers are brutally killed, the babies ripped from their dead bodies and sold in the pet trade. Palm oil anyone? yum!

Absolutely love this paste.  The Sun-Dried tomatoes add a different flavor than regular tomatoes.  We use the sun-dried tomato paste in all our recipes that call for tomato paste; chili's, sauces, ect!

I'm embarassed to say that I lived my life without being introdued to Sun Dried Tomato Paste.  No more ketchup, use the SDTP on everything. You must try it, especially diabetics.  Try it = YOU WILL LOVE IT.  NEED MORE OF IT - ALMOST ALL GONE :-(.
Such a good taste for the Sun Dried Tomato Paste!  Good price to match...and delivered very quickly! This product is very hard to find on the shelves in the grocery store!

This tortellini was even better than I expected. It didn't taste like a boxed variety, more like the kind you buy in the refrigerated section of the grocery store. Also, I was pleased that the tomato and spinach pasta didn't have a gross, healthy taste, and the flavor of the cheese really came through. I make this with pasta sauce from the jar, and it's great for a quick meal.
I use so much of this spice blend I decided to order it in bulk.  I buy the organic spices when possible.  The Italian blend is perfect for any dish that I want to add some body to.
These are the best treats in the world, and I feel great about giving them to my dog. He loves them--and they're NOT made in China!

I ordered two bags of Yummy Chummies and they arrived promptly.  However they should have been shipped with a hammer enclosed to break them.  We have purchased these before from Costco and they were moist, the ones we purchased online were hard as rocks.  I believe they may have been a very old product and I was very unsatisfied with them even though the dogs ate them.  I have no idea how you can verify a fresh product when ordered online.

Our dog, a 13-pound Italian Greyhuahua, loves these treats.  We like them because they are grain free.  I usually break them in half for our dog because she is so small and doesn't need the extra calories.

My English Cocker just loves this treats, he can'tget enough....he expects to have his treats every night, otherwise he gets an attitude, won't let me rest until he has his treats....
great treat...fast service....thanks

Summary: High-quality treats, but not my dog's favorite
Text: What I like about these treats is that they are super healthy. They don't contain any grain, sugar, or similar additives (unlike so many dog treats on the market). However, like a lot of health foods they smell kinda funny (like seaweed) and I get the sense that my dog doesn't care much for them. When offered one of these treats along with her kibble or "jerky" treats, she forgoes these every time in favor of the other.

Summary: Second and third batches were stale.
Text: The dogs loved the first bag we ordered, the bites were somewhat chewy.  The second bag was rock hard so we returned that bag and received a replacement bag that wasn't much better; they are too hard for the small dogs.  The product is great when fresh but I'm hesitant to order again.

My dog loves these treats. She is older and I believe this grain free product is good for her digestion and contains glucosamine & chrondrotin. Yes, they smells fishy but one would expect a product that is 95% salmon to do so. The fact my dog loves these healthy treats is enough for me.
If your dog likes like fish or salmon oil then I recommend you purchase this 2 1/2 pound bag.

These treats are really smelly and I could live with that if my dog actually liked them.  She will rarely eat them.  Most of the time she won't even take it when it's offered but if she does, I usually find it sitting around on her bed.  I'm still looking for a replacement for the chicken jerky that she loves but I can't feed her because it comes from China and has made too many dogs sick.  I'll keep trying to find a treat she likes.  This one definitely wasn't it.

My dog's trainer introduced us to these.  My trainer carries them, but while they were out of stock I purchased a bag from amazon.  They are grain-free, which is a plus.  They are super yummy, per the dog, and they are nice and smelly which is good for nose-work and training sessions!  They are easily broken up into smaller pieces so one large bag last a good while.  Love these!

Summary: Best you can buy for your best friend
Text: Great product loved by my buddies, my dogs Bait and Milady!!!!! They look forward to their special treats. Great for their health ,too.

These are the best dog treats! We especially like the GOLD version because they're grain-free!!
We're keeping our bulldog away from treats or food with grains because of potential allergies.
This snack for him fits the bill perfectly!! He would do almost anything for a "chummie"!!!

Summary: Nothing not to like for training
Text:
I liked these treats very much for using in training. First, I appreciate the bulk size they sell them in and I feel good that it's made in the USA. Second, I like that I can easily cut them into smaller bites or break them up to make them last. All 4 of my dogs love them and I'm able to use them as a high level treat for harder commands. Also - my puppy who is 15 weeks old had no problems digesting them.
All in all a 5 star product in my opinion.
Our "sled dog" buddy thinks these are the best so is always on he is best behaviour when he thinks these treats may be in his future

Dogs love these treats, plus they're healthy. You can easily break the treats into smaller pieces.
Plus they don't smell so you can carry them in your pockets.
Just remember to empty your pockets before you put your clothes in the wash!!
I like that these are over 90% salmon.  The dogs love the taste.  Only down side is they do smell like fish.  But that is to be expected.  Will buy them again.
If you like green tea and you like ginger, this is perfect for you.  The ginger flavor is not too strong.  Glad than Amazon has this as this variety is hard to find.

Summary: The Tea that grew on me
Text: I tried this tea for the first time months ago, for medicinal purposes, and I didn't really like the taste.  It isn't very ginger-y, and initially I didn't sweeten it, as I normally don't sweeten tea or coffee.  Then I began using raw honey in it, and drink it with breakfast every morning - 1 cup, steeped about 4 minutes.  I really like it now, and haven't found anything else that I would want to have with breakfast to enhance my health.  I don't give it 5 stars because on its own, without the honey, it is not impressive.

Summary: Light on Ginger, Heavy on Pear
Text: Straight out of the package the aroma was a halting sweet and spicy with fruity undertones made even more potent when brewed. It's too bad that the taste couldn't live up to that exciting fragrance. From the name (Green Ginger) I expected to taste a bit more ginger and a lot less pear. To be clear, the tea was all right, but rather underwhelming for this ginger lover.

I love ginger! But I don't like the gross ginger teas you can get at Asian import store - they're a bit too gingery somehow and just taste bad. This is a perfect blend of both ginger and green. I haven't been able to find anything else like it. It's the best tea you'll find in a bag!

I have been looking for this green tea for some time since Starbucks changed their green tea.  I loved it when I could order it there.  What they serve now is blah and they should return to Tazo Green Ginger.  I am so glad you had it because now I can fix my own!  It is such yummy tea!
this one i call it the best mix green and ginger tea very healthy and concentarted,,i loved it
I've been drinking this tea for years and it is by far my favorite of the tazo green teas.

Summary: The best of all green teas
Text: I drink several mugs of hot tea each day and Tazo Green Ginger tea is far and above the BEST tea I have ever tasted.
As an Asian Amercian, I am very custom to ginger taste, but will charaterize this tea as a herbal medicine which I hate it.

I loved the quality and the taste of these cookies. They are not too sweet and they will live to your expectations. To the person that posted a bad review, just a small comment. They are called meltaways because they have real butter, go figure. If you are interested in low fat food, look elsewhere. It like complaining that french fries are fried, or that chocolate is fattening. Just saying.

These were so, so good, and I love that they're made with whole wheat flour and a healthier sugar substitute (not aspartame or splenda). I looked at some Atkins peanut butter cups I'd just bought, and they're a higher percentage of saturated fat than these cookies. I worry a lot more about the sugar in a product than the fat, unless it's made with soybean oil or lists trans fat. I list this as one of my "healthy snacks." And since I'm over 40, size 4, with no health problems - I must be on the right track of what "healthy" is. :)

One customer said hers were "greasy." Maybe hers were in the heat, and the butter got hot? I'm now placing my third order for these. They're worth it!
I love these cookies, but this paticular batch was stale, very hard, & I had to dip them in my coffe to eat them easily.

Summary: Good dessert for someone gluten sensitive, dairy sensitive and diabetic
Text:
My husband is gluten sensitive, dairy sensitive, and diabetic, so it is very difficult to find desserts for him. Usually, if it's gluten free, it has waaaay too much sugar, for example. I tried a box of these cookies for him. He tried them and said that they are surprisingly good.

They are not mereingues, even though they are shaped like those types of cookies. They are regular cookie consistency. There are just a few in a package, so they are rather expensive. However, they are less expensive than buying all the materials yourself and having them fail. (Can you tell I have made some bombs in my time as a specialty cook? LOL)
If you are ordering cookies, beware, the 'cookies' arrived in crumbles, so, if you want a box of stale crumbs order away :)

Two of Aunt Gussie's cookies contain 23% of daily fat allowance!  The cookies are so full of grease they fall apart.  They may be sugar free and gluten free, but they make it up with mostly FAT!  I can't even give them to my grandchildren!

I enjoy making homemade Italian food and this enhances anything I make! Does anything smell better than pancetta and garlic cooking? ;)  I received it in a timely matter and the quality is very good! You will not regret ordering this!

I am assuming that most people would buy this tin for the wedding picture of William and Kate on it. However, the teabags inside are surprisingly decent, producing a nice, flavorful black tea, nothing like the flat-tasting bland stuff that is usually packed with tins like this.

I admit that I bought it for fun at a national discount store (which shall remain unnamed) and at a much lower price than offered here. Since I am not a fan per se of the British Royals, I would not have purchased this at the almost $15 price set by this vendor. But if you are a "Royalist" and enjoy a good cup of black tea, this might be a nice thing to get and display.

UPDATE 8/10/12: The price has dropped by almost 2/3rds - at this new price, I will snap up a few more tins to give as gifts...

Summary: Best Finishing Salt in the World
Text: The texture and flavor of this finishing salt is addictive.  It is light and crunchy, but not too sharp tasting.  By far the best out there, better than Maldon and the other usual suspects.  My mother and I order it by the case for our households, because nothing can replace it and we can't be without it.  Summer tomatoes from the garden with a sprinkling of this flaky salt is unbeatable.  Although real, freshly popped popcorn with melted cultured butter and Marlborough flaky salt is a close second!

This is amazing salt! A friend brought me my first bag from the Cook Islands. It is light and very nice on the tooth. I wish I could buy it in 5 lb bags. The best use so far, steam young potatos, flatten on a sheet pan drench with olive oil (I infuse mine with garlic) and sprinkle liberally with this salt and bake hot (400* convection) until brown. It is a great finishing salt for meats too!

The product itself is AWESOME! It tastes great and does what it says but the only problem is the price because it costs about 6 bucks with shipping but in the gamer grub website it is only 3 bucks with FREE shipping (on orders 40 dollars of more). It's a much better deal getting it straight off the gamer grub website that way it is a much better deal!
This salt is coarser than regular table salt and will not work in most shakers; I just take a pinch from the bag and sprinkle to taste. Good taste.
I use Celtic Sea Salt almost exclusively when cooking and eating. It is full of minerals and lower in sodium than common table salt.

This salt is great!  This salt has great health benefits- contains essential minerals, is minimally processed, is not bleached or treated like "regular" salt, etc.  It also tastes fantastic!  You couldn't pay me to go back to "regular" salt!

Odd that the less processed the salt the more expensive it is.  I'm sure there must be a logical reason.  This is a damp, slightly coarse product.  You will need to use it from a salt cellar because it won't pour through the holes in a shaker.  I drink distilled water exclusively and there are some health advisers out there who say that trace minerals should be taken to make up for the lack of them in distilled water.  Some even claim that the water can actually remove trace minerals from your system and that is one big reason I use a quality sea salt, to hopefully replace trace minerals if indeed they are being depleted by drinking distilled water.  This salt is very tasty but it is not very much salt for the price.  Still, I plan to buy another bag.

Summary: Less Sodium and More Flavor, Plus Minerals!
Text: I have been using this salt for nearly three years. My husband has to have a low-sodium diet, but those potassium chloride substitutes taste awful. This salt is full of all sorts of healthy minerals and tastes amazing. We get all the flavor with less actual sodium due to all the minerals taking up space in the salt. Most table salt has 480 mg of sodium per 1/4 teaspoon, and some sea salts go as high as 530 mg per 1/4 teaspoon. Celtic Sea Salt has only 330 mg per 1/4 teaspoon. That my not sound like much of a difference, but 1/4 teaspoon is really small, so the difference gets pretty large when you look at a whole day's worth of meals. Not to mention that all those minerals are great for is heart (and mine)!
I use this sea salt every time I do a fast for salt water flushes. It is also great for cooking too.
I bought this to use w/ the Master Cleanse and it didn't last me. My family loves using this so I have to order more now. :D

Summary: Great salt easy to open and close bag.
Text: I like this Celtic Ocean Sea Salt. The bag the salt comes in is easy to open and close over and over.
when i got it in the mail, it was smaller than i expected. but it came really fast and it works great.

We received this product very quickly.  This is an holistic product to help the cells in the body absorb liquids and not get dehydrated.  I had never heard of the product before, but it works.  Thank you Amazon for carrying this product.

Great stuff!  Use it all the time to spice up alkaline foods without having to worry about my salt intake.  I know I'm getting essential minerals the way nature intended without a bunch of processed stuff from man made products.  Helps my GI tract functions without a bunch of over the counter medicines.  Highly recommended.

I love this saly. I know some people say sea salt is sea salt, but this one has them all bear, hands down.  Give it a try on a plain baked potato, youll see what I mean! My wife is very much into sea salt of late, and we've ordered this product several times now. High quality product and a fair price.
This was recommended by a Dr for my son.  I wasn't thrilled with it.  I think French Grey salt has more flavor.  I bought this about three years ago and I still have have the pack in my cabinet.
It was OK, but not better than cheeper brands of unproccesed Sea Salt.  I'll save my money and purchase the less expensive brand(s)

Absolute best and easiest seasoning out their. Works great with ground beef/venison, or whole muscle meat! Can't ask for a better product. One hint though, the ingredients in the "Wild Goose" seasoning and the other kind for beef or venison are exactly the same, so don't pay any extra for the goose kind, because its the same thing!

Summary: One of the best jerky seasonings that I've used
Text: This Hi-Mountain product adds just the right flavor to both hamburger strip jerky and snack sticks.  Makes 15 lbs. of muscle meat and about 7 lbs. of hamburger strips or snack sticks. Definitely my favorite seasoning mix.  Has less Sodium Nitrite than other seasonings. Let cure for 24 hrs. for best taste.

I've used this to make both beef and venison jerky in a smoker with great results. I like the cracked pepper and garlic flavor so much I don't even feel like trying other flavors or products. Everybody has their own opinion of what the perfect jerky style/flavor is and this hits pretty close to my ideal, YMMV. I've only used it with sliced meat but don't see any reason why it wouldn't work great with ground meat.

The kit comes with a shaker, instructions, and two resealable bags - one of cure and one of seasoning. Keep the instructions, they tell you the ratio of cure and seasoning for how much meat you have. Make sure you use the right amount of cure. I like my jerky with a little more seasoning than what they call for.

Just mix the correct ratio of cure and seasoning in the shaker and apply it evenly over all the surface of your sliced meat. You want the cure to contact all of the meat's surface evenly. Put the meat in a ziplock bag in the fridge for a day or two to cure(mix it around once in awhile to insure even distribution of the cure) and then it's ready to go to the smoker or dehydrator. Very easy and it gets rave reviews.
This product is exactly what I was looking for and will help in making the perfect wedding present for my cousin. Thank you so much!

I got these for my grandsons 4th birthday party. It was in a pirate theme.
These are PERFECT for the party gift bags to give to the kids.
They are so cute you almost don't want to eat them (ALMOST)

I had been dying to try some New Zealand honey since hearing someone rave about pairing it with almond butter. So, I took an English Muffin, spread some almond butter on one side and a Tbsp of New Zealand Clover Creamed Honey on the other. It was pretty close to heaven. Note: A Tbsp is a LOT of honey. Next time, I'm going to try 1/2 Tbsp. ;-) Also, I just ordered this honey on Sunday, and it shipped Monday, with me receiving it Thursday. Not bad. I was expecting it to take a week or more, but the seller was super fast! (seller: RussianShoppe) As for this particular honey, it is probably the closest to what you would buy in the grocery store, as far as flavoring. Some of the others might taste stronger, like Manuka or Tahari... I'm not sure, since I haven't tried those. But this stuff smells and tastes awesome. My only problem with it is that I KNOW it will not last me more than a week! I could eat it straight out of the jar! ;-)

Some info that is on the label and not in the item description, but I thought you might be interested in:

"Clover- Clover honey is everybody's favourite. Here in a creamed form, it is light in colour with a smooth creamy texture and delicate flavour that is typical of the best clover honey produced in our South Island pastoral country. New Zealand produces the very best quality Clover honey in the world." (yes, they do!)

Also, it says to keep the honey cool (20-22C), dry and avoid sunlight. There is an iron-clad guarantee, no questions asked. If you do not like the product (as if that would be possible), you can return it for a replacement.

Nutrition Facts: Serving Size 1 Tbsp (21g), 24 servings per container. Calories: 60 Carb: 17 (16g from sugar)

Like I said, the only complaint I would have is that the jar is not bigger. It is 500g, about the size of a coffee mug. If you can find this in a store where you don't have to pay shipping, awesome. If you have to pay shipping, well, maybe we can talk them into making a jar about 3 times this size. No joke! Buy it now! :)
Expensive but so worth it!  I come from UK where clover honey from new Zealand is readily available.  It has been difficult to find really great honey in US.  I would recommend this.

I hadn't bothered to scroll down the page to view the ingredients when I ordered because the picture is clearly of the Passover variety.
Love this new cereal! Not only is it super convenient for me (full time working mom), it really tastes delicious.

Summary: I really really REALLY wanted to like this stuff.
Text:
I picked this up for $3.99 at my local grocers in this flavor and in orange cranberry. I love quinoa and as a gluten and oat intolerant person, I was psyched to give this a try. I was so psyched that I had about 6 pouches in my arm at the supermarket because I missed having a hearty hot cereal in the morning that wasn't rice based. Luckily, I only bought two of the pouches after seeing the high price (which I think is understandable since it is made out of whole foods and the packaging is convenient). Little did I know that only buying two packs would save me a trip to the return desk.

I could not bring myself to swallow this stuff. I guess after packaging and sitting on a shelf, the quinoa became very mushy. The fruity flavors didn't mesh well with the grain either, which is odd because fresh quinoa and fruit is normally delicious. Its possible that the culprit for the odd texture and taste was the coconut milk (or was it cream?). Maybe it should be replaced with a milder plant-based milk like Almond milk and a smaller portion of coconut. Further, I think instead of being served ready to eat, it should be dehydrated so that way the unappetizing mushy-ness would never be a factor.

Overall the taste wasn't atrocious, but the odd texture was a deal breaker. I would try this product again if they change the recipe/packaging because I think it's a sound concept.

I got two packages each of the Banana Cinnamon and Wild Blueberry flavors from a daily deal site for vegans (Spencer's Market). I wanted something shelf stable to keep in my desk for a quick meal or snack that is all-natural, not too high in calories and with a good amount of protein. This absolutely fits the bill - it is easy to heat (Or you can eat it cold, but heated definitely tastes better). The ingredients are all -natural, and thanks to the quinoa, has some good protein in there as well without a ton of sugar. (Although 14 grams of sugar might be too high to eat this on a regular basis.)

My one quibble with it is the price - at $4 a serving it is definitely cheaper to just make your own quinoa at home and then you can control the amount of sugar you add. Still, as a convenience item for when healthier choices aren't available, it's great.

We have used these for bars, cookies, and no bakes many times over. They are not too tough, and there is no off flavor. It is *so* great to have a gluten free option that is also more like a quick oat. Plus, I don't have any negative consequences from eating this brand.

I ordered these oats because they are GF and cost less than my previous brand. I usually buy Bob's Red Mill GF oats, but this brand was significantly less and so I made the switch. However, now I can't wait to finish these up and go back to Bob's oats. We CAN'T stand the mushiness, as if they're over-processed or something. I'll be making batches of oatmeal cookies to get rid of these packs. Besides Bob's taste much fresher. You get what you pay for.
Both of my shelties, who are extremely fussy, love these. They enjoy both the white and the peanut butter. The small are the perfect size for them.

Buying groceries from Amazon has 2 potential benefits: lower prices and access to items not locally available. This product excells in both areas.
It took me forever to track down manhattan clam chowder locally. The only product I found was Progresso ready-to-eat. You only got 19 ounces for $3. Since the Chincoteague is condensed you get far more soup per $.
As to taste, I compared the soups side by side. The Progresso had a bit more depth of flavor, but it wasn't coming from clams. Even though both soups were only heated until a simmer appeared at the edge of the pots, the clam meat in the Progressor was very chewy and not very abundant. The Chincoteague had plenty of clam meat which had very good consistency. The broth was well flavored with hints of the ocean.
In my opinion, this is as good as canned clam chowder can get.

This is the best canned clam chowder I have tasted. The flavor and aroma were clammy and the clams themselves were not rubbery. I would give this 5 stars compared to other canned clam chowder but 4 star compared to all chowders I have tasted. Adding a full can of water results in a generous bowl of soup. Definitely worth while having in the larder.

I have tried many canned Manhattan Chowders, this one is the best I've ever tried.  The clam content actually exceeds the potatoes. It is very tasty, although I would suggest that anyone who likes spice add some hot pepper to their individual taste.

Summary: Hard to find Manhattan Clam Chowder

This is the best Manhattan Clam Chowder i have ever had!! This is my second order of this product from Amazon and i couldn't be more satisified!! gdm
it is almost impossible to find manhatten style clam chowder in the stores anymore...this brand is very tasty and a quality product.

I guess I was looking for a more tomato based type of chowder. The taste was fine just not what I was hoping for. Still, in my area it is impossible to find anything but the New England style chowder so I was happy to find this.

Arrived in two plastic bags inside a box. I found the tootsie pops to be great, not perfect, but pretty close. Didn't have the problems some other reviewers had...no old or super sticky wrappers. Summary: Fruit snacks high in vitamin C
Text: These come individually wrapped with a reasonable shelf life.  They can be added to a candy jar, or added to a day pack or lunch bag.  They make a good fruit snack or small dessert.  I personally liked the flavors.  I have purchased these in bulk to add to Halloween bags, but they are also available for smaller size orders.

They were rock hard and I could not even chew it, it was more like hard candy instead of the chewy goodness I remembered from childhood. They were not expired, I gave one to my room mate to try and he could not even chew it. Maybe I just got a bad bag but I was extremely disappointed.

Pectin based candies are tasty and easy to eat.

Starch based fruit candies can require more chewing and are more likely to be a choking hazard.
My wife and I are both from Sweden, and we grew up on this stuff. You can drink it either warm or cold, or as a hot soup. If warm, it's really good w whip cream on it.

Ok- I had no idea what these were when I ordered them.  But my goodness am I glad I took a chance.  These are a sweet, malty candy- like sucking on burned sugar (not badly burned- just a tasty little bit burned).  I have tried these in my chai tea- oh my- it's SO good.  One little candy in a glass of chai is enough to get the marvelous flavor.  I've also put it in cocoa- and it's good in that too. Summary: Hot but not too hot - a nicely blended hot sauce. Purchase this "extra hot " variety. The regular version is Not Recommended
Text:
Lets face it - the Mexicans love hot food and generally know how to make a fine hot sauce. While the label (in small print) says "extra hot" there are many other sauces which are far hotter. Think in terms of needing 5 or 6 drops for a bloody mary rather than spoonfuls when using this sauce. It is far from being "extra hot". I'd call it medium hot.

Important: There is a significant difference between this "extra hot" variety of Valentina hot sauce and their regular variety. The easiest way to tell the two apart is the regular version has a light yellow background on the label and this one - the so called "extra hot" has a black background on the label. To my taste, the "extra hot" is far superior.

Ingredients (as copied from the label): water, chili peppers, vinegar, salt ...

Which chili peppers Valentina used is unknown, yet the company has certainly created a nice blend. You can easily detect some sweetness in this sauce and that has to be due to a nice blend of the chiles. There are no added sugars!

Normally I don't like any vinegar in a hot sauce, yet I don't mind it all in this particular version of Valentina. The difference may be this sauce uses actual vinegar while most others use acetic acid (a chemical component of vinegar) and the chili peppers dominate in this particular variety of Valentina. I want to emphasize that this is ONLY true for this particular blend.

The bottom line is this is a nicely blended hot sauce worthy of your consideration. My four star rating means this is a very good hot sauce but, depending on your palette, you might find a few that are better.

Warning: there is a significant differences between the regular Valentina and the "extra hot" (black label) variety that I'm reviewing here. In the regular version a heavy taste of vinegar is painfully evident while the "extra hot" variety is much better balanced, ie, the vinegar is in the background. So it is quite important that you choose the extra hot version - the one with a black background on the label.

This is a near perfect hot sauce for a bloody mary and most other foods.

BTW: Watch out for sellers that price the sauce low but charge very high shipping charges on a per bottle basis

Summary: Fantastic stuff at a great price
Text:
Citric acid is one of those incredibly useful items to have on hand. I use it mainly for cleaning tasks such as:

> cleaning coffee machines - works much better than vinegar at removing hard water deposits.

> cleaning hot water pots - as above. Much easier and less smell than using vinegar.

> cleaning dishwashers - add a couple of tablespoons and run the dishwasher through a cycle when it is empty. Makes the interior sparkle like new.

> boosting dishwasher detergent performance - add a small amount (about a teaspoon or less) to dishwasher detergent. Really boosts the cleaning power and eliminates hazy dishes. Be careful not to use too much, however, since it can pit delicate glass or metal.

> cleaning steam cleaners, steam mops and irons - gets all the crud out.

Basically, this is the best cleaner for anything that is affected by hard water deposits. You can buy commercial products such as Cleancaf or other similar cleaners, but the main active ingredient is citric acid. You can get it bulk at a fraction of the cost.

The only downside is that this comes packaged in a thin plastic sack. The first thing you'll want to do is transfer it to a plastic container with a tight fitting lid. Makes it much easier to store and use. Regardless of the container, citric acid clumps up easily when there's humidity in the air, but that does not affect its performance. Just bust up the clump and you're good to go. The shelf life is indefinite when you use it as a cleaning product.

Highly recommend.

Our citric acid arrived on-time and in great condition.  I completely understand the argument about the cheap bag--it is flimsy and of poor quality.  However, they apparently learned their lesson.  Ours had a second bag over the outside to add a little bit more tear resistance.  It might still not be able to stand up to a great deal of abuse, but it was apparently enough to make it to our house unscathed.
The citric acid arrived quickly, but was packaged poorly, so the bag broke open. The postman even left a note about it.

WOW!!! My dishes have never sparkled like this. My washing machine is clean and smell free. Many uses for this product. Im pretty sure anyone buying this would put it into another container so Im not sure why people complain about packaging.

Im not scientist, only internet research and personal experience. Take my advice how you wish. This is the stuff they put on Sour Patch Kids candy. Even though its edible, be careful not to get it in your eyes.

Dishwasher: If you have hard water build up on your dishes.
Run empty dish washer with 1T. citric acid in each dishwasher cups.
Then, for a few following loads, add one tablespoon to both cups along with your regular dishwasher detergent.
That will EASILY do the trick and you will be amazed. I continue to sprinkle a bit in with every load now and the hard water never builds up.
This is five huge pounds. It will last for a crazy long time.

Washing machine (top load): If you have a smelly washing machine that makes your clothes and towels smell funky...
Completely fill your machine with HOT water.
Throw in about 3-4 tablespoons of citric acid.
Run cycle for 2-3 minutes.
Stop cycle and let it set overnight (about 8-10 hours)
Turn machine back on to finish cycle.
Run a full load of towels with 1 tablespoon of citric acid only. NO detergent.
Run towels again with regular detergent.
This should clear things up. The hot water overnight cycle should be done approx once per month to prevent build-up.

Front load (HE):
I would suggest researching this. The same method as the top load will help, but front load machines can build up nastiness like crazy and need to be wiped and cleaned in different areas.

The added bonus is that Citric Acid can be used for other household cleaning projects and in baking and cooking.

As an added note, I have noticed that in some stores genuine TSP is also hard to find which could be used sparingly in a load of dishes. PHOSPHATE is the magic word and why our cleaning agents no longer clean as they used to. If you see (PF) next to a brand name on the package, it means Phosphate Free and why our clothes and dishes don't seem as clean before Phosphate was eliminated.

Product as expected. The bag in which the citric acid is shipped is clearly not for storage after opening the bag once - just use three zip-lock gallon bags to divide the contents into portions. I used it for the espresso machine, dishwasher etc for decalcification with great success (and we really have hard water). you will find a lot of recommendations on the internet.

Keep in mind citric acid is not the same as ascorbic acid, which is vitamin C. It can be used to preserve vitamin C in canned foods though. It can also be used to add a sour taste to food, in beverages, to buffer the effects of hard water in laundry to make soap work better. Any acid can buffer the effects of hard water though, white vinegar is a cheap route to go usually. But for clothes you don't want a vinegary smell.

Personally I use a small pinch in neti pot solutions. It enhances smells and seems to clean out my sinuses better when it's used. In 8 oz of water my recipe is a very small pinch of citric acid, 1/4 tsp of a no-additive salt, and 1tsp of xylitol.

Text:

Preparation information: Many sites I researched for this product said to mix 1.75C boiling water with 1C of mix in a bowl, cover, and let sit for 5 mins. However, THIS IS INCORRECT and results in runny beans. I contacted the good folks at Fantastic Foods and was forwarded preparation instructions which are as follows.

Pour 1.75C boiling water of 1 1/3C of mix in a bowl. Stir well, cover and let sit for 5 mins.

I haven't tried this ratio yet as I just received the email and wanted to post a review including the instructions since they all seem to be incorrect everywhere I look. Any detritus that may be mixed in with the flowers will sink to the bottom (though any stems will not - but then again, rosemary and thyme typically have some stems mixed in), so don't just dump it in the strainer. Glean the flowers from the top of the bowl.

Summary: I've tried them all, this is the best so far!
Text:
I'm a pretty serious tea drinker, and I've had all sorts of tea balls, strainers, teapots, etc. and been frustrated with most of them. So many are cute but not really functional. I bought a few of these "Ultimates" in a gift shop in England because they looked ideal, and brought them home for gifts. Soon I was down to my last one, and having used and loved it, I was loathe to part with it, even for a very good friend. =) I tried to get more through a friend in England but she couldn't find them.

Then, while visiting another friend in Illinois, we went to a tea shop that had great selection, and there was my infuser, along with many others! I had forgotten what it was called, which is what made it hard to find more, but now I've kept the box and made a special note of the name.

The long rambling story is just to convince you I'm not a casual user; I really believe in this infuser! The wide "handles" on top allow it to fit all cups except a really gigantic mug, the tea leaves are able to circulate freely within the roomy interior, the cover keeps your tea molecules contained as the tea steeps (just like a teapot) and instantly turns into a drip tray when you lift the infuser out of the cup (give it a quick swirl first), and it's a breeze to clean: just bang the leaves out into the wastebasket, turn it upside down under the faucet, and give it a quick rinse.

I've never had the problem of tea leaves sticking to the mesh folds, so I respectfully disagree with the previous reviewer's 3-star rating. I've wasted far more time trying to get tea leaves out of various other designs. My one remaining Ultimate does gradually get stained, but a short soak in a light bleach solution takes care of that (as I do when my teapots get stained).

This is the best infuser so far...after at least 20 years of tea drinking!

Summary: Works well, makes a nice bubbly drink
Text:
Basically it does just want it says. Get a juice, any 100% juice with more than the required amount of sugar per serving, drop in the powder, place the supplied air seal on the bottle, and wait two days. In return, you'll get a nice bubbly drink that tastes similar to mixing whatever juice you used with a hard cider. I used white grape, and probably should have picked a hardier variant. It would be a great drink for a party punch bowl (since it's relatively inexpensive per serving), or a hot summer day.

One thing to note, when you've reached the desired fermentation, remove the yeast from the bottom. If not, it will continue fermenting, even if you put it in the fridge. I did this by pouring the juice on the top into a pitcher, and leaving the sludge in the bottom of the juice bottle. Just wash it out, and put the juice back in, and you're set.

Also, be sure to keep the airlock on the bottle once it's in the fridge. Don't use the bottle cap! Since the yeast is still doing its job, if you use the bottle cap, pressure will cause an explosion.

EDIT: I found an even better way to work this stuff. Read on for good tips.

Buy TWO (or more) bottles of the same juice. Apple or peach grape are good options. Let one ferment out dry...takes about a week.

Then, pour about 75% out into a pitcher. Refill the original container with fresh juice. Put the vapor lock back on...you've created Batch #2.

Pour the pitcher of dry alcoholic juice into the new container (with 25% juice). Squeeze the bottle to remove the rest of the air. Re-install the lid. Wait 24-48 hours until the bottle is stiff again and then refrigerate. Drink and enjoy perfectly sweet/dry/carbonated spiked juice.

The advantages?

1. No worrying about how long it'll take to ferment. You can run your first bottle dry and then add the fresh juice right before the weekend to prime the carbonation. You can leave the first bottle with vapor lock in a finished fermentation state for days/weeks without issue.
2. You control the sweetness/dryness. Vary the mix ratio to suit your taste.
3. You control the carbonation. Adjust the refrigeration and/or vent carbonation to avoid overpressure. (Squeezing out all the air helps prevent oxidation).
4. You get cleaner drink. The yeast drops out of suspension and is left in the next batch.
5. YOU REUSE THE YEAST AND SAVE MONEY! Do this just once per batch and you cut your cost by 50%. Plus the next batch starts up quicker than if you'd pitched new yeast.

As a side note, this yeast is particularly well-suited for this task. I tried some white wine yeast once and it turned my apple juice into a STINKY ROTTEN EGG SULFUR BOMB! No kidding....the yeast got all stressed out and burped sulfur. Yuck. This yeast has never let me down in 10-20 batches.

Original Review:

Wow, this stuff is fun. Thankfully, it comes in double kits so you can experiment faster ( or make twice as much) without waiting.

Go grab a variety of 64oz 100% juice bottles from Trader Joes. I've tried pear cider and blackberry so far...and both worked great. Or save some money and get apple juice or peach grape from Walmart. Choose your poison.

Check it after 2 days. You'll probably want to go 3 or 4 days to get rid of a good amount of sugar and get enough alcohol. But check it daily after that, as the fermentation will be geometrically faster as the yeast multiply. After 4 days, you'll probably have a much drier taste...too dry for some.

I use a strainer to filter out the largest chunks of dead yeast, but they won't hurt you.

And I left the cap on in the fridge to have the residual yeast carbonate the drink. Yes, I was risking explosion, but it tastes MUCH better. And the cold temperature slows the fermentation...just check the bottle rigidity twice a day. If it's too stiff, HAVE A DRINK! The nice thing is, it'll repressurize itself a bit, unlike soda that goes flat after you open it.

Give it a try....you can't go wrong.

As long as you follow the instructions, you will have a great tasting, slightly alcoholic drink in a few days.  The longer you let it ferment, the drier the taste gets (less sugar). By day three it was still going strong producing CO2. I tasted it again. It was delicious. It reminded me of a wine cooler. Nice and fizzy like a sparkling wine. Summary: Spike your Juice and save money
Text: Setup is fool proof! In less than five minutes you are on your way to a delicious beverage. I used Welches White grape juice which tastes kind of like a cheap Moscado. Where was this before I turned 21? Oh, popular in Europe. You buy your juice (64 oz. juice with 20+ grams of sugar, filtered, no artificial sweeteners), add a packet (you get 6 packs), attach the included airlock (I used vodka instead of water to prevent insects) and wait at least two days. I waited longer to try to get to the 14% alcohol limit it says it can get. It tastes like a lightly carbonated juice, think champagne. They recommend using grape, cranberry and/or pomegranate. I don't if it would or would not work with orange juice, but it would taste like a mimosa if it did. I would and have recommended this, for the novelty of it alone. It was nice that it came with an airlock, if you want more Amazon sells them, or you can make your own like I did. It really tastes pretty good and it was so easy you couldn't over complicate this/screw up if you tried.

This stuff works great- and you can control the alcohol content and dryness.

The longer you brew the higher the alcohol content will get, and at the same time your juice will get dryer from the lack of sugars. So if you want a higher alcohol content but want it to stay sweeter then just add about 1/2 cup of sugar to the juice beforehand, shake it up real good, then add the mix and brew it for a day or two longer than the initial 24 hours. The taste of your brew can change pretty dramatically from day to day so taste test it as you go along.

Also make sure to remove about 1/2 cup of the juice from the bottle before you brew- this will prevent spillover and problems when you push the rubber cap onto the bottle.

I work graveyard shifts, so I often need a boost of energy, but many energy drinks taste to me like a spoonful of sugar and the can they came in. Not this one, which actually tastes like a cherry soda. Its pleasing flavor goes down smoothly when I need quick power, and it doesn't leave an aftertaste like Full Throttle or Red Bull do. I could almost drink this like an ordinary beverage.

The power lasts long enough to get me through nearly my entire shift. Since it's carb-based, the power does run out, but late enough that I can coast on momentum. This stuff lasts way longer than those energy shots, which peter out before my lunch break. It's also fairly inexpensive for an energy drink. Too many such beverages cost a small fortune, and I'd practically have to take out a second mortgage to power through my shift.

So we have the trifecta: pleasing, powerful, and affordable. Consume with caution, since these things can have long-term depleting effects if overused. But if you need an occasional boost of power that doesn't taste harsh or acidic, and you want it at a modest price, this is your stuff right here.

Here I sit in the home of Starbucks, and while TAZO is okay, but's not the same. THIS is tea!

I do drink my tea in the English/Irish/Scots manner, which is to say, with milk, 95% of the time. A strong cuppa in the morning, and continally through the day, in my insulated STARBUCKS 16 oz mug! LOL. PG Tips is the only tea to stand up to the pace. Most of the so-called TEA in the US is what folks from the true tea-drinking countries call "floor sweepings", which is to say, the "tea" that is left, after the real tea is made into packets and bags... it's little crumbs and dust, which is why we get it in thick tea bags, nothing else would hold these little dregs.

I am so happy to see it here! The nearest British importer charges $22 plus shipping for the same size box. I am happy! BUY this tea! You will love it. Text: First of all, the palak paneer we're served in Indian restaurants in USA doesn't taste half as delicious as that served in restaurants in India.
