When I went to visit my boyfriend in Boston and he had a few large assorted bags of Terra Chips left over from a function at work. I have always liked the mixed Terra Chips but when I grabbed the bag of these it was love at first bite!

I was not aware that these are not salted until I had eaten half of the bag and decided to check out the ingredients. I am a salt fan and on a high salt diet so I was especially shocked to realize that I had not noticed the missing salt.

Within 24 hours the bag was gone and he had no opportunity to sample even one chip! He also hates beets but will eat them in this form. So, I figure a fried beet beats no beet at all!!

I also love that I don't feel guilty indulging in these as some of the other snack foods I eat are questionable in nature. So I keep these on hand and the other snacks drop by the wayside. These are my 'go to' snack now. The price here is also excellent as I'd pay a great deal more at the store per bag. They always arrive fresh and in very good condition.

Thanks Terra and Amazon!

Summary: Delicious and arrived with not a single broken chip!
Text: Thank you for these wonderful chips at a great price!  They arrived in perfect condition.  Although the box was a little smashed, the chips were pristine condition!
This is one of my favorite snacks of all.  They are very delicious and have vitamins as with eating sweet potatoes other ways.

The second dozen bags seemed to be a little less spicey.  I rather like the spice!  I know sweet potatoes are healthier than white/red potatoes. I'm eager to see their new Parsnip Chips!  I love parsnips. (FYI parsnips are offered in Terra's mixed veggie bag, but I avoid high-iodine content items like beets... not sure if I might be allergic to some of those other veggies like taro.. not willing to test!)
My case of Terra spicy sweet potato chips arrived perfectly! Speedy shipment, perfect packing, wonderful product!  5 stars all around!

Summary: Chips are GREAT...product expiration date too soon though...
Text: These are my FAVORITE chips in the world!  That's why I ordered a case, but I was disappointed that the expiration date is mid-Nov...just 8-10 wks after receiving them.  WAY too soon to eat 12 bags!
Sweet and spicy, great for those on low glycemic or SugarBusters diets where potato and corn chips aren't allowed.

I like sweet potato fries, and so I wanted to try these chips.  They're spicey, and if you like a spicey chip, then you should try these.  I like spicey foods, but I was a little disappointed in not being able to really taste the sweet potato.  This chip was given a high rating by CENTER FOR SCIENCE IN THE PUBLIC INTEREST'S Nutrition Action Newsletter.  I'm going to try the plain sweet potato chips.  I give ten stars to Amazon's packaging.  With packaging and fast delivery, who needs to go to the grocery store for chips?
These chips are dangerously addicting!  They're great, but I probably won't buy any more--can't keep out of 'em!

Summary: Open Bags on arrival !! Check every one!
Text:
7 out of the 12 bags were completely open on the BOTTOM. Taking out the first bag, it was not damaged and I didn't see the issue until I pulled out the second bag. Over half of this purchase is completely unusable and of course, unreturnable. The oil from the bags also seeped through the cardboard box...

This is a good product, don't get me wrong, or I wouldn't have purchased 12 bags at one time. But be very very careful and check every bag when the box arrives. I don't agree with rating products poorly for bad shipping, but this wasn't bad shipping. The bags never look like they sealed, but they might have popped open. The cardboard box they all came in was not damaged in any way, so this looks like a product packaging flaw.

I will purchase these from the store in the future where I can check the bag, but never again online.

I thought I tried something different rather than just plain old potato chips.  The cumin flavor was very strong in one bag while another bag was light in cumin (and better for my taste buds).  The flavor was just too overwhelming for me.  I would not buy this product again.

I've bought these chips before at Costco and I really liked them. Saw them on Amazon and thought I'd give them a try. Too long on the shelf! These chips were stale! Too bad because they are good when fresh.

Summary: Usually good but not happy with this deal
Text: I buy these in the store and they are usually delicious. I was looking for an economic alternative to purchasing this product. This would be a good deal if the bags did not expire next month and in the two bags that have been opened so far, the chips are over cooked. They are still okay, but not as good as I have had in the past. So overal I am disappointed with this purchase.

Summary: Simply awesome sprinkled with Celtic sea salt!
Text:
Fantastic taste, great price, and a healthy snack that even your kids will enjoy!
We have tried both the Krinkle Cut chips and the Sweets & Beets, and the Krinkle Cut seem to have a better taste. We like to sprinkle a generous amount of mineral-rich Celtic sea salt in the bag and shake it up - what a delicious treat!
Our local health food store sells these chips for nearly double what Amazon charges for the Subscribe & Save price, so this is a great deal!

Summary: stale chips , and lots of them
Text: the item was ordered on august 2nd, arrived on the 11th with a best by date of august 30th!! i had ordered to stock up on a healthy snack but instead got a case of chips that are already stale , and tasteless. amazon made it right but i am disappointed to receive old product. I imagine these would taste great if they were fresh!!
I bought these for my husband. He thought they were plain. I didn't like the taste at all. The spiced sweet potato ones are better, but my husband who loves sweet potatoes didn't like them at all.

I've had sweet potato fries before, and they really are delicious where I had them, so I wanted to give these a shot. From the first bite I'm pretty sure I got a hilarious look of astonishment on my face. It's like nothing I ever tasted before--weird, but quite good, which is about how I felt when I first bit into a properly ripe mango. Definitely the spices are unique when balanced with the sweet potato flavor. I think I tasted some garlic, but I know there's a very faint smidgeon of cayenne, and the cilantro was noticeable as well, but no one flavor or spice overwhelms the others, which is good.

If you like any sort of spiced potato chips, like mesquite barbecue or jalapeno or the buffalo ranch doritos, I'd give these babies a try. They're healthy and you might find a nice occasional alternative to the not-so-healthy stuff. Hey, if it tastes good, why not? One thing these chips prove is that not all "health food" has to taste bland or nasty. Sort of like spelt bread and Newman's ginger cookies, and Izze's luscious pear soda. Terra's spiced sweet potato chips have a surprising flavor and are probably not for everyone, but if you like the spicy kind of regular chips, pick up a bag of these somewhere--they'll probably be just your sort of thing.
Wow way too salty for my taste. They really need to cut back on it or just do it natural without salt.

These are very good!!  The only thing I don't like is the fat content plus they are a little pricey.  I feel like I shouldn't eat as many as I would like to, because you certainly have to eat more than one!  Delicious.

Great taste. But why do they insist on saving money using safflower oil instead of canola oil. They say may contain 'canola or safflower or...etc'. But they always contain the cheap oils that I'm allergic to. I'd be a frequent flyer on these chips if they'd just do them so I won't get sick.
I love these chips - rather have more beets than sweets.  Hard to find in my rural area - but do love them.  I wonder if they will ever make just one of beets !
These chips have a great sweet taste, I do not feel they need salt especially if you eat them with salsa. Paste salsa works good for me.
My 3 year old with autism loves these.  They are GFCF and soy free, egg free too.

This is a very tasty, fun-to-eat snack with an impressive beta carotene content.

I am a supplement "junkie", popping more vitamin pills than you want to hear about. Even so, I will be the first one to admit that there is probably nothing quite as good as the "real thing", meaning nutrition in a whole food source.

I cannot prove it, but I could swear that my eyesight is a little sharper when I consume these chips on a regular basis.

Thanks Terra, for making a product that is both healthy and fun to eat.
The product was pretty good but, they forgot to mention that there was no salt added. It was a bit of info I would have liked to know. THe price was right and delivery great.

Summary: Way over-cooked. Some chips look like carbon!
Text:
I do NOT understand why they have to fry/bake for so long?? If they were not so over cooked, I would love it. Too bad!

So far, I only opened one bag, I hope not ALL 12 bags are like this, although they may very well be since they must have been made and bagged together. I will have to complain to the manufacturer if that is the case!

If you are looking for a healthier alternative to a potato chip with the same taste, LOOK FURTHER!! These chips taste COMPLETELY different than a white potato chip.  I was definitely surprised when biting into this chip--it tastes saltless and almost bitter! Tastes a little like fried plantain bananas--definitely not on my top ten list of favorite snack food!
I do not like the chips! They are not to my liking and I do not think I will order them again even though I like sweet potato!

I think this product has been in existence since time began, or so it seems.  But, when you get it right and even improve the product like Kraft has done here with the addition of Romano cheese, well, if you don't buy it, you're missing out.  I use this cheese in particular with a garlic/cheese roll recipe that is outstanding, but it's also superb on everyday pasta recipes.  The clumping is minimal, it's ALWAYS real cheese (not so in the store-brand varieties), and it's made by Kraft.  Great stuff, been using this one for years, highly recommend!

What can I say? Unless you want to hand grate your own Parmesan, this is the best product out there. But I wouldn't spend more than about $8 on it (that's about the grocery store price), and then only through Amazon Prime. On grocery items in particular, Amazon Marketplace vendors wait for the Prime supplies to run out and then become the featured vendor on the product page. But their prices are typically grossly inflated. So if you want to avoid the gouging, hold out for an Amazon Prime purchase only.

Personally, I prefer grating my own cheese right before pasta dinners, but this product makes for a nice condiment at the table or when you don't have a block of fresh cheese to grate. The flavor is pretty nice, goes nicely with spaghetti sauce or as an garnish to other things like chicken.
Great with homemade spaghetti and to use in other things I make like meat loaves or Salmon patties or loaf

I bought this because the price was so cheap here at Amazon and the "100% Real Cheese" claim. I wasn't sure what the difference would be in the flavor with the addition of the Romano. Luckily, it still tastes great and I can't really tell a difference from just regular Parmesan. I have had no complaints from the kids/teens or the hubby.

These are nice larger size containers too, so they last longer in my family of 5. The price here at Amazon is really great too! Parmesan is pretty pricey at the grocery store for such a little container of condiment. Here, I get 2 containers for the price of one AND it's delivered to me free. Can't beat that!
i live in alaska and it is very hard to find in the stores here. Great price and received product on time. i will be ordering again soon

Summary: How does this grate on ya ?
Text: Hi, This cheese in a can is terific ! I would certainly recommend it.It arrived quickly and the cost was quite reasonable!

Now I can have Parmesan/Romano Cheese on hand for whatever. Rural grocery store does not carry it so I usually have to wait until the end of the month to shop for it in a bigger store. Then if I forget, I'm stuck without it until I can get back to the bigger store. With Amazon I can have it in a few days and it's also cheaper than the store. Great.
When you have someone who doesn't like the fresh cheese (KIDS) this is great.  I use it mostly for a recipe for cheese bread, therefore this was a good deal.

Summary: Something is weird with the pricing on this
Text: Something is strange with either the pricing or quantity of this item. Two 8 oz packages of this item are about three dollars and fifty cents at any supermarket. Not sure why Amazon thinks you will pay almost eight dollars per canister for this item. Even with the subscribe and save option it's still being sold for almost twice what you'd pay in a regular supermarket. Compare prices & know what you're buying!

This was a gift for my girlfriend; honestly I never imagined what these would taste like. I was instantly hooked..She has to watch me (from eating all of them). Thank you..They were perfect for Christmas!

I bought some of these mints in Paris in October and I was delighted to learn I could order them through amazon.com -- even at double the price.

I was also delighted that I received my order within three days. I was not so delighted to see that three of the six boxes of mints said "Best by March 2011" when I did not even order them until December 2011.

The date probably doesn't matter much on mints but buyers should beware of this happening to them

Summary: Check product date when you get it
Text: This is a very good cereal (hence the five-star rating), but twice I received boxes from Amazon either too close to or past the "best by" date stamped on the top flap. When I received a pack of six boxes three weeks PAST the "best by" date, I complained to Amazon. A rep quickly responded with an e-mailed apology and said Amazon would credit my credit card for the purchase price. (Foodstuffs cannot be returned for health reasons, of course.) I realize the "best by" date is not an expiration, but it takes me weeks to consume 6 boxes of cereal, so I want the freshest product possible.

Summary: Perfect blend of taste and nutrition
Text: One of my favorite cereals! Not too sweet nor too bland. Love the crunch of the flakes, granola, and the bran! Something unique and different from usual bran flake cereal. Nutritious with whole grains and low in fat. Very filling too!

Summary: I've enjoyed this cereal for months
Text:
I have been eating this cereal for perhaps a year now, though I am not sure of that. What I am sure of is that it tastes wonderful to me. And the weighed down feeling I got from the previous cereal I ate does not happen with this one. Perhaps that has something to do with the difference between nonorganic and organic. If organic and good tasting are what you are looking for, this cereal may be a good one to try.

As for me, I am going to try soaking oats with whey. I heard it is even more healthy and has been used by groups of people in times passed.

Summary: It's the only thing that works
Text: I am pregnant and suffer from the dreaded "slowing of the bowels". Once I started eating this cereal every morning, my life and bowels perked up. Seriously. This is magic. I add fresh fruit and only prepare it with soy milk - but it is a super tasty and just really good cereal. I am a huge fan of Cascadian Farms generally, and this is a lifesaver. For real.
Excellent taste.  High fiber.  Organic whole grains.  Not too sweet.  Stays crunchy in the bowl.  Why aren't more cereals as good as this???

Does anybody else think Hearty Morning doesn't taste as good as it used to?  I wonder why they changed the flavor of the cereal we loved so much?  Now it taste like cardboard.  I tried adding honey this morning and it seemed to help.  I hope they change back to the old formula soon.
This Organic cereal is so healthy for you and it tastes sooo good as well. I love it! You won't be disappointed, give it a try :-)
very filling, great taste, I love it with non-sweetened Silk. it is cheaper on amazon than in the grocery store.

Summary: Cascadian Farms Hearty Morning A Favorite
Text: My husband eats Cascadian Farms Cereal Hearty Morning every morning and is a favorite. He will mix it with his yogurt and add fruit. A healthy breakfast. I hope Amazon will continue to carry this product. Amazon is the best place to shop for groceries and other items.
Really good and great value. I wish Amazon will sell it again. It is very very delicious and it's also organic!

I wasn't sure what to expect this cereal to be like since sometimes healthy cereals can be less than tasty, or bad in milk.  This one is quite good.  It's sweet enough that you don't feel like to need add unhealthy sugar & it's not so sweet that you feel like it's sugar coated.  It also holds up well in milk as long as you don't leave it set.

We are really enjoying this cereal. We ordered enough
for a month but looks like we are going through it
very quickly and will have to order more.

This is the only cereal my husband will eat and we love the subscribe and save since the prices can vary so much at the supermarket.  The cereal is organic so no yucky pesticides or genetically modified ingredients. The kids love it too!

This is the only way to shop for groceries. I wish Amazon had more products available online. No need to drive to Costco, look for parking and stand in line. With prime membership its cheaper, and fast!

Everything in this ad leads you to believe that you are ordering the entire box of bully sticks. It pictures the entire box in the ad and the "list" price as being $240.09, so you think you are ordering the entire box. (I doubt anyone would pay $240.09 for ONE bully stick) However, ONE bully stick is ALL you get. Also, it is the smelliest bully stick I ever come across. I will say my dogs love it but I will NEVER order from PetFoodDirect again!!

So happy with this. Came as promised and we got a full box.Not like other dealers that show a box but give just one. My dog loves this treat and I able to give the others away as treats for all of my friends. a great deal and a great product

My dog loves these treats, they are great for her puppy teeth and after careful review Amazon had the best price on the web. I was paying $6.00 each for them in my pet store!Cadet Gourmet Braided Bully Stick Natural Dog Chew Treat

I have been using the San Marzano tomatoes for many, many years; usually purchased from a specialty grocery store.  When I saw them offered on Amazon, I ordered them immediately. They came very quickly, but 3 cans were badly damaged so I notified Amazon.  They sent another box of 6 and again 3 were dented, 1 very badly.  I sent back all 6 damaged cans and kept 6.  Of the 6 that I kept, 4 are dented, slightly.  I complained about the poor packaging, but they when they mailed the replacement package, they used the same flimsy packaging.

BASED ON an Amazon customer's valid comment today, I'm AMENDING THIS REVIEW to encourage readers to consider that it has been a long time since I wrote the review and that it could have merely been a bad batch for that month. I'll place an order with every confidence that the tomatoes will be of high quality. Indeed, it was never my intention to be unfair to the manufacturer.
____________________

Briefly put, the tomatoes that should have a sweet, mellow taste instead have a "tin-can" taste. Was mine an isolated case? The company alone will have to answer that question. I'm only advising potential buyers to exercise caution. The product is produced in Italy, by the way, with home-grown tomatoes, so they should have tasted wonderful.
Fast shipping and exceptional pricing-less than my specialty store in town!  I made a wonderful Italian sauce with this product, and will buy it again.

The product was delivered promptly in good condition and the Tomatoes are very tasty. They are great for making spaghetti sauce; much better than any american brand with the massive amounts of sodium.

Surprised that 3 inner cans in the case package were badly dented. Amazon outer packaging appeared excellent. Suspect the cans were dented before packaged for our shipment. Wife likes the tomatoes and price.
They are some of the best tomatoes out there,nice and sweet not bitter,less seeds too,being italian there the san marzano tomatoes out there.

Summary: Good, but NOT San Marzano Tomatoes
Text: Just got these in this week and made a fantastic ragu out of these puppies.  As I said in the title, they are very good italian plum tomatoes (says on the label), but the are San Marzano "BRAND" Tomatoes.  They cleverly put the words "brand" in a blue font, so it will blend in with the blue background and not be noticeable.  They're actually good enough for me to want to buy them again, but just wanted everyone to know so you don't feel like you've been duped.  Hope this helps. BTW, giving them 3 stars just for trying to pull a fast one, but would have rate 4-5 based on taste of the product alone.
After all of the hype and anticipation these were a real let down. Average taste and expensive...I will go back to Costco for my imported canned tomatoes at 1/4 the cost!
This is our favorite tomato product: works great in sauces.  Unlike other reviewers, I had no problems with the packaging or dented cans. The 6-pack was well packed in multiple layers of bubble wrap.

These tomatoes are very good for the price. They are not as sweet as some Marzanos I've tried, but were firm with good flavor. Also, the container was packed full and the sauce is thicker than most.
You absolutely get your money's worth with these tomatoes, and I will buy them again as they are good and within my budget. You don't realize the difference in canned tomatoes until you try something much better than you're used to using (like these). If you use canned tomatoes in your recipes, give these a try!

Two of the six cans I received were dented - from the inside, not the packaging, so they were evidently packed that way. But, there was no problem with the tomatoes inside them.

I tasted every can and did not detect any "tinny" flavor. They tasted great and made excellent marinara and bolognese sauces.

It's a great price for San Marzanos delivered to your door. I rated it a 4 because of the dented cans - cosmetics. Otherwise they are a good value and I'll reorder soon.

These little hard candies are quickly becomming my all time favorite.  The flavor of ginger is strong and it packs a punch.  Perfect after dinner mint which is how I discovered them. They are given away at a very popular Italian Restaraunt in Downtown Miami.  The KC Candy website says they are made from natural ginger so I'm assuming it's the same way I make ginger syrup at home.
Most individuals might compare these candies to cough drops, heavy on the ginger and lite on mint. If you enjoy ginger, these hard candies will satisfy.

This hard candy definitely tastes like ginger and even has that ginger hotness. I love the balance of sweet and spicy. This is my favorite hard candy ever. I think because it packs so much flavor, I only need one or two and Im satisfied.

We know the whole pink salt story. If you don't, just google it. We are using it mainly because it's supposed to be better for you health-wise. We both like salt and this seemed like a reasonable deal. There isn't much difference in the taste... cleaner and you have to use less I'd say. The salt isn't quite as fine as we expected... a bit many grained size, but they all come out of the salt shaker well. We found out that our local upscale grocery store carries it in bulk, but it's "rock salt" size. We've bought a Bodum grinder that grinds both pepper and salt for when the salt we have now runs out. The Bodum is great and they sell it on Amazon...
P.S. Fairie's Finest had the best prices for both the pink salt and Red Hawaiian sea salt...

I could not find the large containers of McCormick spices anywhere, tried Sam's , Costco, no  luck.  Happily I found this on Amazon (what can't you buy on Amazon).  Now I know I can continue to order my spices  through Amazon.  How lucky are we!!!!  The price was fair and was shipped in a timely fashion, although I do have Prime...lucky me!!!!

Summary: Wish I would have read the reviews first
Text: I bought this mix because it looked really good on the box. I am a huge baker and I wanted to try something new. I waited for Valentine's Day to make it for my family and I do not think they are going to want to eat it. I followed the directions and it looked nothing like the picture. I ended up frosting it with chocolate frosting to see if it would help. It was ok but I will never buy this mix again and do not recommend it. I might just have to bake something else for my family for Valentine's day.

I have baked MANY cakes over the years. I've never had a problem until now. This cake definitely did not live up to expectations. I followed the directions exactly for baking in a bundt pan. I waited the recommended time to remove from the bundt pan. When I lifted the pan off, the cake had broken into many pieces. It was a mess. Maybe if baked in a regular pan, where it didn't need to be removed until serving, it would be OK. But, it definitely was not OK using a bundt pan. It was such a mess I had to throw the cake away.

My wife wanted me to bake her birthday cake this year.  I've done it successfully before.  The cake was moist and yet had a delicate texture.  The problem was the taste.  It wasn't sweet and it didn't taste like chocolate at all.  My wife looked at me and said, "does the cake taste funny to you".  No one came back for seconds and it's the first time I threw a cake out.  I won't try this again--unfortunately I have one box left.  I'd give it to the Food Bank if I thought I was doing them a favor.

This mix was very moist when made into cupcakes! I recommend this mix. I don't understand why there were negative feedbacks among the better bakers. I am a below average baker and had success with this mix! Hard to find in local stores though...

Summary: Great Cake Mix....Not sure why so many negative reviews
Text: I'm not a professional baker or anything so I guess my perspective is a little different but I love this cake mix. I was attracted to the package (naturally) and decided to try it. I have never enjoyed a cake out of a box so much....especially when its re-heated in the microwave and eaten in a cup with vanilla ice cream. Made it for a couple of parties and thanksgiving and people couldn't stop asking for seconds. It takes longer to bake than it says on the directions and I used a regular 8 or 9 inch circular pan....I did notice that it didn't rise as much as I would have expected. I thought it odd the first time but then I tasted it and couldn't stay angry at the cake for long :). My advice: try it....its only a dollar or so more than the $.99 options and you just might like it.

I have baked cakes quite a few times, but this was the first one which has a separate real fudge and chunks mix too. I am quite surprised at the reviews given by others. I am pretty sure its just because they could not end up mixing it properly. I have followed every instruction with exact time to mix and cook. My friends have loved the cake and it was finished in no time. So, if you are good at baking cakes (even otherwise, follow the instructions exactly and your effort will not be wasted), definitely try this one. Also, you need not wait for the entire cake to become solid hard inside the oven. I did not bake it for more than 35minutes, watching it every 5minutes after the first 20minutes. I turned the oven off when the cake seemed a little soft and left it out for 20minutes (you can leave it inside the oven after turning it off) and it came out so soft and tasty!

Summary: Don't waste your time, oil, eggs or money!!!
Text:
Typically, if I leave a negative review for any product, I still recommend others trying it, since they may like it, and I always state so, in my review. However, NOT this time!

Like the previous reviewer, my cake stuck horribly to the pan, and I used a flat, round pan. I not only oiled my pan, but floured it thoroughly, as well. Any other time I bake a cake, I always, always use this method: Oil & flour. The cakes always pop right out of the pan, with no problem. NOT this time! This was a complete mess!

Even edging with a knife didn't help! So, I would actually not recommend this at all. If this is a new product, I guarantee in one year, it will be a forgotten, discontinued product, because that's what you will want to do, once you try this: Forget it, and never use it again!

But, because I like to be fair, I do love Duncan Hines. They do have some great products, just not this one. This was a miss. Additionally, I figured that even though the cake stuck horribly to the pan, maybe it would taste good and that would suffice. Not this time! This cake, on a scale from 1-5, taste wise, would honestly be a 3, if that. It's just ok.

So, my take is: Don't waste your time. Like myself and the previous reviewer, you will most likely find yourself in the same situation: A stuck mess, that is worthy of file 13 - the trash!!!

And, by the way, the picture on the box, looks nothing at all, like what you end up with. The picture has glaze on the top. Not so with this recipe, unless you buy it, or make it! That, in and of itself, is misleading. They don't include a glaze packet, therefore, they should not represent such, on their packaging!

Beth

I bought this product and am sorry I did.  I tried one can and it was nothing like coconut milk I have used in the past.  There is a hard, greasy 1 inch glob at the top of the can and the rest is clear water.  It has no flavor and doesn't even resemble coconut milk.  If I want to return it, I have to pay the shipping and a 15% restock charge. Not sure it's worth it.  May donate to the Food Bank.

Terra Kettles Cut Blend Potato Chips, Sea Salt, 2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24) While these chips are crisp, they feel and taste too oily for me. The per serving fat listed online is 6g while the bag lists it at 10g. Since the bag contains 2 servings, that would be 20g per 2 oz bag. They are packaged in stronger material than other chips I have tried.

Summary: The "salt and pepper" chips bite back!
Text: These are really good, but whoa! there's no missing the pepper. Forget the kids' lunchbox, save these for yourself, and keep a glass of water nearby.

Considering that many of the Terra chips are healthier versions of snack foods, it was surprising that these chips were so oily. They have more oil listed on the package than what Amazon actually stated when I bought them. I was disappointed in the overall crunch of these chips. They are a bit too thick to be a true kettle chip and though crunchy, it isn't quite what I expected. They aren't bad, just not really as advertised. Those who like a thick, nearly unsalted chip will enjoy these.

Summary: Terra Kettles sea salt krinkle cut potato chips
Text: I was disappointed, the chips were very oily and tasted and smelled rancid....Since they are supposedly high end snacks they do not live up to their billing.

I really like these chips! They are nice and crunchy. They are not oversalted (to my taste, anyhow). I think that the taste is richer than standard potato chips. Take a look at the "nutrition facts" on the back. One is not overdosing on salt here (one serving=5% of daily value). Saturated fat is 5%. Compare with Wise's standard potato chips: 7% salt and 15% saturated fat.

All in all, a rich taste and perhaps a bit better fotr you than other standard brands.

I received these chips yesterday and they are horrible. They are very stale-tasting and also very oily. The date printed on the bags is Sep 9th and therefore this is the way that they are supposed to taste BEFORE they are expired, which is very disappointing. I called Amazon right away and was given a refund.

These potato chips are extremely tasty and well liked by our team. Crisp and not too salty. Has a tendency to have breakage into small pieces but they are like eating potato sticks (so there is no waste).

I don't know if it's the sea salt or what, but you can actually taste the potato in these chips.  The chips are not greasy, and they're nice and thick.  And knowing that they're a much healthier choice than other brands, is important to me.  But even if they're a healthier choice, we would not purchase them unless they tasted great.  And these are great! And with AMAZON'S packaging and fast delivery, I definitely will be ordering most of my chips here.

These chips are great.  Strangely enough I was a bit overwhelmed by the fact that they have a strong actual potato taste.  Though of course that's a good thing in chips, but I have never tasted any other chips like these. You simply can not compare these to chips like Lay's or other national brands.  They are just salt and pepper and potato.  You don't taste grease or manufactured flavors.  They are crispy, but NOT hard to chew or too crunchy.  totally perfect.  Buy them, but be prepared to eat way too much.  Though one complaint that I didn't have - someone who tried them wished they had more pepper.  But I think they are perfect as is.

Summary: You can taste the different potatoes!
Text: I was initially afraid that I'd been sent the wrong product as the shipping box seemed to be for the variety veggie chips, but once I looked carefully I saw that the UPC label had the right product name. At any rate, the best thing about these chips is that they actually have a potato taste and each type of potato is a bit different. Very good crunch. And the blue chips make them really fun to serve at a party. Kids love them! Great product. We'll likely get them again.

I bought a case of these chips and found three bags had small holes in them at the bottom seams (just big enough for air and/or a bug to get in).  So,I had to throw them out.  And, many of the chips were broken up and many seemed burnt or way overcooked.  I think I'll stick to the supermarket bags next time.
Satisfyingly crunchy and holds up to dips well. But it's a bit greasier than I expected. Let's hope Terra can in the future make their chips with a less oily texture.

WONDERFUL. ONLY PROBLEM IS - CAN'T STOP EATING THEM.

CAN'T WAIT UNTIL YOU HAVE ANOTHER PROMO

I purchased this item (24 bags). This was my mistake. I normally don't eat chips except when I am close to my period phase. When this order arrived, I ate one bag each day until I came down to 5 bags. I realized what I have done.

However, it was yummy and no trans fat. More healthy than most brands.

Now I know, I can only order a bag, not 24 bags next time. :)
Having a case of potato chips come to your door!  What could be greater!  Fast service; great product.

Summary: Great chips, but I prefer the bag with the blue chips included
Text: Take them to your grocer and exchange these for the bag that also has the blue chips with the other chips.

The chips are so-so.  For me a package when opened must pass the smell test - these didn't.  When ordering a case (12 bags) I assumed they would be shipped in a factory packed box.  Not so.  They were repackaged by Amazon in a box designed for ten bags.  The case consisted of 12 bags.  No problem for the packer as he just squeezed in the two extra bags.  You can imagine what that does to potato chips.  I now have 6 bags of whole chips and 6 bags of chip pieces which can be eaten with a spoon.

I have tasted several brands of barley tea.  All of the following were cold brewed, including the one I bought here.  One of them was a gift from Japan and wasn't roasted, so it wasn't bitter at all.  One of them was roasted and VERY bitter.  Another one was a mixture of lightly and deeply roasted and tasted okay (not very bitter).  This one I am reviewing however, is excellent in taste.  It isn't bitter at all, even after cold brewing for several days.  The package says it is gently roasted in small quantities.  That, plus the fact that it is organic, I believe is the reason it doesn't have the bitter taste.  If you don't like bitter drinks and want to drink barely tea, this is a great choice.

I started eating Arame about two years ago and it is my favorite sea vegetable. Filled with minerals and it doesn't have a salty taste. I add it to my stir-fry dishes or just make a seaweed salad. Emerald Cove puts out a quality product. Amazon sells it for less than I can find it in any health food store in my vicinity.
I love it.  This is my first time buying seaweed and it's great!  I just need to get some organic miso soup ingredients to make my own.
It's not my favorite seaweed, but it's OK, it looks kind of like spaghetti, I sometimes just add water and it softens up nicely.

I have been drinking this tea for some time. I happen to like Chamomile teas they are very a mild, I do not like teas that are to strong. One bag is enough or me I can put it in a cup of hot water and leave the bag in without worrying if it was to get too strong like other teas do. Adding just a little raw honey enhances the flavor also.
I enjoy this tea before I go to bed and it has a very soothing and the warmth of the liquid allows me to slip into a nice sleep.

I like the convenience of a foil package, I can carry one or two with me when I go out to lunch with friends, I just order a cup of hot water and slip this tea into it.
I have on occasion I have put this is a cup with some fresh ginger and it makes a totally different tea, and he ginger helps sooth the tummy while the Chamomile tends to relax you.
Doesn't get much better than this.

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.

Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile. I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.

I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.

Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.

If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.

Summary: The BEST "mango in a container" product ever!
Text:
Item arrived quickly and frozen on dry ice. After sampling a thawed container, I have to say this is the best canned mango product I've tried. It was very sweet like a fresh mango should taste....NOT like the typical flavorless mango mush in heavy syrup. This would be good for anything requiring mangos from a fruit smoothie to mango nut bread to mango wine. I've got 6 gallons of mango wine going and so far so good!

I also contacted The Perfect Puree's customer service before ordering and they provided me with the information I needed on sugar content.

Will definitely buy more and possibly try some of the other purees they sell.

I stumbled on this company which produces wonderful fruit purees for both commercial and home kitchens.  They are not cheap - but superb quality.  Take a look at their website (and no I don't get a commision)

Summary: Ajika Dried Prickly Ash or Sichuan Pepper or Chinese Pepper, Japanese Sansho, 2-Ounce
Text:
Ajika Dried Prickly Ash or Sichuan Pepper 2ounces is amazing and has a wonderful smell to it and wondeful Sichuan Pepper taste to it. I am looking forward to using it in many of my recipes. So, yes, I would buy this product again. Wonderfullly fresh and ready to use.

The next thing I have to mention is that Amazon.com and it's sellers do a wonderful job of replacing any broken open container that come accidently opened in shipping. My last shipment had some problems with a the Contianer of Pepper being broken and was all over the bottom of the shipping box. I immediately notified the seller and they immediately sent me a brand new Container of Ajika Dried Prickly Ash or Sichuan Pepper 2 ounces to replace the bad one. I was amazed at the service and will continued to buy from Amazon, because of their wonderful service. So, both the Ajika Dired Prickly Ash or Sichuan Pepper and the Customer Services that quickly replaced my broken container of pepper deserves 5 healthy stars each. Which would give them 10 stars in my book. Thank you and yes, I will continue buying from Amazon, because of their wonderful quick service.

I just thought I should mention that here also. So, yes, I will buy this product again.

Thank you for the shipment of the Saf-T-Pops to replace the order that I previously had - it was a very nice and unexpected surprise.
This batch is much better where the wrapper doesn't stick to the candy.

Just another reason for me to keep using your service - it's much appreciated!

In the product description it says you will receive 24/5.5 ounce cans of cat food. When received in the mail I received ONE can of cat food. It also says shipping weight is 10 pounds and turned out to be under one pound. They have false advertising! No wonder this turns out to be so cheap.

I usually buy Hellman's but thought I would go this route for the price; I'm glad I did. It has a fresh salty, spicy and vinegar taste and I use it in my tuna salad with lettuce and tomato and my other spices and my neighbors knock on my door to make this for them.

Sprecher is amazing. one of the best. but, the Orange Dream is kinda iffy. the taste is great, kinda creamy, very orange, but still very soda and not some kind of hybrid drink. The thing that makes it a 3 and not a 5, is the HORRIBLE aftertaste. To me, the aftertaste is similar to that of burnt popcorn. and its STRONG, almost as strong as the initial taste of the soda. We got 2 4-packs, and both me and another person agreed it has a strong "burnt food" aftertaste. I am drinking the last bottle of the first 4-pack and will begin on the second 4-pack tomorrow. if those 4 do nto have the nasty aftertaste, or if it is lesser, i will edit this review to note that the first 4-pack was from a bad batch. Overall, great soda if the aftertaste doesnt bother you much. Helps to be eating something with the soda so you can kill the aftertaste

EDIT. ok, second batch. same aftertaste... its possible its a big bad batch and both 4-packs were from the same batch. so, i wont lower the review score any more than it is. its a good soda with a horrible aftertaste that MIGHT not be in all of the bottles. lets hope not.

I would have given this salad dressing five stars in the past, but the ingredients and consistency of the dressing recently changed. If you get a bottle that says "New Look" and "Same Great Taste!", be aware that you are getting the new recipe with less sodium, but also a thinner consistency with less cheese solids and a less robust and authentic taste. Vinegar and water are now the second and third ingredients listed after soybean oil. The original recipe contained soybean oil, water and then parmesan and romano cheese. Romano is now the fourth ingredient and parmesan is further down in the list.

I will give more information later, but this consumer is not pleased. Why do companies mess with something that is a success?
Maybe we should express our discontent.

This change is in the works right now. We have two bottles in our refrigerator - new and old. The older one has an expiration date of August 2012, while the newer one has an expiration date of October 2012.

Summary: If You Like Almonds and Cinnamon....
Text: If you like almonds and you like cinnamon, these are a tasty and healthy treat.  Almonds are good nutrition offering protein, good fat and Vitamin E.  Nutritionists recommend having a small serving of healthy nuts like almonds or walnuts each day.  Cinnamon is good for you too, and this combination by Trader Joe's is tasty and unique.  Our family enjoys these cinnamon almonds and Trader Joe's sesame honey almonds to snack on or have with a fruit smoothie at breakfast or lunch to provide protein and healthy fats.  This is a healthy snack you can feel good about eating.

Quality ingredients resulted in a super duper stout. I would highly recommend this ingredient kit. I will definitely buy this again.

=== update ===
I have bought this several times I want to start by saying that I have NEVER been dissatisfied with the kit. I will say though that the ingredients have been inconsistent. I have gotten an all malt kit with non pellet real leaf hops, a standard liquid and dry malt with pellet hops kit, and a kit with syrup, dry malt, pellet hops and additional raw sugar. Every single one has been a winner on the pallet and the price is great, but I would like to see this be more consistent and for the description to tell exactly what is in the kit.

Keep in mind though, every single kit has produced a quality stout with great flavor and at a price that can't be beat. The price of ingredients does fluctuate as they are commodities, but this kit has been able to produce a fine stout at a great price every single time.
Very satisfied with this product. Addition times are listed beside each ingredient, which makes this recipe easy to follow if you are already familiar with the basics of extract brewing.
Makes beer but it is a cheap kit that leaves you with a somewhat watered down beer. Will be trying a different suppler next time!
Awesome flavor, very good tasting, not to strong and overbearing.  Great to relax with or to have first thing in the morning.

This acts a lot like fake ground beef.  It's better than some fake taco-beef dry mixes out there because it doesn't have any of its own spices.  So I can put it in marinara sauce or tacos.  Most often, I make chili with it.  It's low in fat and high in protein, so it works out great with my workout diet.  It's moist in the can, so it's ready to cook with right away.
Since giving up meat,this is a must have for me. It's the best ground beef substitute I've found and I'm so excited to have found it online! It's not dry, chewy, or pre-seasoned.

Add this with the linkettes and your family can enjoy a hotdog with chili that is healthy and as good as any. To make the chili I add olive oil, onion and ketchup. You really need to add oil to this in any kind of frying pan situation to keep it from sticking. The only downfall here is it looks a little like cheap canned dog food but once it's out of the can the appeal surfaces.

My husband is an extremely picky carnivore and will not eat other vege-burger products.  This one he hardly even notices, the texture is only slightly different than ground beef, other than that it could pass for the real thing easy.  It takes seasoning well and is completely interchangeable for ground beef in casseroles, for tacos, chili, etc.  It does not mold into hamburger patties though.  We have been extremely happy with the product.  I've even used it in my slow cooker and it held up nicely.
AS a vegetarian for 37 years i think Loma Linda makes the best tasting products ever. They are cheaper than the bookstores or grocery stores and you get free shipping too.

The Loma Linda Vege- Burger, is ideal for everyone, this Vege- Berger can be used in any meal that requires ground beef.  It can be season with a variety of condiments. It has a great texture and taste.  I am not a vegetarian yet, however, I have replaced the use of ground beef with Vege-Burger. Great product

I grew up eating Loma Linda meat substitutes, including this item: Vege-Burger. I also eat meat, but I prefer the Loma Linda and Worthington meat substitutes when I have the choice. To find these products in restaurants you have to find a Seventh-day Adventist school (or sometimes an SDA hospital), and patronize their cafeteria, or college snack bar.

First thing you need to know: Loma Linda Vege-Burger is not meat. It doesn't cook like meat - can't grill it because it'll burn easily. It doesn't taste like meat. It has a similar but not overly identical texture to meat (it's not as tough as meat, but is substantive which provides for chewing satisfaction; this is the biggest complaint of meat eaters: not the same chewing satisfaction as animal meat). This vege-burger has a similar form to loose, cooked hamburger in that it's pellet like, and it'll stick together.

The purpose of this meat substitute is to give people who prefer not to eat meat a similar and clever alternative that we can use in recipes where hamburger is used. The nutritional value of this product is plant protein. For any vegetarian - however you choose to define the term - there are concerns for missing nutrients from the diet that aren't provided by meat (vitamins, minerals, etc). I'll leave that topic up to you to figure out.

Loma Linda Vege-Burger is best, in my opinion, in cases where a well defined pellet of "meat" is appropriate. This includes for me: taco meat, meat loaf, and chili. I like this product very much - it's one of those staples of meat substitutes for me. I cook with this vege-burger just like I do with meat except it's already cooked. It's slightly delicate - fry it at a lower temperature than hamburger, and don't bake it as hot or as long as a hamburger meatloaf - just get the veggies cooked in your meatloaf - as much as you want them cooked - I like my celery and onions a little crunchy to add texture. Oh, and in the meatloaf I like to add some pecans! Yes!

Worthington brand also makes a canned vegeburger (available here on Amazon as of this review 6/2010). For me the Worthington burger is a finer, smoother grind - ie not as pellet like. I like it especially in pasta sauces, meat balls, and stuffed green peppers.

To your health!

I am a mom of a VERY picky 7 year old...The first thing I made for her with the vegi burger was tacos....She now CRAVES these and asks for them at least once a week!...I don't even like to think about regular hamburger after using this product..(I am a regular meat eater)
Sautee a finely chopped small onion in a large nonstick skillet..(no oil needed)
Add 2tsp of minced garlic..stir for a minute...Add 3/4 of a reg. size can of diced tomatoes with the italian seasonings already added in the can...Add 1 can of LL burger..mix together...Add 1 1/4 package of your favorite taco seasoning..(we use taco bell orig.) and 1c water...Stir and cook until thickened...Mix in salt and pepper to taste..(I add the s and p when I add the meat, but this way you will get an idea of how much you'll need the next time)

Loma Linda Vege-Burger, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) is a very tasty, healthy product. It may be made in the form of a burger, great for meals and snacks. I may also be used in all forms that hamburger is used. For example burger and rice is very satisfying. It might also be used in the making of a lasagna. Really great for those avoiding the problems associated with red meat. This is a better vegetarian burger than any other that I have tasted and my mother was a vegetarian.

My other favorite vegitarian foods are: Loma Linda Big Franks, 20-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), Loma Linda Tender Rounds with Gravy, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and Worthington Vegetable Skallops, 20-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).
This is my choice of this type of products.  I will recommend it to any one.

I have been looking to find a source of protein while maintaining a lower caloric intake. I love ground beef, but it tends to be higher in calories/fat. I stumbled upon this product while surfing the Amazon website, and I thought I would give it a try based on other reviews. I'll add my review to other favorable ones... while it's not quite ground beef, it's hard to tell the difference. I have used it in several dishes and was hard pressed to tell a truly discernible difference. I will definitely be ordering again.
Add to tacos, chilis, spaghetti sauce.  Gives substance and protein without trying to taste like ground beef, while still having the right texture for people who like ground beef.

I grew up on this stuff. It's so quick and easy to use. I love that it's never greasy or funky smelling like real ground beef and there's never a danger of e-coli from not cooking it enough. It's also cruelty free. No animals had to die in the process! Yay!

I use it for chili, taco filling, and it's easy to make vegeburger patties just by adding bread crumbs, eggs and seasonings. It can even be formed into meatloaf or meatballs. I've made Hamburger Helper with it before which was pretty good. Its uses are endless. I'd love to try this in shepherd's pie. Loma Linda makes the best vegetarian "meat" products.

This has been used in my family to make "hamburgers" for as long as I've been alive and I love it.  Like I've said in other reviews for Loma Linda/Worthington foods it's not meat, it is not meant to taste like meat.  I've also stated before that the meat substitutes are an acquired taste and it tends to be like it or hate it.  Vege-Burger is versatile, but it is not something that can be eaten without seasoning as it is not palatable on its own.

I fixed them as the reviewers recommended.  I breaded them in seasoned whole wheat pastry flour and fried them with mushrooms in olive oil.  So good.  At church they make them with the same breading, fry, then covers them with gravy and bakes.  Either way what's not to like.  Fast and tasty.

The texture and density is just like real ground beef. It doesn't really have much taste on its own, but that is where seasonings come in. Throw some veggies in, some onions, scallions, peppers, maybe even some olive oil.

Don't expect this to taste just like beef though. Beef has a high fat content so there is quite a lot of flavor in beef. Ever try rinsing off all the fat from your ground beef? Well when you do, it loses a lot of flavor. And this is what this reminds me of. Fat free ground beef. Use your imagination and create something tasty!

As I type this, my crockpot is filled with Vege-Burger, kidney beans, onion, garlic, celery, carrot and spices. It smells fantastic in here! The Vege-Burger makes an extremely hearty chili, and the texture is perfect. I also use V-B for tacos and burritos and "meat" sauce for my pasta. This is a wonderfully versatile product, with a pleasant taste that takes on the flavor of the spices you use. It has great "mouth feel". The only caution I would give is that you need to use oil in the pan if you are going to sautee it, because it will stick to the pan. But that's not an issue with crockpots, of course.
My first time eating this product. I make the most delicious soft and hard shell tacos with this product. I have to say this.........I LOVE IT!!!
This is a must have for vegetarians for the pantry.  Handy uses galore as a substitute for ground beef.  Comes out of the can in great condition.  I love this on tortillas and in chili.

This is our favorite "meatless" product. It's crumbly, like ground meat..cooks up quick in the microwave. It's a favorite supper as tacos with Kids and Big People alike in our house. It has a great texture and a subtle unique taste that can be dressed up with spices or good as is. We're great fans of Loma-Linda meatless, though we're not exclusively vegetarian.  Order it by the case!!

We are not vegetarians . . . but we are trying to "cut back" on red meats, etc.

We think Vege-burger tastes best in recipes calling for lotsa' spices, as in Tacos, or Chili - we had some VERY good dinners from these = Dad also made a casserole, but the spices were lacking and the taste was less than stellar, but okay. He promises to try harder.

Overall, we are most happy with this product.

Having been primarily a vegetarian for the past 25 years, I can truly state that this product is fantastic as an alternative to ground beef.  Even for a person that just wants to live a heathier lifestyle, one could substitute this product in all kinds of recipes, it adapts itself readily to all types of seasonings and gastronomic genres. And with this low fat version, it makes it even healthier.

Summary: Healthy product just be sure to season it well
Text:
Bought the first case on a whim thinking that I would sneak some in the chili or tacos without telling the family. Well, the hubby saw my put it in and threw a hissy fit. Chili turned out great, but he was not a believer. Eventually he wanted to add some burger to something he was preparing and we did not have it in the house, so he grabbed a can of this. He has loved it ever since! This comes unseasoned so be prepared to season it well to go along with whatever it is you are using it in. Originally I planned on only using it in chili and for taco "meat", but we have expanded the use. Yesterday we made meatloaf that had ground turkey blended with this and it turned out terrific. The hubby blends it all the time with ground turkey and the kids are totally unaware. We did try it once with a box of hamburger helper and we won't do that again- messed up the texture too much. I also love that it is shelf stable so it is a great pantry item.

Be warned- if you are not used to working with this stuff it seems a little nasty coming out the can. It does cook up great so long as you season it though. The calories are half that of the ground turkey we use and has more protein. Check out the nutrition label- it is some good stuff. Highly recommend!

Summary: Vege-Burger a key to my favorite recipe
Text:
I was given a recipe for "Manhattan Meatballs" which called for canned Vege-Burger. Everyone raved about this
dish and wanted the recipe. Over the years it was hard to find the product. My daughter found it on Amazon.com
so now I can share the recipe and give them a can of Vege-burger to make their own. I hope to try other recipes
using this product.

Excellent meat substitute for vegetarians who like the meat taste but don't like to eat the dead animals and has a good amount of protein. I use it anywhere you might use beef and it's so easy to prepare, just microwave and you're ready to go. I will probably use this product for a long while yet, I'm on my third case and eat it several times a week. Great product!

I was very scared to try canned veggie meat. It sounds horrible...meat out of a can. It is wonderful! I am so happy I finally tried it, and only wish that I would of tried it sooner. I bought the low fat version and loved it so much that I have never tried the full fat version (why when I enjoy the low fat one). It makes the best meat-loaf. Everyone loves it, even my non-vegetarian friends and family. We used the meat in a pasta dish last week, and everyone thought it was actually beef. This product is awesome, and I will recommend it to everyone. Give it a try!

Summary: Great price for a great product.
Text: I have been using this product for most of my life. My mom used it and so do most of my four sons. It was terrific to get such a great price and NO shipping cost also.
Loma Linda Vege-Burger, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) are a convenient and tasty way of replacing ground meat with a vegetarian alternative.

Summary: I Have to Balnce These Reviews!
Text:
I gave this a one-star for balance. Had the other reviews been balanced, I would have given it 2 stars.

If you are used to eating meat, this stuff is a very big disappointment. When we mix it 1-4 with beef, people won't eat the mixture!

My dog eats almost anything, but she won't eat this.

Neither my wife or I will eat this, even when mixed with hamburger helpers or whatever.

So, beware, because all these five-star ratings are from people who do not eat meat, and probably have forgotten what it tastes like.

You want Foojoy China ( CLASSIC ) Oolong! Not Foojoy China Oolong. That word Classic needs to be on the box, if you want a MUCH smoother, flavorful cup of tea! Could be the best on the planet. Try it! You WILL be pleased!

I got this in China town in Los Angeles because the restraunt we went to I had actually complimented them on their tea.

Turns out, it was actually a mixture of FooJoy Oolong/FooJoy Jasimine Green Tea.

This is officially my new brand of Oolong Tea....Wonderful aroma and fantastic flavor.  Try it!!  For Green Tea, try Kirkland Authentic Green Tea with Matcha...also fantastic!!  Got to find me a good black tea and white tea, and I'll be set!!

OMG I love this tea. It doesn't give you pain when going to bathroom. I had my 8 friends try it they love it. They are also ordering it. It let me work out more in gym. It really does work! I drink it every day now and it has really helped me lose my belly fat and body fat. Try it you will love it too.

Summary: Actually 3.5 stars. Very good w/ food, weak by itself.
Text:
Foojoy China Classic Min-nan Oolong (Wulong) Tea

Personally I prefer a very strong mug of tea so YMMV.

My first sip and I was disappointed in the tea. I thought it was weak and lacking in body but it had an interesting aftertaste. Not nutty but I've seen this tea's taste described as Toasty. Good word.

The tea is very good with food. The tea doesn't overwhelm the taste of the food and the toasty tea aftertaste really seems to accent the food's flavor.

So 2 stars for drinking out of a mug, early on a cold morning; 5 stars in a tea cup, whilst scarfing down foods.

I bought this product mainly to help me lose weight since extensive studies have found that Oolong tea helps in to lose belly fat.  You need to drink at least 2 cups a day to do this effectively.  I usually have like 1 cup a day - in the mornings with my breakfast.  Its good tasting and healthy at the same time.  I would recommend it to anybody even if you don't have to lose weight.

I am a tea lover and ordered 2 boxes of this tea ... a big mistake.  I have been drinking oolong tea for years, and this is the worse oolong tea I have tasted.  It tasted bitter, burnt and stale.  Poorly packaged, the tea bags broke when hot water was added, leaving loose tea leaves that needed to be strained. A real disappointment,  my boxes ended up in the trash.
I was looking for the tea served in Chinese restaurants, this is not it.  Tea is weak and I don't care for the taste.
This tea is so delicious even without sugar and it's so inexpensive for the quality. I use it for health and to lose weight and it definitely helps!
I didn't care for it that much. I purchased because of the other reviews I read. I do not think I will purchase again.

Summary: Not what I was looking for but still great tea!
Text: I was looking for a tea that tastes like the one I was served in a restaurant where we used to live. This one comes pretty close. Even though it is not quite the same taste I miss and was looking for, it is a great tea.

I'm really happy with my Oolong tea.  The price was really good and since I can't find this brand of tea in the stores in my area I was thrilled to find it at Amazon.com.  I will go back and order more when the supply I have gets low.  I really like this tea.  I was also happy with the delivery time and the packaging.

I see others enjoy this tea. Perhaps I received stale tea? The packaging is poor.

I just had my first cup and will throw the rest of the box out. The tea has a flat taste and no aroma. An oolong should have a little smokey, little spicy, interesting and aromatic taste. Very disappointed in this tea.

This is my first Oolong tea purchase and I normally drink flavored black teas with milk, which are very hearty so I wasn't sure I'd like the Oolong tea, but I really, really do.  In fact I have 2-3 a day.  I had lost weight before I started drinking this tea and I can't say for sure whether this tea is part of the reason I've continued to lose a little weight.  However, I like it so much that I will continue to drink it as it might be part of the reason.
Oolang is my favorite tea, and this is great!  This is the hot tea that is served in Chinese restuarents with or after your meal.

The China Classic Oolong packaging of the individual tea bags is superior to the previous ones I have had from China. The bags are always intact with no string coming loose.  And the tea has a great flavor! I drink it as iced tea every day.  I have reordered several times and will continue to do so.
I dont know if I believe this tea is helpful for losing weight, but it tastes great and its a wonderful alternative to soda...which is the reason I bought it.

This stuff is awful!

Summary: Perhaps the greatest hot sauce ever?
Text:
Let me start this review by saying I'm a bit of an expert on hot sauce. Maybe not as much as Scott Roberts (of scottrobertsweb.com) but fairly close. I use hot sauce all the time. I've tried hundreds of brands. And this is easily in my top 5 hot sauces ever. It might even take the #1 spot, if the hotter version of this, made with fresh scorpion peppers (Cauterizer) did not exist.

First, it's hot. It's not so ungodly hot that I can't run a solid line down my burrito, but it's hot enough where even the most hardcore of chileheads can tell it's hot. It's hot enough to get the job done. And it's a perfect heat where I can use it with anything. It is one of the hotter non-extract based sauces out there (which means it should have good flavor -- those who don't know, most extract sauces taste a little chemically and thus lack in flavor).

Second, there's flavor which is the most important category. After all, who wants to eat something that's hot, but doesn't particularly taste good? And flavor is where this sauce excels. This is a Louisiana style hot sauce with a vinegary base, but the flavor is much more complex than any other Louisiana style hot sauce I have ever had. While there is a bitter vinegery taste that we have come to associate to Louisiana style hot sauce, there is a sweet fruity flavor at the same time. It works as a Louisiana style hot sauce, and also with dishes that one normally wouldn't associate with a Louisiana style hot sauce. In short, this sauce is good with anything which makes it the most versatile hot sauce of its style.

Third, they all have some cool artwork on the bottles.

In short, if you enjoy spicy foods, you really can't go wrong with this hot sauce or anything Heartbreaking Dawns really.

Summary: Could you have a worse name for a candy?
Text:
People who take candy seriously are a vulnerable group. So why name a straightforward candy "nerds"? It seems like you are poking fun at your supporters. Especially for the sour ones (which are I think the best), the conventional thing would be to call them something like "McGillicutty's" and have a picture of a scowling Irishman. The candy itself is just going to be sugar, corn syrup, stabilizers and some flavoring--the name is what gives you a sense of what it is.

In general, the Wonka lines have been a depressing experience. First, no one should have been so cynical as to use the name "Willy Wonka" for real candy. It's like Fruit of the Loom having "Thomas Jefferson" briefs. And I'll get back to that. But second, the candy has consistently been uninventive, third rate, and with no particular appeal. All it does is drag W.W.'s image into the ground as opposed to it being an inspiration.

And as we all know, Wonka is now actually a part of Nestle's. Now as someone previously in the candy business, I have to say that Nestle's main-line and high-quality line products in the candy/chocolate world are pretty good. But as a company, Nestle is a nightmare--poisoning pets, starving babies. If Nestle owned the real Willy Wonka factory, the Oompa-Loompas would turn out to be slaves. I just can't understand a world in which Nestle owns the right to put out low grade candy and call it Willy Wonka.

Willy Wonka represented the dream of doing good, being a child, and being honest. That was why Charlie got the factory--because he precisely wasn't the kind of guy who would go far in Nestle's. I feel like in this product, Nestle is basically saying to Charlie, "you're a nerd! Maybe you can work in the tech department programming the payroll computers! But you sure as heck can't run the factory and we're not interested in any of your spacey ideas!"

And one last thing--if you're my age, you've probably had to listen, more than you wanted to, to the song "Nurds" (the spelling was "charmingly" wrong) by the Roches. Now if there's one thing you don't want associated with your candy product, it's roaches. Animal contamination is always a real threat, and it's often not taken seriously enough. So, Nestle, when you were done with your ethically-dubious activities in the third world, you somehow chose a name for a candy that would both spit in the face of Charlie Bucket and make the consumer queasy. Who's running this show? [15]

Summary: Yeah, Yeah, miracle drug, but how does it taste and is it worth the price
Text:
Yes, Manuka honey is special. It is cultivated only in New Zealand and southeast Australia. It has also been used by some researchers in a clinical trial as a medicinal honey to ameliorate some of the ill effects of cancer treatment. It probably works in some medical indications. But this is not because it has magic powers or that it is vastly different from other honeys. Manuka honey is used as a medicinal honey rather than other honeys because it is very well characterized chemically. That characterization is consistent because Manuka honey comes from only two very similar flowers. This honey is unusually viscous and it has relatively high concentrations of the chemicals that kill bacteria in honey. But, most good honeys are viscous and have antibacterial potency; they are just not as well characterized for medicinal purposes. As far as using it as a folk remedy for all these various conditions? Honey has been used as a folk medicine for centuries and it works for some things. As a toxicologist, I have to say `well maybe it will work for this or that, but we cannot really know if something works medically until we do a clinical trial.' The reported `cures' are possibly real and are probably the result of immune stimulation or antibacterial activity that might occur with any honey. But for most people it is really all about how the honey tastes (unless you are on a clinical trial).

I think it tastes rather good. It is floral and complex and full of flavor. Its viscosity means it clings to your hot biscuit better than most and it comes in a fancy jar. But my wife did not like it. It was not clear but rather cloudy like honey that has begun to precipitate out its sugar. But that was not the source of the cloudiness; it was actually due to the presence of honey comb. And the honey tastes of comb, which my wife found a bit objectionable.

So why buy this honey. I really cannot think of a reason unless you are trying to impress someone. I have had much better, much clearer honey from a roadside stand in North Carolina, particularly sourwood. And this stuff is terribly expensive. I do not see anything wrong with trying it on your warts but you might try a cheaper honey first. Yeah but there is that impress people thing.
