Baby loves this and so do I. It's very tasty and great for breakfast or lunch. One of our favorite banana combos, but the beet comes through and of course the blueberry just adds a little something extra. Highly recommend.

Candy is delicious, as is all Godiva. They don't skimp on the flavor, so it's not a "cheap version" of Godiva. But it's overpriced here, as they are sold in most drugstores for $5.99 a bag. If my arithmetic is still good, 6 x 3 =18, so there is no need to buy it online, unless you live somewhere very rural. Thanks!
This is absolutely the best instant hot chocolate you can buy!  I even like it better than the hot chocolates they sale in coffehouses.
This is hands down my favorite hot chocolate. So much better than any of the stuff you pick up at the nearby grocery store. I know that it's a bit pricey, but you get what you pay for.

This is an excellent chicken noodle soup, good news for those observant of a kosher/Halal diet. I am glad it is made available through amazon, I usually tend to purchase 'vegetarian chicken soup' but one gets sick of tofu after a while and wants the real deal. Will definitely purchase again, hopefully amazon will restock.
This has 60 calories per serving and each can had two servings.

Be aware that the title and the whole listing is wrong, I didn't receive six sets, or 1 lb worth of tea, I received 1 gift set.

That being said I and my family drink tea daily. Between the three of us we go through about a gallon a day, usually a plain variety of orange Pekoe and/or Black tea. However, I like to mix it up and try new teas, and I fell in love with the quality stash teas after my boyfriend bought me a huge variety pack, so when I'm looking for something new I tend to gravitate towards the Stash brand.

As soon as you remove the cellophane you get a very inviting aroma from each box, I tried 2 out of the 3 both hot and cold, and 1 (the cranberry) I only drank cold.

Cinnamon Vanilla
I found this to be very sweet, so I would suggest cutting your sugar back by 25% - this one was my least favorite

Warm: I preferred it warm over iced, which is rare. The flavors are much fuller while it's warm and the aromatics are better appreciated that way too,I tried it first with out milk, it was okay, almost reminiscent of warm apple cider sans the apple, after I added milk and it transformed into a liquid cinnamon bun! That was a delight!...at first. It was one of those things that the more you drank it the less you enjoyed it, the cinnamon began to overwhelm you and the sweet notes became clawing.. - My mother didn't like it plain or with milk.

Cold: It's just shy of "Okay" while cold. the flavor's become very sharp and one noted it still kind of reminds me of an apple cider due to it's predominate sweet and cinnamon flavor, I haven't tried it cold with milk yet. later I mixed it 50/50 with our regular brew hoping to cut the overwhelming flavors, it didn't help any.

Pumpkin Spice.
the pumpkin spice was my second favorite,
Warm: it was quite similar to the cinnamon vanilla as far as it being very aromatic but much more balanced, the clove dominated and while it didn't taste anything like a pumpkin pie (it contains no actual pumpkin) it did have a nice earthy notes to it. It was easy to enjoy this one both warm and cold although I also preferred this over being warm. I added milk while it was still warm and preferred it with out. The milk didn't really compliment the flavors.

Cold: The same thing happen with the cinnamon vanilla with it being cold, the notes are a little sharper, but it was still really enjoyable

Cranberry Pomegranite.
I only drank this one cold, as I'm not big on warm fruits, I made a half gallon using 2 bags of stash and 2 bags of black tea, this gave it a nice fruity hint while still being a full bodied tea. I enjoyed this one the most, probably because I enjoy fruited teas over spiced teas, but also because the taste was enough to enjoy it, but not so much that you were overwhelmed with strong flavors.

Chicken pasta roni has always been a favorite for me and my husband.  With in the last 2 months, we have been unable to buy this product at any of our local stores.  Thankfully, Amazon.com came to the rescue and now we can buy our pasta online.  We signed up for the auto shipment.  So I am very excited to see how this works out.

We use 2 boxes of the Chicken Pasta Roni and add 2 large cans of chicken breast pieces .. and it's great!  We've signed up to have Amazon automatically refill our Chicken Pasta Roni order every few months.  Now we don't have to wait for a local sale, plus we can get all we want  ... AND at a great price!

I adore this product!  why oh why do they no longer sell it in any store near me?!!  why must i have to purchase this boxed wonderousness from the internet?  oh, chicken flavored pasta roni, why do you forsake me?

I am a coffee-holic. So I'm pretty critical of coffee. I can't stand to be served what tastes like warm water with cream and suger. I also don't like the so-strong-you-can't-taste-it coffees like Starbuck's.

I ordered Gevalia coffee to receive the free stainless steel coffee maker (which I received in a timely manner and love!). I was very pleasantly impressed with the coffee. The taste is rich and flavorful -- no bitterness.

I highly recommend this particular blend of Gevalia (Signature Blend).

I used to think this stuff was the best coffee around. Until I started trying various other brands, and grinding my own. To which, I came to realize that at best, this stuff is average.

Slightly above the canned stuff in the grocery store, thats it. The other reviewer is right, it is "Nutty" in flavor, so you really need to love nuts or this one will turn you off. Secondly, it is fairly light roasted. We tend to have more enjoyment from medium-dark to dark roasts. This one doesn't have enough kick.

This is a blend, which isn't really a good thing for coffee freaks. I tend to like beans from specific regions in the world, so blends really mess up my taste enjoyment. Blends are generally for people that aren't too serious about Coffee.

My teens and their friends drink regular soda pop by the gallon! They're obviously addicted to the stuff - a very unhealthy habit.

I can't drink soda pop myself, it's been 5 years or so since I had one, and so I began searching for a drink that tasted like regular soda pop, but wasn't unhealthy. I searched high and low for a suitable alternative - and then I found Izze.

I love the fruity, tangy flavor of Izze's sparkling clementine soda. Nothing beats an icy, cold Clementine Izzy on a picnic. The clementine flavor goes well with a nice thick sandwich and a handful of chips, but it is also great just by itself.

My teens love Izze and drink it now just like soda pop! I'm so happy to know they aren't guzzling down corn syrup and artificial colors and flavors, but instead are enjoying all-natural Izze, with no added sweeetners!

If you're looking for a great alternative to regular soda pop - you can't do better than to buy Izze.

Izze Sparkling Clementine Soda is like a bite into fresh fruit! It's made of a mixture of different juices including grape, lemon, orange and apple. Somehow, the combination comes out to be like a section of the freshest clementine bursting with flavor.

This is certainly a nutritional step-up from regular soda, but be aware that this does have sugar in it -- of course, there's sugar in all fruits. Enjoy Izze's great flavor and refreshment, but enjoy it in moderation.

Excellent product!

This is a very good drink. Tasty and not syrupy I really enjoyed the flavor. I tried the Sparkling Clementine. It is funny when I tasted the drink I thought, yup, that tastes like a Clementine. Then I looked at the back for the ingredients. There are juices (from concentrate) from White Grape, Apple, Lemon and Orange Juice. No Clementine. Funny enough it really is a nice flavor.

Izze also offers this beverage in a just over 8 oz. a can. The drink does not have caffeine or added sugars so I don't feel bad about drinking it. It isn't overly sweet so it adds a bit of energy rather then making me tired.

This is not a hydration beverage as much as a tasty treat. It is not unhealthy so you don't need to feel guilty by downing one or two of these in a day. Not calorie free but not too bad either. The taste is not overly sweet. I have heard from others who consider it bitter. I disagree. I think this bitter taste is from tastebuds too used to sugary sodas.

A great drink, a good company and thumbs up in my book

As a gourmet soda lover and shameless glutton, I've dropped a good amount of coin at my local Wholefoods trying out different beverages... well.. at least the ones that don't cost $5 or more per bottle. On sale, one bottle of Izze is about $1.50.

It's fabulous! The soda does taste like clementine. It's all natural, sparkly, and so refreshing. I remembered trying the canned version of this (IZZE Fortified Sparkling Juice, Clementine, 8.4-Ounce Cans) and not being impressed. The bottled version tastes much better. It's got different ingredient ratios and a different formulation: sparkling water, white grape juice concentrate, orange juice concentrate, lemon juice concentrate, natural flavor, gum, acacia, ester gum, beta carotene. Drink it ice cold though, otherwise it doesn't taste that great.

Sugar is a bit high, with 120 calories per bottle. 70% juice. One bottle is very high in Vitamin A and gives you 100% of your daily needs. Both are astoundingly good. Highly highly recommended.

Several weeks ago I discovered Izze fruit drinks starting with the Blackberry variety. It was so good I tried the Pomegranate. That was good too, so now I have a four-pack of the Clementine variety. It tastes like a weak orange soda with a good sharp tartness. I like it much better than the typical orange soda pop and it's made with 70% fruit juices and no added sugars. It's just like having a slightly carbonated fruit juice rather than darkly-colored sugar water. That's my kind of drink. Excellent.

Gary Peterson

Okay I am not a math wiz but the Box cleary says .25 cents each. So there are 24 boxes. That comes out to $6.00
I am not sure if they sell these candy in jars like they do lemon heads, but this is not a deal at all.

I remember these from my childhood, and randomly, I decided to look online and found them here.  I went overboard and bought 3 different flavors, so now I have LOADS of candy around.  I need to find people who also like this candy to share with them, because if I eat all of this, it would be a bad idea.  :)  My favorite are STILL Appleheads, just like they were when I was in middle school.  The funny part is the case reads "25 cents" a box.  But, if you multiply 24 boxes x 25 cents = $6.00.  If you plan to sell them, your return won't be good. HA! I paid $10 for each box.  Time to share them!  They still taste just like they did when I was young.  If you miss this candy from your childhood, buy some, you won't regret it.

Really like this product.Its much like Uncle Bens Spanish Rice.It is a ready to eat product.Just heat in the microwave for 1 to 1 and 1/2 minutes and that's it.Other ready to eat rices are usually around 8 oz per pack.This one is almost 16 oz.So there is plenty for two servings as a side.We like bratwurst,pork,or chicken, on the side or mixed in and it makes a meal for two that quick and easy.The green peas on the label arent regular peas.They are crispy with an almost nut like taste which we really like.Great price for 6 packs considering the size.

Summary: Great product! Too expensive from Amazon!
Text:
We love these corn flakes and were so happy to see them at Amazon. They are the perfect alternative to mainstream corn flakes! They have just the right texture and flavor and everyone in our house will eat them! We even use them for crusts in many dessert recipes!

Ordering groceries from Amazon has always been both convenient and saves us money. But we paid $30.40 a case for these a few month ago! I can get them at our local health food store for less than they are now listed so unless Amazon changes their prices of many of our gluten free favorites to reflect the savings we USED to get, we won't be ordering groceries here anymore.

These corn flakes are delicious -- not wimpy, thin corn flakes like you find in house brands. And they are just sweet enough. Nothing like Frosted Flakes (ugh).

Everyone in our house loves them. Highly recommended.

These corn flakes are very good and tasty. My last order was $30.40 which makes the new price of $38 about 25 percent higher. I guess if you have celiac problems you are a captured audience. But with corn flakes costing about $1 a box at the dollar stores it's going to be a hard sell to continue with this brand at these high prices. Gas has gone down but their prices are still going up. Maybe it's because they are imported from Canada?

Too bad. These corn flakes could get a much bigger share of the market if they would just stop pricing them out of reach. Remember--they are only corn flakes. Great product for those who think it's a deal.
Very good tasting cereal at a great price.  At whole foods it would cost about $7.00.

I have followed a strict gluten free diet for about 7 years now and this cereal, I think, is one of the best out there.  I eat this cereal for breakfast almost every morning and sometimes as a snack during the day.  What I like most about this cereal is how universal it is.  Besides a great breakfast cereal, I also use it to make special k bars (which my husband loves).

Summary: Unknown G/I Issues Helped by this Cereal
Text:
Long Story Short.

I get the flu from Co worker - WOW, thought I had flu before but now I totally understand how it can kill infants and old people.

The months to follow I slowly got worse and worse with a G/I. I ended up losing 45 lbs (not trying) and was having a problems getting to work.

Every test you can have and all the results are normal. I don't have a Gluten Allergy according to the tests BUT

I started to avoid Gluten and Dairy (and caffeine and gum and hard candy...) having honey with decaf tea and coffee (1cup a day)

(if you have the same deal as me here is highlights) once you get your routine down and can survive this and... believe it or not, feel better than you ever did before (cuz your not eating all that crap) took me about 1 year to finally get a handle on it.

In Short - this cereal is a tool that works keep you happy and healthy.
This cereal is a great replacement for frosted corn flakes. They are sweet, stay fresh a long time and when purchased through amazon.com, they are quite economical.

Summary: Gluten Free/ GMO Free/ Organic Corn Flakes Cereal
Text: Excellent! This cereal has a great taste and texture. My family really likes it. It's great alone with it's very light sweet flavor or with fruit. They like to just snack on it dry, also. This is a great product at an affordable price.

We love these cornflakes. They come in regular or honey. I like them as they stay crunchy for a long while. I also use them for 'Special K' bars as those are not gluten free. I crush them for making fish and chicken. It makes a great crunch and a golden color.

I have been eating Nature's Path Organic Honey,d Corn Flakes Cereal for about two years now and its great.
I haven't got tired of it yet.
Its nice and crispy and very tasty.

This is about my fifth time I have order this product and eat it about 5 mornings a week.  It is indeed tasty and fills my need for Gluten Free Cereal.  I have shared the goodness of this cereal with several other people that have Celiac and they too are very happy with the product.

I was looking for Kellog's corn flakes when I found these.  I thought I'd try them since I couldn't find Kellog's.  I'm sooo glad that I did.  These corn flakes are terrific.  They have a wonderful flavor and the texture is excellent - not flimsy and whimpy like the Kellog's.  These are the best corn flakes I've ever had.
I love these corn flakes with blueberries and soy milk. I've never had any better, and they're gluten free!

Summary: This is the best Gluten-free Corn Flake on the Market
Text: This is the best tasting gluten-free corn flake on the market.  I have purchased them regularly for the last five years after trying all available brands.  Even my two and four year olds will eat them for breakfast.

Just tried these for the first time - new to the gluten free diet and these are very good.  They don't get soggy either.  Bought these because of other reviews saying you could grind them up for breading on chicken etc.. haven't tried it yet but I'm sure it will work nicely.

This cereal is delightful. It has just a hint of sweetness and a great crunch. I love how small the ingredients list is! This is what "Corn Flakes" should taste like, unlike the Kelloggs brand (which tastes more like cardboard...) It goes great with sliced bananas!

:)
Nature's Path Organic Honey'd Corn Flakes Cereal is the best cereal I have found since I found out I am gluten intolorent.

These corn flakes are really good. My son wasn't crazy about most of the other kinds. He is a newly diagnosed, special needs kid. It was hard at first, since he was used to regular, gluten foods. But he has adapted well. Good price too!

Excellent flavor. A slight touch of sweetness but not too much. Holds up well in milk.

If you have Celiac Disease you can also use them as a bread crumb substitute for chicken parmesan . I simply add parsley, parmesan cheese, salt & pepper, throw it a food processor and presto! Gluten free bread crumbs are very expensive and this method works very well.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

These corn flakes are designed for those with dietary problems, or for those who refuse to eat any with additives, food colorings, etc.  And they are more dense then those we grew up with, plus they taste very good.

I love this cereal!!!
I,ve been eating it for months ,and did not tired yet...

I have an allergy to gluten and this is absolutely the best tasting cereal around. It tastes better than any corn flakes I have ever eaten  even before going gluten free. They are not too sweet and not too bland. Just right. Crunchy and holds up in milk. I normally do food shopping at the nearest grocery store but had to drive 15 min. just to buy my gluten free cereals. Not any more. These eco pacs are a great price. Saves me time and money.

Summary: Natures Path  ECO PACK (26.4oz) Honey'd Corn Flakes
Text: Nature's Path Honey' Corn Flakes...GLUTEN FREE....are as my husband with Celiac (Allergic to Gluten) says.... the next best thing to real people's Regular Kello--s Corn Flakes. It is hard to get something tasty BUT to him this item does the trick....Recommend highly for people with Celiac and other allergies.
You can eat this cereal anytime of the day. If you have Celiac or not this a great cereal.
For anyone on a gluten free diet this is a wonderful cereal - as good as Kelloggs, if not better,and already sprinkled with honey.  The eco-pack is about the best price you are going to get.

We have never had this brand before and hoped we would like it.  We love it.  My  husband wants to eat healthy, but the junk food junkie in him fights against it!  I was worried this may be too bland for him, but he really likes it!  Great price, great deal, great cereal.
My kids and I really enjoy these.  It is hard to find good tasting gluten free products.  This one is one of the good ones.
I like this product very much.It has delicious taste and it's very good for you, because has no artificual ingrediantes.Amazon is my favorit company on the Web.
Thank you for your prompt delivery of this wonderfully delicious and tasty treat that is good on all sorts of ice cream, cakes, and pies!  The kids love it, as do adults of all ages!

I tried these at an frozen yogurt place and immediately fell in love with them! I have been craving them for days! Once they pop in your mouth a burst of strawberry flavor fills your mouth with pleasure! My kids love them on their ice cream and just about everything else they can think of.

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.
Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.
Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.
Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.

Summary: shipping canned items is risky, but...
Text: the product itself is very good-i would definitely recommend this brand. i bought these with subscribe and save because it was so much cheaper to buy them this way (the price at the grocery store is about $1.60 more per can). when they arrived, 5 out of the 12 cans were dented so badly that i didn't feel safe using them. i emailed amazon and explained the trouble-and they sent me a new case for free. 2 cans in the new case were dented, so i might think twice before buying canned items thru amazon grocery again, but i appreciate the good customer service that was provided.

These are delicious, it's been hard to find a good stewed tomato,the kind my mom used to can.  This is very close. A real fresh tomato taste and seasoned perfectly. Other brands have a tinny taste to them and usually are too sweet.

I've ordered these for the past year - they're great for soups and even as a side dish. A most satisfying tomato flavor without the unpleasant aftertaste some canned tomatoes have. Like the nice chunks of tomato instead of mush.
Excellent buy! Really fresh, how can you beat the health benefits of raisins and DARK chocolate? Perfect and delicious.
My all time favorite chocolate snack, a little healthier that twinkies :).  Love them and love the smaller size.
I gave two packs to each of my teenagers on a hike and it was gone before the hike even began. ;) Just the right amt of sweetness and energizing.

Summary: Dark chocolate is good for you right?
Text: Comes in lovely a little packets, great for portion control.  Definately tastes better with the dark chocolate (relative to the milk chocolate) ~60% cocoa.  Great value.
These are delicious!! A nice way to get a serving of fruit along with a chocolate fix, but dark chocolate so you get antioxidants, too.  Also, in the small package so you don't over-eat :)
Small very well built cans filled with suggary not very lemonade or raspberry tasting clumpy powder. Didn't go very far. Dissapointed overall with price vs quality in McStevenson Sipperville Product

It says Vanilla all over the bottle, but vanilla is not in the Ingredients. This is purely a mix of artificail ingredients and other "natural" (possibly toxic) substances that resemble vanilla taste, yet there is no actual vanilla in this.
I would definitely spend more money and research time before buying this. Don't be fooled!

Great Candy. No caffeine that I can tell. Artificial flavors. Needs different colored repers to match so many different flavored candies.
It arrived on time in very good shape. I was surprised how the soil was still wet even though it was left in the box for more than a week. Hope to see it grow to a nice big tree.

Used to work at one of the DMC hospitals in Detroit. The Canadian nurses would bring coffee and donuts from Tim Horton's to work. By far the best coffee and donuts ever! Beats America's "leading coffee shop coffee". Whenever I go back to Michigan now not only do I buy it to drink where I'm staying, but I bring several bags back home  to Arizona.
This is the only coffee I drink, I travel 300 miles to my hometown to stock up 3 times a year.

If you ever visit Canada you cannot miss the Ubiquitous Tim Horton's franchises, it seems as if they are on every corner (and small wonder: everything they sell is excellent, reasonably priced, and served with typical Canadian efficiency and politeness.) The quality of Tim Horton's coffee is pretty remarkable -- it is very, very good -- and the price is not outrageous (I picked up a 39 ounce can in a Canadian Walmart for about $16.50 in American dollars toward the end of november, 2010, which was about the same price they were selling for in the Tim Horton's stores.) Note: Their decaf is every bit as good, but I haven't been able to find it in cans larger than 13 ounces.

Removing the lid gives you a big hint of what you're in store for you when you brew this fine coffee. If you've ever bought ground coffee in a store only to get it home and be dissappointed in the taste this coffee will give you a bit of a surprise. Canadians know what this coffee is about and introduced us to it. Starbuck's doesn't even come close!

When my order arrived today I was so disappointed that the ingredient list wasn't just coconut water. It's long and includes sugar. I waited to leave a comment until I'd chilled them, hoping they might at least be a decent-tasting stand-by. YUK. To me it tastes like marzipan. With lumps.

I just love this product and will buy it again. The Coconut water was sweet and tasted like it was coming straight from the fresh water coconut. I love the taste and it's also very good for you. I can't wait to buy some more for myself and my friends.
These mustache candies are adorable!! My 22 year old son loved them in his Christmas stocking.  The tin is nice and can be used again.

For Father's Day I presented dear old Dad with all moustache-themed gifts; these candies made the cut. The candy itself is quite off putting...as while itty bitty 'staches are adorable, the fact that they're a smokey black/gray color makes the brain think of licorice or, well, anything that isn't fruity. But they're indeed generically fruit-flavored. Not too tasty and pretty darn hard. Not sure we recieved the freshest batch, but I think had they been more gummy or even passably soft they'd have scored higher on the taste scale.

But the fact is you buy this sort of novelty as a stocking stuffer type of gift, or, in my case, just to go with a theme. The tin is well made and Dad will probably use it to store some tiny, albeit manly man odds & ends. Is it overpriced for what you actually get? You betcha! But since they don't sell moustache candy at every corner store, the price is worth the smile.

Just skip actually eating the candy... unless chipping a tooth is kind of your thing or if you're on the 'dark grey food only' diet. And of course, understand it's a small piece and won't feed (if you're brave) the entire neighborhood. Small 'stache for lots of cash.

4 stars for the novelty tin, 1 star for the contents. If you're dead set on mustache candy and have teeth as mighty as Chuck Norris, order away!

Summary: Perfect for the man with the stache !
Text:
Nice sized , re-usable tin . Fruit flavored candies .
Comb your stache , eat a candy , enjoy the day !
It would be worth about a $1, but not more.  Too small.  Not worth the money. Pathetic to be quite honest.

I am very impressed with the quality of this product! The raisins are on the small size, but are the perfect blend of sweet and tangy. The price is outstanding...about 1/3 of what I have been paying at my local health food store for a similar product.

Note: If you can only buy a few organics, place grape and berry product at the top of your list. These products are very highly sprayed in conventional farming operations and will contain large amounts of pesticides!

Summary: Wonderful organic raisins... and a wonderful value!
Text:
I never tried Bonner raisins before and purchased them at Amazon based only on the favorable 5 star reviews I read here. I'm always a little nervous about buying 6 pounds of any product I've never tasted before but my concern was unnecessary because these Bonner Organic Raisins are truly wonderful! I concur 100% with the other reviewers. These raisins are great and here at Amazon Bonner Organic Raisins, 16-Ounce Bag (Pack of 6) are a great value as well!

I like them much more than Newman's Organics, SunMaid Organics or the bulk organic raisins at my local health food store. They are not the jumbo sized raisins I'm really crazy about but still they are a decent size and they are moist, soft, juicy and oh so very sweet. They are almost too sweet for snacking (for my taste anyway) but they are a great addition to many of my favorite raw recipes and I love having them on hand as a healthy treat for visiting nieces and nephews. I bet your kids will love them too, just the way they come out of the bag!

I think the price is wonderful too ~ they end up costing much less per pound buying the pack of 6 16-ounce bags here at Amazon rather than the single pound packages at the grocery or bulk at the health food store.

And they are certified Farm Verified Organic ~ so no worries whether they are truly organic or not.

These raisins are moist and chewy and very flavorful with a potent sweetness. They are almost comparable to Dole brand raisins, which in my opinion are usually the best tasting and highest quality raisins available. Another brand worth trying if you are an aficionado is the Trader Joe's jumbo medley pack, which are EXCELLENT.

I would like to note that Trader Joe's sells organic raisins for something like 2.49 or 2.69 a pound and I find them to be just as good as these, which come out to 3.4 in change per pound i.e. Trader Joe's is the better deal.
they were very fresh used them in cooking and found them easy to blend with my dishes thank

I was pleasantly surprised at these little raisins. Organic and tastier than grocery store brands. Even my daughter who does not like raisins enjoys these. With most grapes being a fruit with much poison used on it, I feel very good about giving these golden goodies to a toddler :-)

I usually toss a small handfull of raisins in my oatmeal in the morning. For years, I have purchased Sun-Maid products without complaint. I decided to just try something a bit different since I saw all of the good reviews for this. Man am I glad I did! They are very soft and flavorful. I don't have any complaints against Sun-Maid raisins, but in my opinion, these are better. I don't have a preference of buying organic products, so I guess that is just a bonus in this scenario.

They arrived quickly and well packed by Amazon. Also, each of the 6 packs were air tight and should last a while. Considering how much I use on a daily basis, it may take me 9 months to go through them all. The nutrition information is about as standard as it can come. Since I noticed that the nutrition info was incomplete on Amazon's site here is what the package had...I didn't include items with 0. It was exactly the same as Sun-Maid raisins...without exception. The only difference I can tell was in the taste and texture.

Serving Size: 1/4 cup
Servings Per Container: About 11

Calories: 130
Sodium: 10mg
Potassium: 310mg

These are the most flavorful, moist raisins I've ever eaten.

WOW! Please try these, they are worth every penny.
I bought this because of an advertisement on a magazine but i love it. It taste so good and the calories are low

Summary: 5 stars for the quality of the food, 2 for the price
Text:
The antioxidant properties of Goji Berries are ones you can feel immediately upon consuming them. They're a legit superfood, however, the price is outrageous. If you're comparing them with a dried snack fruit like raisins, they're 8x the cost (for organic). If paying $6 for an afternoon snack is up your alley, then there probably isn't a much better snack for you than these Goji berries.

My only beef with goji berries are that they are BONE dry. So dry, in fact, they could hurt your teeth, if you have sensitive teeth. I actually know someone who chipped a tooth on goji berries. Soaking them is ideal, and then using the juice in smoothies, not to waste the antioxidants that washed off into the water.
I couldn't believe the price for these berries, and they're a third of the size they should be.  I'll stick to buying mine from the local Asian foods grocery at $3.25 a pound.

As other reviewers have noticed, this is not the cheapest goji berry product on the market. However, in my experience, as with pretty much every other Sunfood Nutrition product [...] quality is unsurpassable. I have tasted many goji berry products, and non are as soft and juicy as these little babies.

In response to some of the other people who are objecting to the price, I have been to David Wolfe's lectures (the founder of the company that imports these gojis) and he has spoken of the extreme difficulty with proper quality control of goji berries. They grow in China (and in Tibet) natively, and even many of the products out there that claim they are "organic" may not really be, as some of them can be tested and proven they are still sprayed with sulfur dioxide among other preservatives.

Sunfood Nutrition has 4 checkpoints in China and in the export process to absolutely ensure the quality of their product is a high as they say it is.

David Wolfe has stated that Sunfood is not at all trying to compete on price with cheaper products that are flooding healthfood stores and internet companies nationwide. Their only passion is the highest quality available.

By the way, I have tasted dozens of raw chocolate products (raw cacao) as well, and NO ONE has the consistent quality and taste of the Sunfood products. Try it for yourself and see.

It's not every day that you learn about a great product and solid company that makes you want to quit your job and join them, right? Well, I discovered Zuke's, a "bone brokering," performance pet nutrition company based out of Durango, Colorado that makes treats so good that you almost want to eat them. I was first introduced to a sample size of Zuke's "Hip Action" treats, and questioned how "natural" they really were. With the melamine-induced pet food scare back in March of last year, I've been much more discriminating (as a vet) in what I feed my pets (as a pet owner!) and always make sure to read the ingredients on any treat or food product.

Being that JP, my 10 year-old rescue pit bull, has discriminating tastes (i.e., he's uber-picky and doesn't even eat pig ears sometimes!), I thought I'd put him to the test. Well, he wolfed these Hip Action semi-moist dog treats down and begged for more. JP has always been partial to soft treats, and these often contain a lot of propylene glycol (which is a humectant used to add or preserve moisture content of the treat). Upon reviewing the ingredients in Zuke's treats, I was impressed that I understood all the ingredient names and they were quite natural after all! Keep in mind that "natural" is different from "organic" (which must be certified organic). "Natural" means that no additional ingredients are added into the product, and I was glad to hear that all of Zuke's ingredients are natural by definition of AAFCO. I also loved how all the ingredients are sourced in the USA, as we know we have tighter regulations (USDA, FDA, AAFCO) than other countries (hence, the pet food poisoning last year). Zuke's only exception to this is their lamb and venison, which are imported from New Zealand. Apparently, even the salmon in their treats are wild-caught! (Remember, we green-crunchy types always want to promote that people eat WILD salmon, as farmed salmon has quite a severe, unhealthy effect on the environment).

Hip Action: Ahhh... my favorite. Well, actually, JP's favorite. As a 10 year-old dog, JP is fit, lean, and well conditioned... but he still is slowing down from arthritis. I have him on Cosequinn DS (double strength), which contains 500 mg of glucosamine and 400 mg of chondroitin (GAGs) in each capsule. Unfortunately, I have to pill JP each time (by hiding it in a meatball of canned food) to get this medication into him. Zuke's provides a tastier option in these Hip Action treats (dog), which contain 300 mg of glucosamine and 50 mg of chondroitin. These are very similar in size, appearance, and ingredient to the Jerky Natural treats - with the added benefit of these cartilage-protecting, safe products and some blueberries, apples, carrots, and flax seed to boot. That said, keep in mind that most of the veterinary research that has been done has only evaluated Cosequinn (we vets know that this brand of GAGs works), so I can't vouch for the anti-arthritis properties of Hip Action. That said, it's likely the same and is benign enough to be a safe, healthy treat for your dog. For you cat lovers, fear not. Zuke's has this in cat form too. Your average cat likely doesn't need it, but if your cat is diagnosed with arthritis, has had a fracture before, is stiff getting up in the morning, or is grossly overweight, it might be worth trying this treat for Kitty. With only 2 calories per treat, these cat Hip Actions contain 50 mg of glucosamine and 15 mg of chondroitin.

Summary: Hard to find in the middle east...
Text: I bought these and had them shipped overseas to where i'm working... for the price, I would say they aren't worth it unless you absolutely have a craving for them...  These are smaller than the ones that come in the 2 packs.  Won't get them again.

I've tasted all of the different hostess cupcake flavors, and I like this one the least. They have a taste kinda like they were flavored with clear juice from an orange, but the cake consistency isn't as good as the chocolate ones. and the icing is a little more gooey. More orange flavor would have gotten them a higher rating but they are definitely worth a try. you won't dislike them.

Summary: The best fig preserves I have ever had
Text:
I bought these thinking that I would try something different. These are amazing. Fig preserves are a southern tradition. I make my own fig jam in the summer; I will never be able to make it like this.

All fig preserves are pricey and this is no different. This is dense and sweet. Try it on a warm biscuit with butter.
I enjoy this spread over warm brie, served as a spread on plain water crackers.  The fig with orange is my favorite, but the plain fig over warm brie is also excellent.

My great aunt was here and wanted to make fruit filled cookies for me.  I searched my pantry and found this sitting on my shelf, I had purchased it on clearance some time back but didn't know what to do with it.  She used the whole jar to fill her rolled and cut cookies and they ended up being my new favorite cookie.  this spread is the best fruit filling I have ever had in a cookie.  Now I am ordering more to use on toast and to make some more cookies since we ate all of my aunts.

My son loves PB&J I like to be sure is getting the best ingredients. He likes this in place of Jelly on his sandwich. I love this on toasted bread, bagel, cream cheese and tomatoes. the possibilities are endless. Yum!

Summary: Best jam I have ever eaten
Text: At the stop and shop saw couple jars of the orange fig variety stuck behind christmas baskets.  Bought it our of curiosity. It was excellent.  I went back and bought the rest of them.
I LOVE this fig spread! It's a perfect complement to cheese, crackers & wine. Just a tad sweet and so flavorful. I could put this on anything and it would enhance the experience!!

One of my guests bought this, and I didn't try it until I was cleaning out my fridge a month or so later. Very little was left, and it had crystallized, like honey does, but a few seconds in the microwave (without the lid) took care of that problem. This spread has a nice taste, not too sweet, with just the right touch of orange.

In washing the jar in preparation for recycling, I noticed that it had a nice urn shape, with two little embossed 'handles' on its sides. I soaked the paper off of the lid, then cleaned the adhesive off with Goo-Gone, washed it well with soapy water, and voila! The lid is a beautiful lustrous green with gold accents, and no label or other inscription. My daughter has decided to keep this cute little jar for storage of some of the tea that she buys in bulk, so I view the packaging for this spread as a bonus.

We adore this yummy spread, and are lucky to be able to get it at local grocery stores.  It makes a really interesting filling for a cake, and one of our favorite ways to enjoy it is with rosemary flavored Triscuits.

Nice china black tea with a hint of flower nectar from the orchid. Not too sweet. I'm almost halfway through my first order of this tea, and enjoying it more with each cup. Nice quality for the price and amount of tea.

This is the freshest and most flavorful powdered ginger I've ever purchased. My husband puts it in a beverage that he drinks for medicinal purposes, and he's very happy with it. It's a fraction of the price that you encounter at the supermarket for the volume, and worth the extra effort. One bag goes directly into the freezer, and the other into a jar in the fridge. Sure beats buying those little jars in the spice aisle.

Summary: Very fresh, excellent taste, nice ginger "bite"
Text:
I'm very pleased with this ginger - very fresh tasting, which is important since I use it mainly in beverages. The cheaper stuff just doesn't have the "bite" that this stuff does. Excellent!

It comes packed in two one pound foil packs, so it should stay fresh for some time. It's a lot of ginger, but if you work out the cost per ounce, it's much cheaper than the smaller containers of quality ginger, and even a bit cheaper than the generic stuff you can buy at a discount (but worlds better in terms of taste).

Highly recommend.

Yep, best deal for the money, high quality, spicy and No sulfites!!!

I recommend a teaspoon in a glass with stevia, along with arginine and pycnoginol before workouts. Tip: have a chaser standing by...this stuff is hot!

Ginger is one of my new favorite spices.
Put some on chicken, steak, burger.
Mix with bbq sauce or a honey glaze and I'm in heaven.
Also good mixed with beverages like tea.
A versatile and outstanding herb that no kitchen should be without.
Recommended.

Recipes often call for a substitution ratio of 1 to 6 for using ginger root as opposed to ginger powder. This powder is fresher than others I've tried, so that ratio won't apply. It's fresh and penetrating.

Besides the great taste, the benefits of ginger are vast. In some studies, forms of ginger have been effective against a variety of cancers in mice. The show, Mythbusters, ran a segment to debunk so-called remedies for motion sickness. Mythbusters found that ginger is effective against motion sickness even while many others remedies were not. Ginger has been used to treat constipation, colic, gastroparesis, dyspepsia, inflammation, coughing spells and soothe upset stomachs.

There are warnings against taking too much ginger in powdered form, mainly because it's possible to consume more using the powder. The FDA warns that too much powdered ginger can cause intestinal blockage, gas, belching, and that it's contraindicated for those suffering from gallstones because it promotes bile production.

There is no end to ways of using powdered ginger in cooking and mixing in foods and beverages. One of the famous juicing drinks is made from carrot, orange and ginger.

I recommend this item for its freshness and economy, not to mention that ginger is so beneficial in one's diet.

Summary: Great Product at a Great Price!
Text: The product is so versatile and flavorful. I use it to make instant ginger tea, also to cook Asian style dishes or bake delicious cookies. I trust Frontier, they always carry high quality products, non irradiated and sulfur-free.

I love ginger and haven't had it for a few years and I stumbled upon it here and when I read the reviews where people said it was too spicy I said to myself I have to try it!

When I cut open the box, I accidentally sliced the non resealable two 16 ounce foil bags that were in a plastic bag. I don't mess around when I open shipping boxes and I could tell I sliced the foil bag. So I took a finger tip full of the ginger around my accidental slice and WOW! There definitely is a bite to it, but notlike a fingertipful of hot chili powder.

The powder was pale gold which the picture describes and is a lot lumpier. The two foil bags are not resealable. I just cut the top off of one with a scissors and poured them in my containers. Easy pouring.

I took the end of my teaspoon and filled it. I don't know if most put a full teaspoonful in and perhaps that's why to some it was super hot, but a teaspoon endful was plenty for my hot tea.

When I ordered it and it had those choices of a schedule, and the "one time only delivery" I asked about that after I ordered because I'd never seen that before and if I liked this ginger I didn't want to be on a schedule with automatic deductions because who knows if it's ever discontinued and it doesn't go out if you'll be refunded.

This is very good ginger. It's worth the price. It's got just enough bite and it's by no means as tame as store bought, at least with me. These two bags will last months and when the time comes I'll definitely re-order.

If you have room in your freezer, this is the way to buy spices and herbs that you use the most. I love this brand for spices and herbs: all of them are tasty and fresh. Way cheaper than going to the store.

Summary: Strong stuff, and lots of it.
Text:
Very aromatic and flavorful. Not preserved with sulfites, so you should probably freeze what you can't use immediately.

Good sturdy bags that are supposed to be resealable, but mine were manufactured incorrectly so that they can't be opened without destroying the zipper closure. Plan on having a separate container ready unless you have a use for a pound of ginger all at once.

5 stars for the ginger, minus a star for the defective bags.

I've been getting this for 2 yrs.  The only better quality i've found is to buy the root and grind it myself.  This price is amazing, especially compared to the stores ($5 for 1.6oz/45g).  Although I do prefer organic, free-trade.

Summary: Saves a fortune and pure organic gold
Text: We use lots of ground ginger and it's very expensive per ounce. Buying this in bulk saves a lot of money. Plus, I was unable to find organic ginger even at Whole Foods! I try to use organic whenever possible. Herbs are so expensive, so finding organic ginger was truly a "find!" It's clearly high quality and it has lasted for months so far. Very pleased.

I had searchced for "organic ginger powder" on Amazon and this was one of the listings. I wasn't sure about the quality since it does not state it is "organic" but it got such great reviews I decided to order and see. I have received my package and I have not opened it nor have I used it. I called the # on the bag to see if it was at least "pesticide free" or such.  I've confirmed with the lady at customer service that it is conventional, not pesticide free, not organic. This is of course fine for those who don't need/want an organic product this seems to be great according to past users.  However if you want an organic product, you can find this same item - in organic form- at iherbs.com.  I've placed my order today and will await my package. As for this one, I'm just going to return it.

Summary: strong aroma, decent flavor, but not great
Text: Really liked that it is grittier than most, so it is easier to pour and scoop out, but leaves a slight residue when dissolved in liquid. Probably fantastic for cookies or sauces. My Ginseng is so fine, that it plops out in  big clumps. Decent product at a very good price. Foil bag would keep it fresh for a long time, but I immediately put in a resealable jar for convenience.
So happy that I bought this. The ginger is strong and pungent. Excellent! I use it in all my cooking and in smoothies.

Every bit as good as what you buy in the grocery store, but only a fraction of the cost. If you can can split the order with a friend, the deal is even better. I like preparing Asian style food and use a lot of ginger when I cook. The 2oz or 3oz containers at the grocery store get expensive. This is a great value! Caution - This is a lot of ginger!

This is a really great ginger powder. Tried other brands and were put off because of the quality? Try this one! You'll love it. It's very potent and hot and that's exactly what ginger lovers like me look for. It's also cheaper than buying at a natural store. You can't beat the potency or quality.

5 stars all the way!
Such a reasonable price and very flavorful ginger. You'd have to pay a lot more per ounce in the store. I put it in green tea, and add it to baking items. It is very healthful.

Summary: Very Good Quality! Excellent Taste & Purely Delightful.
Text: This Organic Ginger powder is a excellent product for a good price & you just can't beat what you get for the money & the quality of the powder is unparalleled. I love this stuff. It last forever. I kept one pound bag out & the other 1 pound bag I put in my chest freezer. I will definitely be purchasing more of this wonderful A grade organic ground ginger. I put a tablespoon of it in my tea, I put a tablespoon of it in a glass of water with 1 tablespoon of organic ground wheat grass powder with real lemon & 1 heaping tablespoon of Honey Gardens Raw Honey, 2-Pound Glass Bottle or the other honey I use is YS Royal Jelly/Honey Bee - Raw Honey, 22 oz gel. I also put a Tablespoon of it sometimes in my green smoothies sometimes. Simply Wonderful & I am truly enjoying the taste of this yummy Ginger.
If you use a lot of ginger like I do....this is a great deal !!! Taste great, quality product!!!! I would buy this product again.  Use it for cooking. brewing teas and for bath salts.

Summary: 7 lbs. of Milk Bone Dog Biscuits!
Text:
The price was great for 7 lbs. of Milk Bones plus free shipping!

With three dogs of our own, plus a foster pup I am house-training, it is great to have this many biscuits on hand by the door.

Great value, plus it's one thing I won't have to worry about buying for quite a while. My foster dog has graduated from Milk Bone Minis (great for training purposes). These can also be broken up so that the treats last longer.

We have 4 dogs and all love these little nuggets of delight!  Our dogs range in size from toy poodle (10 pounds) to Husky (about 55 pounds) and these treats are exactly the right size for all.  We used to buy these at a super saver retail club but they quit carrying them.  Their loss and our gain as we found Amazon has them for considerably less and delivers right to the door.  All boxes to date were fresh (well within their "Best by" dates) and well packed.  These  treats make great rewards and pacifiers--we'd be lost without them!
My little dog loves treats. Always expect one in the mornings. This is a good treat for him and he seems to really enjoy them so I have to assume they are good.
THE MILK BONE DOG BISCUITS CAME 2 DAYS EARLIER. THIS IS SECOND OF MILK BONE DOGS BISCUITS. MY DOG LIKE THE MILK BONES BISCUITS.Milk Bone Biscuits for Small and Medium Size Dogs, 7-Pound

I have a Westie and a Cairn Terrier so I go through a LOT of milk bones. My dogs love these multi flavor variety. It's my second time purchasing this and the first time I got them I wasn't sure how much milk bones were in 7 pounds, but trust me, it's a lot! I feed my two dogs on average 2 or 3 bones a day and the first box lasted about 5 months! My only complaint would be about the packaging. There is no way to close the top of the box all the way once it's open. I don't have a large enough canister to accommodate all 7 pounds so to keep them fresh so I just had to use 4 gallon size ziplock bags. It would be nice if the box top was like the smaller boxes of milk bones and had a tab so you could keep it closed.
I give me dog one of these and he goes right in his crate.  It's great for training.  I will also give him one to reward him for doing something good.  He loves milkbones.

Having four dogs, it is a pain, never mind expensive, to buy small boxes of biscuits at the grocery store.

This is a great value and means we don't need to buy so often. Although these are for small and medium dogs, I can break one up into four pieces to keep the calories down and make the box last longer.

Highly recommend!

Our dog loves these and gets probably 10-15 per day.  She is a 70 lb dog, so we use this small size to reward her without over-feeding her.  Note that this is a very large box, and is a good value.  I would guess it has about 4 times as many biscuits as the size box you would normally find at a grocery store, but at only twice the price.
My dogs love 'the b word'; biscuits.  These are the right size treat for standard dachshunds, and the price is quite reasonable.

Summary: Bib box of goodies for Fido!
Text: What a wonderful find online...a big box of treats for our dogs, and the bones we love!  Shipped fast and friendly.
The biscuits arrived on time in excellent condition. I was very pleased with my purchase. I will order them again in the future.

We have two small dogs and they really enjoy the bisquits!Sometimes my two dogs are like cats being picky about what they eat!!!

Text: I have a bowl of this for lunch pretty much every day. Delicious, savory, crunchy, nutritious, satisfying, and fills me up at about 100 calories. Can't get much better than that! Best strawberry tasting jelly beans ever!  Used maroon/red and orange for a college colors grad party and they tasted great!

Summary: Great butter taste with no hydrogenated oil
Text: This is a wonderful oil to pop corn over your stovetop.  I buy it because it's got a real butter taste, but also because it has NO HYDROGENATED OIL!  It's nearly impossible to find microwave popcorn that isn't manufactured with hydrogenated oil and so I pop fresh Orville Reddenbacher popcorn with this popping oil.  Popping corn fresh gives a fresher taste and I can control the additives, like this healthy butter flavored alternative oil.  Great product!
This oil makes the best popcorn even better, like the popcorn you get at the theater or ballpark.

Summary: GREAT POPPING OIL, BUY IT ELSEWHERE!!
Text: This is a very nice popping oil made from soybean oil. Makes one of the best tasting popcorns I have made. A medium body oil. They say you can use it as a topping oil as well, but I like the popcorn just the way it comes out using the oil as a popper. Please, Hometown Favorites $36.50 for 4 bottles?? I can buy it at WalMart for $3.25 a bottle and sell it myself for 100% profit and it wouldn't cost nearly as much. Gotta love these greedy people. I can't believe these companies stay in  business charging these outrageous prices. Oh well, I guess you're not forced to buy from them, thank goodness.

Summary: Available elsewhere for much, much less
Text:
First, with 0mg of cholesterol, this is a great alternative to butter. It really enhances the taste of popcorn without the health worries.

Second, it is grossly over-priced on Amazon. Just go to your local Walmart and get it for less than three dollars for a 16oz bottle.

I've been on a long quest to make awesome theater type popcorn at home. This stuff is one of my tools for what I've finally tinkered into a great substitute for the $10 a barrel stuff you get at the multiplex these days.

Here's how: I use a stir crazy type popper (a whirly pop works too). I throw in coconut oil, not this product and let it melt, since it's usually solid at room temp. Sprinkle with the appropriate amount of Flavacol & add kernels. Let pop. Drizzle with Orville's Butter Flavor Popping and Topping oil, sprinkle with fine dust of Flavacol again. AMAZING.

Now, I wouldn't name this stuff popping and topping for theater type popcorn, because you need to pop in the coconut oil. Second, you might be able to get just SLIGHTLY better topping flavor in another buttery product, but they're almost all 100% trans fat, this has none... so this wins. Yum!

The product is great, but at $30.25 for four bottles?
I can get it at half that price at the grocery store!
Adjust your price accordingly, PLEASE.
This is a great product.  Came just in time for using at Christmas and New Year's.  The product works great in the recipe for which I purchased.

I bought a bottle of this at the grocery store for around $4. It seems to have virtually no flavor. I sprinkled a bit more on, still no flavor. I'm just going to use the rest as I would any other vegetable oil.

Summary: Tasty oil but a little pricy here!
Text: I agree with the other reviewers here. This is tasty stuff, but my gosh, I bought 3 bottles of this at Wal-Mart the other day for $2.98 a bottle. Unless you live on Mars, I'd get it elsewhere.

Summary: Horrible "taste" if it even has one.
Text: Like the title says, no flavor what so ever, unless bland oil is a flavor. Might be some kind of oil to be used for popping but as for topping goes this might as well be vegetable oil, how can people like this stuff?

This is nasty stuff. When you compare to the great oils out there, this stuff is like using oil from your car. The best I have found to date, that also gives your popcorn that theater butter taste is from Wabash Valley Farms Real Theatre Popcorn Popping Oil. Even my teenager can tell the difference.

i've lived in chicago all of my life, and, maurice lenell cookies were a big part of my childhood. i know maurice lenell cookies, these are not maurice lenell cookies. they do not look like them, they are not shaped like them, and every cookie in the box was broken. you could not have more efficently broken the cookies if you had taken a sledge hammer to them. disgusted in illinois.

I was making seitan the labor intensive way, from flour - rinsing, wringing, rinsing, wringing. There had to be a better way and I'm glad to have discovered gluten flour. My favorite food to make with gluten flour is sausages. There are many recipes on the web. I make a batch and freeze some for later.

The price here at Amazon was the best! This is difficult to find at local supermarkets and when I did find it, it was $5+ a bag.

Since I purchased bulk I was concerned with the product getting rancid. I've had no problem with spoilage yet after 6 months of storage. I'm happy with this product and plan on repurchasing when I run out.

I have found a whole new resource for my nutritional diet products.
The Spearmint Leaf is only one of the many health food items that I purchase.
The quality of the items is excellent. The packaging is such that it's what I
call user-friendly. Amazon.com is my primary source for maintaining my diet.

Wow! Usually I am skeptical when a food is labeled as spicy.  Color me wrong with these chips.  A few of these were enough to get my mouth burning.  All that concentrated capsaicin in your mouth activating your pain receptors..yes..it doesn't get better than that!  I highly recommend these chips if you're into spicy food.  By the way, these chips were quite tasty as well.
My husband and sons love these chips.  They are so hard to find here in LA .  It took one of my sons 2 days to eat a small bag.  He commented, "these chips are #$@% great.

Summary: All That & A Bag of Blair's Habanero Chips
Text: I received these wonderful chips yesterday in the mail, as I had been passively looking for them for quite some time.  They are awesome.  Hot and spicy taken to a new level, is what they are.  The flavor is equally awesome.  If you don't like spicy food, beware.  But if you do like spicy food, you'll be turned out and taken to a new level eating these chips.  Word of advice. Savour each and every chip slowly, as you will certainly have to take a break if you eat them like regular spicy/barbecue chips.

I received these chips yesterday in the mail.  What a pleasant surprise.  They have a little Bar-b-que flavor and the kick doesn't start till the third or fourth one.  Yes, they get a little warm on the tongue and lips toward the middle of the bag. (I had to put them down for a while).  But the flavor is awesome..!  They are kettle cooked and thick and crunchy - I recommend them... and am going to place another order today.

Summary: Not as good as others, to my taste
Text:
I first encountered Balsamic Cream in England a few years ago. When I was in Italy March 2008, I bought Mazzetti Balsamico Cremoso at a grocery store, which was wonderful and reasonably priced. Earlier this year I bought a couple varieties on Amazon, and I just bought a few more for holiday gifts, not all of which are making the cut! Here are my personal views of the ones I bought:

#1 Casa Rinaldi Crema di Balsamico Blanco (white). This is not the dark Balsamic Cream I have had before, but of all the ones I've now tasted, this is my favorite. It is the perfect balance of vinegar and sweet, the texture is thick, but the flavor is light. Wonderful! ($11.95 for 8 oz from [...])

#2 De Negris Balsamico Glaze - also a great flavor, balancing vinegar and sweet, but much thinner texture. Fine for dipping bread etc. ($11/7.3 oz) ($10/13.5 oz on Amazon)

#3Da Magreta Acetaia Real Crema di Aceto Balsamico di Modena (Glaze of Balsamic Vinegar of Modena): second best flavor and thicker ($23/16.9 oz)

#4 Modenaceti Balsamic Gkaze: thicker, good flavor, but more grapey than the others above. (3x13.5oz for $28)

I also tasted Earthy Delights, which was thick and more tangy/vinegary than the others above. I'll use what I have, but probably not buy more. $14.50/500ml

For my taste I would not again purchase Mussini Crema di Aceto Balsamico di Modeno (Glaze of Balsamic Vinegar of Modena - sweet, grapey, caramel-y" and don't know what to do with Roland Balsamic Glaze (thick, but very, very vinegary - ugh).
Use this as a salad dressing substitute.  Delicious without any fat calories.  Like the squeezable bottle too.

A friend gave us a bottle of this and told us to treat it as an expensive treat.  It is not all that expensive and just a little transforms broccoli, potatoes, chicken into a fancy taste treat.  I am ready to order the three pack now and keep in on my shelf!  Wonderful.
Excellent. I put on everything: chicken, fish, salad, etc.  No limits to what this adds flavor to...  You  won't be disappointed!

This was fabulous! I tried a balsamic glaze with olive oil and bread at this wonderful cafe and was hooked! I had to get some for myself. It has a great balance of sweet with vinegar, and goes wonderfully with a caprese salad. Definitely a must have for foodies! Enjoy!

Excellent product. It is very smooth in taste and really has no vinegar after taste.
Great for chicken, fish, or salad dressings.
the best balsalmic vinegar I have ever found on the market.
I enjoy it with string cheese, but if you really want to get wild take vanilla ice cream topped it with strawberries and drizzle this glaze on top.

This glaze is really good - very smooth and sweet flavor. Pours beautifully. I found it in stores a couple of years ago but now it seems no one carries it. My only complain is that these three huge bottles have an expiration date that's the same as the bottle I bought probably 2 years ago. That's kind-of frustrating. But other than that - love this!

My kids loved the Trader Joe's version of balsamic glaze on their sandwiches (mozzarrella, basil, and tomato) , but then Trader Joe's discontinued it, and we ran out of our home stash, so I bought the Modenaceti.  Because it is not as sweet as the Trader Joe's, my kids don't like it quite as much, but it's still good.  I haven't tried any other brands.

This glaze is delicious. My daughter lives in Italy and sends me PONTI glaze. I was very frustrated when I couldn't buy it here in the USA. So I took and chance and purchased MODENACETI;3 bottles. What a wonderful surprise to read the label and see it is made by PONTI. I have since found MODENACETI at Kroger/Fry's, but the bottles are smaller and more expensive. Thank you AMAZON!

We use this balsamic glaze to add that perfect, elegant touch to our savory breakfast items served at the Aska Lodge B&B in Blue Ridge, GA.  The squeeze bottle makes it so easy to use, and the taste is wonderful... makes for a big WOW factor with the guests~!

I use balsamic vinegar a lot so when I saw this product it looked like something to try.
I Love it!
Convenient to use. Adds that great flavor to meats, vegetables and almost anything that neds just that special touch of balsamic!

This is the best balsamic glaze we've ever had.  Compares to the very expensive brands you find in high priced specialty stores.  It's the perfect balance between sweet and balsamic - not to "vinegar-y".

Summary: Excellent product, cute shape, goodbye Kraft blue box!
Text: We stopped buying the Kraft mac n' cheese once we got started on Annie's products. The kids love Arthur, and thought it was pretty cool to have Arthur shaped mac n' cheese (they are all Arthur heads, no Buster, D.W. or other Arthur faves). The cheese sauce tastes more like real cheese than the sweet, overprocessed Kraft sauce. Once you acquire a taste for Annie's, there's no going back! On the other hand, the kids' friends who come over for lunch often turn up their noses at our Annie's mac and cheese, because they are so accustomed to Kraft or the like. I like that Annie's are all-natural, too, but it's mainly the taste that keeps me coming back for more.

Great tasting organic product! I have been on a somewhat organic diet since I was a child. My parents always had an organic garden and now I have one. My son also loves organic food and this was a great alterative to regular store brands with character pasta.

Adding organic sour cream or extra cheese to it just enhances the taste. Amazon is a great way to purchase this product if you do not have a Fresh Market or a health food store in your area.

Summary: This blows Kraft mac and cheese away!
Text: My family loves this mac and cheese.  I orginally bought it because it's 'totally natural' but we love it for the taste.  We won't eat any other mac and cheese - we're hooked!

Summary: Great tasted even adults will love!
Text: The cheese tastes wonderful. Once you try this cheese, you'll think Kraft tastes so artificial. I love that I can let my daughter and son eat mac and cheese when they want. It's healthy and nutritious. I eat the leftovers, when there are some!

When I am stuck for something to make for the grandkids (who all eat something different), this is my reliable stand-by for all of them for breakfast, lunch or dinner.  Have to make more than 1 box though.

love this stuff-don't feel guilty about feeding the kids mac and cheese with this one! i add pureed carrots to it, too, since my youngest refuses vegetables of any kind. Summary: Artificial taste and smell. Naturally flavored with other natural flavor (?)
Text:
This syrup is as fake as they come. There is absolutely nothing in it that has to do with a real raspberry fruit, not even remotely.
It tastes horrible, it smells a little bit better, it is full of bright red dye. Sugar free version has a weird aftertaste, though I have not tried a regular one in order to compare two.
If you care about what you consume, do not buy this. If I were told that for the rest of my life I cannot use sugar or use this in my drinks or as a food topping, I would go sugar free.
It is a pathetic excuse for a raspberry syrup. Honestly, a food for hummingbirds I bought earlier (Mills Brothers Hummingbird Food) has better ingredients and smells better than this.

I cannot wait for the regulation agencies to enforce some kind of a standard for food related purchases made online.
To begin with, every product should clearly list all ingredients from the label (or having a photo of the back side of the label would be sufficient too).
Then, going step further, I would want all food companies to show % of every ingredient used in their products.
There is a reason why every 3rd American is considered to be obese. There is a reason why there are so many people with diabetes and other diseases. From 1980 through 2010, the crude prevalence of diagnosed diabetes increased by 176%(!). It is what we consume. Lately, we consume pretty much preservatives and different dyes while food companies shamelessly pocket extra profit.

Ingredients for this DaVinci Raspberry syrup are
water, natural flavor, cellulose gum, sucralose (splenda brand), sodium benzoate (preservative), citric acid, red 40, blue 1

The front label states "Sugar free Raspberry Syrup Naturally flavored with other natural flavor." You can add an extra line and write "which has nothing to do with raspberries or anything natural".

All 3 bottles will go straight to the garbage. A costly mistake to make, but I cannot blame anyone but myself for buying this syrup without finding out what it consisted of.

We have been using DaVinci sugar-free products for a couple of years now, and are very happy with them.  We use them in coffee, over sugar-free ice cream, and on whole-grain waffles.  We would recommend this product.

I regularly use DaVinci Syrups mostly because of sugar restriction and avoiding insulin response.

I find the raspberry flavored syrup very useful and of course tasty.

If you need a satisfying dessert treat try adding it to a cubic inch of warmed-up cream cheese and a sprinkle of stevia sweetener extract.

Also, a raspberry vinaigrette is very good. I make it with the raspberry syrup, some olive oil,cider vinegar and stevia. Mix briskly and add to you salad. Again, it's no sugar ,no calories no carbs but taste great.

~Enjoy
