She makes a bit of a mess, but since when does anything involving baby feeding clean? I love these and so does my little Autumn!
My then-8mos-now-9mos loves these. He only has two going on 5 teeth and devours these. They dissolve quickly so I just hand him a whole wafer to munch on.

My biggest issue with these is that mommy can't stop eating them! They are so yummy, and gluten free too! They keep baby occupied for quite awhile and they dissolve so baby doesn't need a bunch of teeth to eat them. They don't make a big mess either. Love em!

My 7 month old son liked the taste but immediately bit off a huge chunk and began to choke. I had to get it out myself because it doesn't dissolve fast enough. My 9 month old nephew did the same thing. I don't consider these safe for babies.

Summary: Don't care if they come from outer space!
Text: My son loves these crackers. He started eating them around 7 months. I would break them into little pieces and put them in his mouth. Now at almost 9 months, he feeds himself the whole cracker! My husband didn't like it at first that the product came from china (the dude is Chinese!) but then realize its a big known company so I guess he's ok with it now. More like he's not getting rid of this product cuz it's the only thing that will calm our baby down during his tantrum! Anyhoo..love this stuff!
My baby loves these!  They are just the right size too!  I bought a case of these and soon had to buy more!

My twins are now 9 months old.. Have been snacking on these for a few months and they love the fact that they can hold their snack, it buys me a few minutes while they're in their high chairs. Banana flavor is their fav.
I ordered two boxes. Expiration date ws only 2 month left. My baby is 14 month now. I believe he can not finish it eventhough i feed him this as an main food.

My 9 month old son loves these crackers!  They are a nice addition to the homemade baby food I feed him.  They are crunchy, and perfect for babies who are teething.  They also melt in your mouth, making them fun to eat.  I've tried them and found the banana flavored ones to be delicious!  Our dogs even wait by the high chair to steal one away!!
My 12 months old son love it, he loves all the favor. It is a MUST item in our diaper beg.

My daughter LOVES these treats.  My sister in law had given me half a box because my nephew was too big and eating other snacks.  I had to run out to buy more because she absolutely loves them.  My baby is 9 months now, and these have really helped with her learning to chew larger bites of food.  They melt in the mouth a little so you don't have to worry about choking.  They have a great banana flavor that is not too sweet.  I could not find these in my supermarket and the price here is better than target, especially if you use the subscribe and save!

I love the shape and size of these Mum-mums!  They're big and flat, so my baby can easily hold it and feed himself.  They dissolve in his mouth, so I don't have to worry about him choking.  There's not much to its taste.  To me, it resembles banana-flavored styrofoam, but my kids LOVE them--even my older toddlers!
This is a great first cracker...dissolves almost instantly in the baby's mouth, great shape for tiny hands, lightly flavored, and not expensive.

I give these to my little one all the time and I think they are great. I also purchased the veggie ones and he loves them. They are easy for him to handle and feed himself and he likes that they crunch. He is giving me some trouble with eating things with texture so I am pleased that he likes these and for the most part they are healthy. I would rather him have these than cookies or chips.

I bought Mum-Mums for my (now) 6 yr old daughter when she was an infant, and I buy them by the case from Amazon for my twin 9-month olds now. They have been eating them since they were about 5-6 months old. THEY LOVE THESE. We just bought the Banana Flavor for the first time. When they see the box, they get so excited.
One of the great things about Mum-Mums are that they are not messy. You can give them to them in a stroller, or in a shopping cart, or carseat, and there is no mess. They melt so quickly - great for babies without teeth.
The few stores that carry Mum-Mums are always out of stock of the Infant ones, so I have resorted to buying them buy the case on Amazon, which is actually a better price, and I never have to worry that the store will be out of them.

I noticed that one reviewer gave these a bad rating because they are a product of China, and not Australia as the Product Description says. I am pretty sure that all the Hot Kid products come from China, not sure why it says Australia, but I wouldn't let that deter you from purchasing.

My daughter has been eating these since she was 6 months old! They are great as they melt fairly quickly and don't really pose a choking hazzard. I take them everywhere we go and when she gets bored or wants a snack they are perfect! I also like that they aren't as messy as other snacks.  Luv them!!!!

I won't give this to my baby. Product states Country of Origin: Australia but when I received it, it was made in China. With many recalls for China made products I will stay away for edible things at least.
This product is made in China and not Australia as stated in the product detail.

This is the rice flour for gluten-free cooking.  Unlike other rice flours, the super-fine grind is not gritty so baked goods can have the same smooth finish as those made from wheat flours.  If tightly wrapped, it keeps indefinitely in the freezer so one can afford to buy it in bulk.  I also highly recommend Authentic Foods' superfine brown rice flour and gluten-free flour blend.  My wheat-eating husband says the cinnamon rolls I baked with it are the best he's ever eaten, wheat or no wheat, gluten or no gluten.  If you've been disappointed with other brands, as we were, you really should try this.

Summary: Love the flour, hate the shipping costs
Text:
I still remember the first time I made GF chocolate chip cookies from this flour...they rose, they looked amazing, and for the first time in our allergen-free diet, they had the texture of traditional baked goods...I was sold!

I love this flour, (and here's the soapbox) but I just don't understand the extremely high shipping cost. I requested it at Whole Foods and was told they stopped carrying it/ordering it because of the shipping cost. I don't know much about those things, but I do know it arrives in a box, no special packing (sometimes a bit battered and beaten up), standard shipping. I've checked out the weight on some shipping sites, and even factoring that in, the shipping cost is high. I really wish they would lower it so I could afford to buy this amazing product more!

P.S. After filing this review, I received a $2.75 refund for shipping costs! Woo hoo! Thank you Authentic Foods!

Summary: Authentic Foods Brown Rice Flour Superfine
Text:
I used the flour as a sub for wheat flour in several recipes and it worked great.You
need to use 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan powder per cup to replace the gluten.

I have been baking gluten free for two decades. Using this ultra fine flour eliminates the sometimes gritty texture of regular rice flour. I have used this flour for popovers and flour tortillas with very good results.

The extra fine grind of this flour and their brown rice flour allows cooks to create wonderfully textured baked goods.  When combined with other starch flours to make a flour blend, items bake up with a lovely crumb.  Guests don't even realize you're serving GF foods!
I really thought that I would like this flour.  But everything I make with it seems a little starchy.  Has a kind of wallpaper paste texture, gummy.  I won't be buying this again.

I accidentally ordered this, I was really looking for sweet white rice.  But, I figured it's a gluten-free flour I'll find some uses for it.  I certainly have, it works great for making pasta. I've also put it in quite a few recipes and have found great success.

Summary: the only chamomile tea i'll drink
Text: I'm so glad I decided to try this tea. As a child my mother bought chamomile tea often and I tried drinking it several times throughout the years, hating it every time. THEN, I tried Numi Sweet Meadows(that's what this tea is now called) and WOW, I liked it. Actually, I loved it! It has a sweet lemony taste that keeps the chamomile from being overwhelming. It's easy to drink and is very relaxing. As far as price, which I noticed some other reviewers complaining about, I think it's worth it if you know anything about Numi. They use organic ingredients, recycled materials for packaging, and their tea bags are made from natural fibers. They're committed to being a green company and I'm willing to pay extra to support that! You get what you pay for.
I'm glad I was able to find this on Amazon.  I love this tea and it's difficult to locate.  The item was shipped quickly! Thanks

Summary: A lovely but pricy herbal tea
Text: I first tried this tea recently and enjoyed it very much, finding that it had the unexpected bonus of settling my stomach. The flavor is light and herbal, and you can use each tea bag at least twice for a satisfactory cup. The only thing that holds me back is the price- I wonder if it is the lemon Myrtle (I believe an herb from Australia that made its American debut in this tea) or just the high price of organic herbs. Traditional Medicinals also has an organic chamomile tea (single herb) that costs a little less, if this is a concern. Personally, I wish Numi would offer a large, reasonably priced box of their assorted herbal teas through Amazon Grocery because although I would like to order multiple boxes of this tea, six boxes is quite a lot of one flavor. However, I can recommend this tea flavor for anyone who enjoys chamomile tea, and I do think the lemon myrtle adds an nice touch.

*****

Sweet Meadows is a very relaxing high-quality Numi tea. This herbal tea is certified organic and is kosher. The whole organic chamomile blossoms used in this tea have been cultivated in Egypt's northern valley, and are combined with the finest organic lemon myrtle from the rainforests of Australia. The tea itself is caffeine-free, of course, and has a flowery chamomile and citrus-y flavor.

The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi herbal teas, get it---you won't be sorry.

*****

I was introduced to this tea in a Russian restaurant in WA while visiting my daughter.  It was the perfect tea to compliment a great meal. When I got home, I looked for it and as usual when I go hunting for something, ended up finding it on Amazon.  I love this tea.  I have a cup of hot tea every night before bed with a Ghiradelli dark chocolate square. I usually use loose leaf teas, but I feel this is a good quality tea that just happens to be in a bag.  I gave some to my daughter when she came to visit me.  She also remembered the tea we had at the restaurant.  It brings back a good memory every time I drink it.

Summary: Taste nothing like a cinnamon bun!!
Text:
I don't know what kind of cinnamon buns these people eat but these tastes absolutely nothing like a cinnamon bun.
I will never buy a Coffee shop item again. They Lied big time with this one....
For some reason, all the flavored coffees are a light roast which, unfortunately, leaves them with little flavor.  If you are not a coffee lover, this is for you.

ProfileName: Victor Luera "Move along....nothing to see here."
Text: This is good stuff, especially when mixed with a Cinnamon Roll Dairy Creamer. It does not last long in my pantry.

Summary: If you like weak coffee - and doctor it liberally
Text: maybe you'd like this.  I thought it was terrible, and am looking to give it all away.  I don't know why I ordered it - and the same for the "Chocolate Donut" type - because I don't really like flavored coffee, and ESPECIALLY when the flavors all taste alike and the coffee is so weak it tastes like dishwater.  I like a rich, full-bodied (but not bitter) cup of coffee, which this most assuredly is not.  Maybe if you like lots of cream and sugar, and just a touch of coffee flavor...

Summary: Donut Shop Cinnamon Roll - Worst I have tasted
Text:
I love flavored coffee so thought I would try this. This has to be the worst tasting coffee I have ever had. I can't say it even tasted like coffee at all not much less having any type of flavor. Maybe the one I tried had something wrong but now stuck with having to toss out the rest of the box!
Very disappointed! I will stay with my Hazelnut and French Vanilla
This is a great choice if you like the cinnamon roll flavor in a K-cup.  We've ordered it before and have always enjoyed it.
I prepared a cup of the Doughnut House Flavor today. It tasted like water with a crayon having been dragged through it. Yuck.

Maybe its me, but I don't taste ANY cinnamon in the Donut House Cinnamon Roll coffee. In fact, it tastes like a VERY weak cup of bad blueberry coffee. I just got my first Keurig coffee maker a few months ago and have been trying new flavors like crazy. I have to say, this is the worst flavor I have tasted yet. I would never buy this coffee again.

This coffee smells amazing...really does smell like baked Cinnamon Rolls. But it taste like the tray that the rolls were baked on. Pure metallic...not even sure how or why? Just taste like i'm drinking a spoon. Skip this one.

I love the chocolate glazed donut flavor, so I thought I'd give the cinnamon roll a try.  This doesn't have a cinnamon roll flavor.  Instead, it tastes like a weak coffee, with a dash of perfume in it.  I tried adding cinnamon to the coffee (something I love in unflavored coffee) and it didn't help, either.  Yuck.

Summary: Donut House Collection Coffee, Cinnamon Roll, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
Text: Sure disappointed with Amazon as they sent me a collection of Donut House coffee and not the Cinnamon Roll as I asked.  What is up with that?

Summary: Just put some cinnamon in your coffee
Text: Not a favorite of mine, but I don't really like cinnamon in my coffee.  I purchased a Donut House variety pack and this came in the box.  Friends of mine who do like cinnamon in their coffee have tried it and thought it was good.  The coffee brews a bit weak, as well.  I do love the regular Donut House flavor, as well as the Chocolate Glazed Donut (yum!).  Overall, I think people that like a light brewed cinnamon coffee would love this.

Let me start off with the coffee itself which is pretty good. I will say that these coffee's (green mountain and such) have really huge swings. I've bought cases that were wonderful and the next will have a burnt aftertase or be noticably weaker in comparison so realize that these reviews may be reflective of the wild inconsistant nature of the brand...

Now for the major point; 1.04 a cup!? I know K's have gone up quite a bit recently but not that much geez. This brand is a staple at "Bed Bath & Beyond" so you know and is 10.99 up from 9.99 for a box of 18, which is .61 a cup. But hey if ya don't wanna leave the house go for it. Oh wait you can order if from them online as well... oh well I tried gimme my star back.

If I had a choice of THIS or nothing, I'd go with nothing. Of all the K-cups I've tasted - this is the worst. Very weak and if you close your eyes and think really hard about it, maybe you can almost taste cinnamon. Blech.

I know that coffee reviews are subjective -- we all have different tastes and preferences, right? So I'm writing my review based on my own preferences for a light roast coffee with a "soft" flavor (rather than overly bitter or bold). This is currently my 100% absolutely favorite k-cup flavor. While it's brewing I get the distinct aroma of cinnamon rolls. I brew in a Keurig B40 and choose the 9.25oz serving size and think the brew strength is exactly right. My usual method of serving is to heat about 6 ounces of skim milk in the microwave for 1 minute, add about 1 tablespoon SF Torani Vanilla Syrup and froth using my Aerolatte thingie. Then I add the coffee to the milk and stir gentle. It's as good as anything I can get at Starbucks!

This is a Light Roast coffee with only a faint cinnamon like flavor. I brewed this In my B40 at the 7.20oz mug size. Adding a sugar substitute and liquid creamer and it created a mellow flavor with at best a very slight cinnamon flavor. I was expecting more. I will try this coffee at the larger 9.25 mug size and report back.

I brewed a cup at the larger 9.25oz lever and still no real desirable cinnamon flavor. But as a light roast coffee alone, it has a nice smooth flavor with low acidity; just wished they'd would have put just a tad more cinnamon in it

As a serious coffee drinker, I should have read the other reviews. My coffee preferences are Bold and Dark blends. I like a strong cup of coffee and this was very watery to me. I brewed it on the smallest cup size and still thought it was weak.
it smells amazing. But if you like a good strong cup of coffee do not buy this. My roommate who prefers lighter coffee, really liked this one. She can keep the extras, im going for that dark Roast cup of coffee.
And if you arent sure if you are a DARK or a LIGHT roast person, if you prefer your morning cuppa at Starbucks- then you prefer a dark roast. If you prefer a cup from Dunkin or krispy, you like the lighter roasts- so this cinnamon roll would satisfy you.

I purchased these for the 1st time last week and love them!  I also bought a box for my co-workers to try and the coffee drinkers now have a new favorite (and I'm talking about some picky coffee drinkers).  If you like cinnamon and can make do with a light/medium roast I really recommend you give it a try!

Summary: YOU CAN SMELL THE CINNAMON BUNS!!
Text: I first tasted cinnamon bun flavored coffee with Seattle's Best - it was actually named "Cinnabon".  I loved it and was very excited to see this flavor in the k-cups, but nervous that it wouldn't taste as good.  Well, it is just as good, if not better, and I love the smell as it's brewing and running down into my coffee cup!!  Kudos to Donut House brand!!
This is a light to medium roast coffee with nice cinnamon flavor. If you like your coffee a bit bolder, just brew on a smaller size.
I truly liked this coffee.  It does have a nice,full- not overpowering flavor of cinnamon.  I enjoyed it with Italian cream flavored creamer. Yum!
This is very good , is not real strong cinnamon, but was is a pleasant taste, will buy again.
The coffee is tasty, but it has an odd smell. I'll drink all the kcups in this box but I doubt I will buy it again.
I purchased this Cinnamon Roll coffee for my wife.  She loves it and so does my daughter. This is all they want now, which makes it easier for me to keep my favorite "Nantucket" in stock.

Summary: A must have in my collection
Text: My husband and I have become K-cup addicts since I bought him the machine for Christmas. This is my favorite flavor so far. I'm not a strong coffee drinker, and I'm a total sweet-tooth. All this needs is a little splenda and some half/half and the result is a creamy, low-carb delightful treat!

I absolutely love this flavor. This is one of my favorite flavors for my keurig! And I was very happy to find it on Amazon! This one is so much better than the Chocolate Donut one. I recommend this to anyone who wants to add a little flavor to their coffee.

I like flavored coffees - those where you can really taste the flavor it claims to have.  Well, this one does.  It is delicious and you feel like you are enjoying all the calories and good taste of a cinnamon roll in liquid form - only you can rejoice because you aren't getting the calories!!!  I will be buying this item lots more!

The price was great and the flavor is good. I only really drink flavored coffee. This smells more like cinnamon than it tastes like it. But like I said for the price and 24 k cups ends up being a really good deal. The green mountain golden french toast is delicious. So if you either hate this or just think it is okay I suggest trying that.

Summary: Total misrepresentation as far as flavor is concerned
Text:
This is the first time I have taken the time to review something on Amazon. This product is so bad that I consider this review to be a public service. As the title indicates, to say that this coffee is cinnamon roll flavored is total misrepresentation. There is a very slight scent of cinnamon roll while it is brewing, but the end product has absolutely no cinnamon roll flavor. The end result is bitter black coffee and nothing more. I have to wonder if the maker, Green Mountain Coffee, has ever heard of taste testers. Based on the flavor of this coffee, and flavor of the equally bad "Chocolate Glazed Donut", I have to say no. I think I will throw them away and take the loss rather than subject my taste buds to continued assault by choking down the remaining 23 cups. The kindest thing I can say about this product is that it is absolutely terrible. I intend to express my displeasure to the manufacturer as well. For a product this bad it should be possible to give a zero star rating or better yet, a negative star rating.

Based on my experience with both products I will be very reluctant to purchase another "flavored" coffee.

I tried these despite the negative reviews hoping they were wrong.  They weren't!!  Only at the very end of the cup of coffee did I detect a tiny hint of the cinnamon.  I do not know why or quite frankly how, the company ever named it cinnamon roll.

This is great coffee. I usually brew on the larger serving size and it's great. With half and half and sweet n' low it's perfect. Not too "cakey" and not too cinnamony. It is a lighter roast coffee so if you're looking for something that's going to put hair on your chest, this isn't it.

I am normally not into sweet coffee (I drink it black without any sweetener but decided to buy this flavor upon recommendations. It is definitely a sweeter coffee, but I think it is really good. It has just enough of a hint of that cinnamon roll flavor without being too much. It also smells delicious!

Summary: Pretty darn good cup o' coffee
Text: This is a pretty good flavor of coffee.  The cinnamon isn't overpowering and the smell is really enticing. This is a flavor I am likely to purchase again.
Amazing experience every time. The taste of cinamaon and hint of sweetness in just the right amounts. Can't just have one cup.
This is my go to coffee when I need to pick a favorite.  Just a hint of cinnamon but enough to give it a good flavor.
I add international delight vanilla creamer to this coffee and it is so delicious!  It's a wonderful way to get my day started.  Have tried several K flavors and this is my favorite!

My husband got a Keurig coffee maker recently which prompted me to try this coffee.  I've never liked the taste of coffee, but this is amazing!  It's delicious and leaves a slight sweet taste in your mouth after each sip.  I would highly recommend it!

After trying the donut house regular coffee, I was wanting to try other flavors they offered. This was my first venture for other flavors and I was a little disappointed. Yes,,it has all the wonderful flavor of the regular and I was expecting a bolder cinnamon flavor. Sadly, very little of that cinnamon came thru. Good coffee but not the wondrous flavor I hoped for. Now I am reluctant to try the other flavors.
love this flavor but still wish someone would make a mint flavor coffee i know there is a candycane at xmas but i love mint flavor coffee and cant find it in any k-cups by anyone

The cinnamon roll coffee and flavor is mild.  I use the large size brew button on the keurig so that may have something to do with it.  It was a nice change.  I like "Jet Fuel" for my every day coffee.
This is a delicious, slightly sweet coffee with a hint of cinnamon.  The shipping time was excellent.  The best prices for K-cups are on Amazon.
This is a smooth coffee with a good taste.  I don't like overly sweet flavored coffees and this one is perfect.  It has just the right flavor and it is not bitter at all.

Summary: Great Cinnamon Coffee - Much Better than Timothy's Cinn Pastry!
Text: I am a flavored coffee drinker by nature, and I love Cinnamon in most things, but this coffee is delicious.  I have tried the Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry K-Cups, and they do not compare to the Green Mountain Donut House Collection Cinnamon Roll in the slightest.  With Amazon prime free shipping, these come out to about 50 cents a cup, perfect!

Summary: Excellent aroma-almost makes the kitchen smell like you've been baking
Text:
Smells wonderful, tastes great with a little sugar and vegan creamer.
Not as strong as I like but with Keurig cups, it never is.

Summary: Over priced for a lousy cup of coffee.
Text: Timothy's cinnamon pastry blows green mountains cinnamon roll away... not to mention the prices is much better. I would never recommend this to anyone.. sorry.

Besides Timothy's, "Donut House" is my other favorite K-Cup coffee to drink so far.. Taste fantastic, has a touch of cinnamon which I love and just the right strength to get you going in the morning but not so strong where it gives you the shakes.. Highly recomend "Donut House" if your looking for a new K-Cup to try...
While I am a fan of all of the k-cups I have tried, this one was a little bland.  I did not taste cinnamon.
This is now the ONLY coffee I purchase for my Keurig.  I only drink coffee in the morning, and I add a little Cinnabon creamer to my Cinnamon Roll Donut House Collection coffee ...so perfect.

These K cups are delicious... cinnamony and tasty...I have bought them numerous times, and everyone I serve this coffee too loves the flavor. It is not a very strong coffee, but very tasty and satisfying. I will purchase again, many times to come!

I'm not a coffee drinker but my husband is.  I got a sampler pack that included this flavor, and he loved it, prompting me to buy a box it it.  We had a family party this past weekend and when people smelled this flavor coffee they wanted to try it.  Everyone raved about this Cinnamon Roll coffee.  ALMOST makes me want to try a cup, but I'll stick to enjoying the scent of this "new Favorite" in my house.

Thus far this is the best coffee that I've purchased for my Keurig experience.  I've paired it with Cinnamon vanilla creme Coffee mate for a rich cinnamon experience.  Great flavor to get you perking in the morning!

Not quite the cinnamon flavor I was hoping for--it's barely a hint. The coffee is smooth and not bitter at all, which is a huge plus for me. Although I can barely taste the cinnamon, I'll buy it again for it's mellow flavor.

Summary: One of my favorite coffee's ! Delicious great flavor !
Text: This is one of my favorite coffee flavors. It's delicious. Great cinnamony flavor. I dont understand how other reviewers say there isnt enough flavor. Maybe they're brewing too big a cup ( too much water ) for their taste ? All I can say is I use a pretty big mug and I taste lots of flavor. I would have to say its all about personal preferences and what you're used to. I also dont get how some others say they dont taste cinnamon roll flavor, thats all I taste ! I love flavored coffee's but I also like dark bold coffee's, but if dark bold is all you like then this one probably wouldnt be the one for you as it's not a dark roast. Another reviewer compared this to Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry k-Cups....there's no comparison in my opinion, this Cinnamon Roll is much better. More cinnamon roll flavor and not as acidic tasting as the Timothy's. I highly recommend this flavor. My whole family loves it as well.

I am not a big coffee person, unless the coffee doesn't really taste like coffee.  This is really good.  I just add a little bit of stevia to it and it's perfect.  The aroma in the air is amazing from this coffee.

Summary: More like essence of Cinnamon then Cinnamon Roll
Text: I don't like coffee and this K-Cup is one of the reasons why. It doesn't taste anything at all like a Cinnamon Roll. I need a strong flavored coffee in order for me to be able to drink it.  It kind of reminds me of taking medication. I only bought this coffee because I am currently on a diet and this is pretty much all I can have in the morning. Maybe it is because I can't have any creamer, but just adding Truvia doesn't help the taste of this coffee. With that said if you love chocolate then you will LOVE Donut House Chocolate Glaze Donut Flavored coffee (with a couple packs of Truvia it taste like eating a Chocolate Glaze donut) and Donut Shop Coconut Mocha (OMG...this taste exactly like Hershey's Mound Candy Bar...I feel guilty drinking it, LOL).

I tried this, despite some of the negative reviews, since the positive reviews outweighed the bad ones. But it looks like the negative reviews have it. While brewing, it has a distinct smell of cinnamon, which got me excited. Note: it smelled like raw cinnamon, not a cinnamon roll. That's about the only positive. Otherwise, it kind of tasted like bad coffee with a hint of dirt. I tired it on all the settings, too - 6 oz, 8 oz, and 10 oz, and they were all terrible. I won't try this flavor again, or other novel flavors by Green Mountain.
I usually drink light roast and sometimes medium roast. This coffee seemed very bland to me. Not only is the cinnamon weak, there is not much coffee flavor.
This coffee is one of my favorites!! It is mild but full of flavor. It is sweet and delicious! I bought it on amazon since I can't find it in stores.

Summary: Just the right touch of sweet
Text: I recently purchased a Keurig and have been very disappointed the the availability of different types of coffee in my local stores, so I came to Amazon. The Cinnamon Roll coffee is AMAZING! Just enough cinnamon to make it different but not to take away from the reason I drink coffee- the flavor. I can see myself keeping this one in stock.
I have at least one cup of this a day and I make sure it is always stocked in my kitchen.  It is a medium roast with no bitter flavor.

I am ordering more as I've rather quickly gone through my package.  If you are like me and like a really smooth light roast, you'll like this coffee.  It could use a little more cinnamon flavor to make it perfect but it is good this way

Summary: Smells and Tastes exactly what they say. The flavor is subtle and elegant.
Text: The flavor and smell doesn't so much as hit you over the head, but elicits an emotional response through one's olfactory senses. Brewing the coffee creates the warmth and smell of a donut shop on a cold's winter morning. Mind you, this is not for those who are looking to be hit over the head with a sledge hammer of donuts. The flavor is subtle and elegant. It's flavored coffee - not a Latte, Cappacino, etc..

Summary: This flavor is "Ok" but it tastes and smells more like Gingerbread than Cinnamon Roll
Text: When I brewed a cup of this coffee, I had my husband smell it (without knowing what kind it was) and he said it smelled like Gingerbread.  This definitely tastes like Gingerbread coffee, not Cinnamon Roll and I would say the flavor is "Ok" but not great.  I would not recommend this.
I love the cinnamon flavor to this coffee.  It is also a great price with free shipping on amazon prime.

I like my coffee strong.  At 6 oz water brew it is on the slight side of strong.  I must say it does taste very nice- smooth flavor- but if I close my eyes and try VERY hard I do  detect the slightest (and very distant) taste of cinnamon.  My friend could not tell me it had cinnamon in it when she had a cup.  Could it be that the flavor is only in some of the K cups? Simply, a nice cup of coffee (average to good).

Summary: One of my favorite flavored coffees
Text: It actually has a mild taste of a cinnamon roll!  I was somewhat skeptical but the product managed to deliver as advertised.  The cinnamon taste is not overpowering and there is even a slightly unctuous buttery taste just as one would get from a real roll.  I will be ordering again.

I have always loved cinnamon coffee, but I could never find a good tasting brand. This combines the wonderful coffee that Keurig produces with a quality tasting brew! There are few coffees that are as balanced as this brand. I would highly recommend this K-cup.
this coffee taste great and taste just like  cinnamon rool,chocolate donut,donuthouse coffee the best ive tasted so far really good coffee.

Summary: Cinnamon Roll?! Are you kidding me?
Text: Yeah, NO. A big no to this one. After enjoying Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry k-Cups for some time, I decided to venture out and try a new cinnamon k-cup. Big mistake! This sucks so hard it's not even funny. There is absolutely no cinnamon here! It's like drinking burnt gas station coffee where you start hating yourself more with every sip, but for some reason you just don't stop. I usually add a little bit of half and half to my coffee and nothing else. Welp, not even half and half PLUS a packet of stevia could save this mess. Tell you what, go love yourself by not buying these hot messes of crap. Try Timothy's instead.

The cinnamon roll flavored K cups are super delicious. I am not a fan of flavored coffee, I usually prefer a flavored creamer but this coffee is so yummy that I didn't even add creamer to my coffee! Talk about cutting calories!

The combination of cinnamon with coffee is, to me, the best invention yet. The quality of this product surpasses all others I have tried. It is not too bold, with no aftertaste. Would highly recommend it.

This is a light roast coffee, so if you are used to the larger brew size, you may want to reconsider. The cinnamon roll taste is subtle, and leaves no aftertaste as some flavored blends do. With creamer and sweetening, it is a nice brew with a great aroma. Just don't close your eyes and expect a tasty cinnamon roll in your mind.

Worth it, but with the right expectations.

This product has a hint of cinnamon in it but not what you would expect by the title. It adds a little step up from regular coffee k cups but for the price I would expect more flavor. I personally would rather by regular green mountain k cups and add flavored creamer to it to get the real full affect of cinnamon roll.

I will never purchase this one again. In addition to not smelling or tasting like a cinnamon roll whatsoever, it also has a really burned taste to it. Perhaps change the name to charred cinnamon roll? Yuck.

I really enjoy this Cinnamon roll coffee.  It's very good.  It's great first thing in the morning. It's a good light to medium blend without a strong taste of cinnamon roll.  Just enough without being to strong.  This is definately my favorite coffee.

Summary: Smells great and that's about it...
Text:
I had never realized how popular Dunkin' Donuts coffee was until I saw all these "donut" k-cup coffee clones. I've tried Dunkin Donuts, Donut Shoppe and Donut House varieties. The Donut House flavor is the mildest/smoothest of the 3 with a muted bitter aftertaste and, of the 3, I like it the least. The Donut House brand comes in 2 additional flavors, Chocolate Donut and Cinnamon. Both are flavored additions of their base coffee.

The Cinnamon Roll smells fantastic while brewing and hints at the promise of sweet tasting coffee. Alas, that hint is all you get. The coffee tastes the same as the base mild/smooth Donut House coffee flavor but has a slight (very slight) cinnamon flavoring (not sugar cinnamon like on toast, certainly not a "cinnamon roll" taste, but more like they sprinkled actual cinnamon spice into the coffee).

I use 10oz mug sizes so I tried an 8oz size to see if that affected the taste. It did make for a stronger coffee taste but the flavor tasted the same, maybe slightly more bitter.

It's not a bad coffee, and I kinda like the milder flavor for evening drinking but if I get it again, I'll stick with the Donut House plain flavor.

Normally, I like flavored coffee.  I currently have about 30 different K cup varities.  I certainly like the Donut House brand.  This stuff tastes like someone wrung out a dirty sock!  I will not ever buy this again.  It is just bad.

Summary: Believe The One Star Reviews - Tastes Like A Cherry Pipe!
Text:
I love the chocolate glazed donut house - and normally I love bold coffee - so I decided since I loved the chocolate glazed (even though it's not bold), I might enjoy the cinnamon.
Wow. I wish I had read and believed the 1 star reviews!
So disappointed - and the odd thing is - my dad smoked a pipe when I was young, used cherry tobacco - and this tastes like this pipe used to smell!
Now I'm stuck with a whole box - so what I do is brew some really strong coffee and then add this to it. It's not spectacular - but at least I don't feel like I've wasted all my money!

I ordered this as a Christmas present for my daughter and son in law. When I received it I wanted to keep it for myself....lol. but in the spirt of Christmas I gave it away as a gift. I have not tried it,  but they say it is very good.

I like flavored coffee and when I first brewed this, I was disappointed by the lack of cinnamon flavor. It was too little/weak. As a regular hot cup of coffee, this k-cup fell short of my expectations. But brewed and set aside to cool and then adding ice made this cup of joe much more delicious. The cinnamon flavoring really comes out. If you also felt this coffee was at first "meh", I would recommend trying it over ice and hopefully, it will become "yum" to you too.
The coffee came on time and it's not too overpowering with cinnamon flavor. I highly recommend it for your Keurig.
They sent me a variety pack that included a few cinnamon roll flavors, instead of the advertised 24 pack of ALL cinnamon rolls.
The smell is very nice, but the taste is a little on the weak side.  Overall not too bad, I just wish the taste was a bit bolder.
Way to go Dunkin!! This coffee is one of the best cinnamon flavored coffees that I have tasted in a long time.  It really does taste like you are eating a cinnamon roll.
Like most of the kcups, they're expensive. Good flavor but mild strength. Just wish they would drop prices on the flavors.  The kreuig machine is the best though.
I am new to Kcups. However after my realization that I am diluting the coffee with creamer. I became shocked at the taste. It is great! Good Coffee
I'm addicted to this flavor, enough caffeine to get me going and a great taste. It's always a treat. This is my go to flavor and guests always want this one, too.

I'd say that 85% of the office loved this coffee, 10% doesnt like flavored coffee and 5% didnt like this particular flavored coffee. One employee said, "I dont like it, it tastes too much like a cinnamon roll!". (what?  I enjoyed it and include it in my rotation of coffees I drink on a regular basis. We have already ordered more.
This is a great tasting cup of coffee.  Very easy to use the with Keurig machine.  Has a great "Fall" taste to it.  Not too strong of a taste.

Summary: OK, but Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry is better
Text: I bought this because I only needed 24 K-Cups and I could only get the Timothy's in a 48 pack.  It's OK, I don't really taste much of cinnamon flavor, and to me, there's a weird artificial aftertaste.  I'll definitely finish the package, but I won't reorder these.
This coffee tastes okay, but it is nothing to rave about. It tastes better with a medium cup. I personally prefer donut shop with flavored creamer.

Summary: Very good Coffee, but not quite the same as a Donut shop
Text: This makes a very good cup of coffee.  Not bad when you consider the price of the K-cup.  But I could not rate this a five star just for several reasons. First it is not quite as strong as a good donut shop coffee should be, the cinnamon taste needs to be a little more flavorful, and makes a great cup if you do not use the largest cup feature on the coffee maker.

This coffee is ok...if you truly love cinnamon. I can only take one cup and then I am done with that. I would buy if one or two were in a multi-variety pack but I will never buy it in a package alone. I did share some cups with my sister, niece and a couple of friends and they all had the same opinion..only one cup needed.

This flavor was a little weak on cinnamon...or it just might be me!!! I had to add a dash extra cinnamon to my cup to get the flavor I like. The coffee note was very good though and if it was not a flavored coffee I would give it a higher score.
this coffee is really really good. full of flavor, not bitter at all. i love it. i get it alllll the time.i get all donut shop coffees. they r my favorite.
I enjoy my Keurig Brewer, so I am always trying something new, really like this Cinnamon Roll Coffee flavor.  One of my favorites now.

Summary: This is a great tasting coffee
Text: I love this coffee.  It isn't a super dark roast and there is just the right amount of cinnamon.  Its a coffee you can drink everyday or keep around for that special occasion.  If you are in love with the darker roast or extra bold coffee flavors this isn't the one for you as it has that great coffee taste without the charred taste of over roasted coffee beans.

I found this particular brand to be very weak tasting.  Not only that, but I could not even taste any cinnamon.  At first I brewed the 10 oz. cup size, which was way too weak, and then I brewed the 8 oz. cup size, which did little to improve the boldness or flavor.  One of the weakest brews I have ever tried.
I have had to switch to skim milk for "creamer" for health reasons and this coffee still tastes good even with skim!

I purchased this coffee for my wife, which she absolutely loved. We will definitely be purchasing more of this Coffee.
All the Donut House coffee collections have been great so far.
good desert coffee or when you just want something different and a little sweet.  it smells and taste just like a fresh baked cinnamon roll.

Summary: Brew smaller cup size for full flavor
Text:
I LOVE the flavor of this coffee but my normal portion size on my Keurig Brewer must be changed to the next smaller size down or it's like drinking water.

The flavor with the smaller portion is really delicious so it's worth having a smaller cup. I would buy again but for a full size of similar flavor I will stick with Green Mountain Coffee Limited Edition Golden French Toast.

I really wanted to like this flavor of K-Cups but it's just not that good. It smells incredible when it's brewing but I think that because this isnt a true flavored coffee you come in thinking its going to taste sweet. Its bitter to me and even the  undertones of the cinnamon seem a little tart. I tried even putting creamer and sugar and still found it to be too bitter. I love the regular and deacaff versions(unflavored) of Donut House coffee but this is not too good.

Found I probably dont like flavored coffee too much. The coffee flavor is a little too light and the cinnamon overpowers it. Aganin, its not the blend..its me. I would have preferred a stronger (medium at least) coffee with a hint of cinnamon.

You guys make a great product, I especially like the margarita flavored mix. It goes great with Florida key weekends, boating, and bar-b-q on the beach... Back to the Appletini, this is my second favorite followed by lemon drop. When I drink these I don't call them "apple-tini's" and "lemon drop", I prefer to use the term "Man-tini" and "le-man-ade ale"

The reason I bought this " besides the three 5 star reviews " was my wife and I love fresh Wild Nova Scotia Canadaian salmon in a dairy package that we get in our local supermarket. We thought this would be similar with the convenience of a spread in a small can.

When we received the Pate we tried it and it did not taste very good and possibly thought it might be out of date. We could not figure out the date on the can so we called the company up. They told us the 3rd number of the 5 stamped on top of the can was the year it was made. The 3rd number on my can was 6 meaning it was made in 2006. They also said that you should not use it after 3 years of that date. My cans where nearly 5 years old. I must say they where extremely nice and helpful considering Amazon is the one that shipped the out of date cans. They said to throw my cans out and they would send me 4 more, which they did.

When we received the new cans, we tried it and yes it did taste much better. But my wife and I both agree it definitely was nothing we would call great, it seemed slightly fishy and did not have a natural flavor even though it is all natural. We did try mixing it with cream cheese which we thought gave it a more pleasant flavor. Because of the three 5 star reviews is the reason I bought it, obviously we have different tastes.

We much prefer the Vita Wild Nova Scotia Canadaian salmon Family Pack or most other Nova Salmon from our local supermarket. Per weight its price is about 1/3rd less than the Pate, plus it has less than half the calories, nearly no fat, cholesterol or carbs.

Note ::: This Pate is made with wild smoked salmon which is not the same as Nova salmon " Lox " which does not have a fishy taste.
.

Summary: Something for your party or reception
Text: I have sometimes ordered this from SeaBear for use at parties.  It makes a good spread for small crackers to complement other food on a buffet.  I would recommend it for parties, receptions, art shows, etc.

Summary: Yummy - IF you like salmon and don't expect too much
Text:
Bought these to try and boost the fish in my diet. I'm used to smoked salmon in strips, so a paste seemed quite novel. I used these in sandwiches I take to work. In a word, yummy! They are a lot subtler and closer to salmon taste than other fish pastes/spreads/pates out there. They also don't stink and irritate your coworkers. (There is a bit of a smell but nothing like opening a can of tuna. If I ate them in my office kitchen instead of at my desk, no one would notice.) The spread itself is quite moist and easily spread. It shows great protein content and is only 330 calories/can. One can made about 4-5 sandwiches regularly.

BUT, keep in mind this is a FISH PATE! It's going to taste like, well, FISH! It is most definitely NOT like cat food - trust me, I have 3 cats to prove it. Just set your expectations and you will be happy. But don't buy it if you don't like fish.

Overall, two thumbs up. I ordered more.

Summary: O K ----  B U T....N O T....T H E....B E S T
Text:
SEABEAR SMOKED SALMON PATE CAN, 3.5-Ounce Wild Alaska Sockeye Salmon, is VERY tasty. That said, however, it does NOT taste like NOVA salmon, ("lox"), as I hoped it would have. It tastes basically like what it is: wild-caught, dry smoked salmon, with a lot of salt, plus other ingredients. The salt is ingredient number 2 -- so there's a lot of salt in it. It could taste better, it's true....but once started, it was hard for me, at least, to stop! Yummy in its own way.....

I think I'll try other types of smoked salmon pate before I go back to the SeaBear brand of smoked salmon pate, (or try to make some myself.) But I won't rule out buying it again... Though it doesn't taste exactly as I would have wanted it to taste, it still does taste very, very good!

U P D A T E.................H O W could I forget? VITA brand makes a WONDERFUL smoked-salmon-cream cheese combination, with REAL LOX! THAT is the type for me! I'm going to get some of that soon, at my local Waldbaum's. (Waldbaum's is a famous New York supermarket, now owned by A&P, who graciously allowed their Waldbaum's subsidiary to keep it's own name. Probably because Waldbaum's supermarkets always hada "family feeling" about them...and in fact, Julia Waldbaum, wife of the originator of Waldbaum's supermarkets, used to famously drop in at all the branches of her store!) I hope too, to be able to order it soon, from Amazon as well! And that everyone who wants to, will be able to, as well!
I love Salmon Pate', its great with crackers or in Salmon Crochets.  I first had this on a cruise and never forgot the great taste, its one of my favorites.

I HAD NEVER TRIED SALMON PATE BEFORE,BUT I LOVE GOOD SMOKED SALMON,SO I GAVE IT A TRY.TURNED OUT TO BE A GREAT CHOICE.I EAT 1 CAN WITH SOME CRACKERS AND I AM FULL AND HAPPY,NOT TOO FISHY AND SPREADS JUST FINE.I WOULD BUY AGAIN.
I have ordered other sea bear items before and they are good just not great. This product is great and non fish eaters like this on a simple cracker.

The diced candied lemon peel is nice, prefect for my needs and the size is perfect. There is no metnion if shelf life in the information but I called the company and was ablt to get the information I needed quickly (shelf life of 2 years - no need to refrigerate). Thank you for the quick service.

Especially appreciated by troops deployed to desert environments during long hot summers!

Pros:
- taste is great, like real ice cream (but less wet)
- requires absolutely no refrigeration
- adequate expiration dates survive delayed shipping
- I can imagine this working great for children wanting ice cream in the back of a car and parents not wanting to clean drips off of the seats afterwards

Cons:
- none really

Suggestions:
- could be made in greater variety of flavors
- packaging a little bulky, an issue only if product is being shipped

This stuff is just as good now as it was in the 80's.
Melts in your mouth & has chocolate chips.
They usually ship out in 1 or 2 days.

The Astronaut Chocolate Ice Cream with Chocolate Chips tasted very good. I would have given this item a 5 star except for one problem. The paper wrapped in all of the items were ripped and the ice cream were in pieces. Thus the but!

I love this stuff. It tastes just like normal ice cream, which is weird at first because of the different texture from the freeze-drying, but it tastes great! It melts in your mouth when you eat it. I recommend trying it; it's awesome!
Fast Shipping and a great tasting flavor,highly recommended if you're a chocolate fan. Great overall experience. =-)

I love dates.

That will no doubt color my review, but meh.

These are wonderful dates. In five bags (one shipment) I found two pits. Too many? Okay, maybe, but not bad.

Add to that, these are natural. No sugar. No pecans inserted. No added anything. Sweet without sweeteners.

I munch eight, maybe ten at a time. I savor them, drink some coffee with them, luxuriate with them. Some hours later, I am regular. I will say no more.

They are well worth the relatively meager expense.

I have not had the pleasure to eat other dates but I have fell in love with these.

Yes they are dry and can be tough but fantastic out of the package but heck I like beef jerky which is far tougher, love these chopped then mixed into yogurt or left whole in a cup of yogurt for a few hours ... just like a big sugar cube.

I will have to try others and sure will as I have fallen in love with these and golden raisins, prunes and imagine I eat a diet that a gorrila would love.

Hooty

The price is good but the dates are a little hard.  The taste is good and they are very sweet.  I will probably buy them again but beware that some of them are a lil on the hard side.  If you plan to bake with them etc than it doesn't matter as much.

Summary: My Family Eats Them Like Candy
Text: Well, they eat them in place of candy. I started buying the whole, pitted dates a few months ago and now my family loves them.  We're debating over whether they're better at room temperature (a little more chewy) or refrigerated (a little harder).  Buying them this way (5 at a time) is much less expensive than buying them from the grocery store.  I've only had the Sun-Maid brand, so I can't compare others yet.

I got one batch that was nice and moist. and another order that was hard as a rock. What's up with that?

I would say the nice and moist ones rated at 4 stars (for the price) and the dry ones at 2 stars (they are still edible)
After reading some reviews on dates sold by amazon i was reluctant to order any; however, these are not a disappointment at all - they are delicious.

Summary: Some were great and some were hard
Text: I read the reviews before I purchased these dates.  Another person had written that the dates were a little hard and I've found so far (3 pouches) that this is indeed true for about half the pouch.  I use the hard ones in cooking hot breakfast cereal or baking so I don't mind as much as if I had bought this entirely for eating.  Will I purchase these again? Absolutely. The price is right and since I use them mainly for cooked breakfast cereals and baking I don't mind the hard ones.  And the soft ones? Well, I LOVE eating those just as they are.

We usually get the Mariani dates, which comes in one big bag. I saw this when I searched on Amazon for dates and thought I'd give the Sun Maid dates a try since they were less expensive (by per ounce cost).

I love plump, soft, sweet dates. Not soft enough to smear and not al dente. In a bag of Mariani, I'd say about 40 to 50% fit the bill.

In these Sun-Maid bags, about 20 to 30% deliver the perfect luscious plump goodness. Many are just a little harder than I like and some are close to dessicated. Very few are so soft that they're smeared onto another date.

That doesn't mean that they aren't good (except for the very dry ones). They are sweet and delicious and my 3 year old asks for some every night as an after dinner treat. I just wish they were softer.

I like the convenient small bag size and I would buy them again for snacking (considering our budget), but with a mind to put the harder ones aside for baking.

These are sweet and rich; one stone found so far. These are very satisfying when my 'sweettooth hollers', it only takes 2-3 and I am free again! To boot, I am receiving some valuable minerals, real nourishment, rather than traditional sweets.
Of course baked goods are richly embellished by addition of chopped dates, cookies, bars etc. I love to stuff them--a walnut, peanut butter, cream cheese etc.

Summary: DATES ARE TOO DRY to enjoy as a snack
Text: Purchased these dates to enjoy right out of the pkg. but alas, they're too dry to eat except in recipes such as date-nut bread.  Very disappointed.  I hoped they would be as good as Sunsweet's in a can, but were not at all.  Too bad--I like the convenience of the foil pkts.  I would not buy these again--BIG WASTE OF MONEY.

Being a diabetic, among other problems; I have found that I can eat these like candy, with no appreciable increase in blood sugar noted in an 8-hour period. Try a few at first, and if they don't raise your blood sugar-the rest is up to you. Delightfully decadent.Sun Maid Pitted Dates, 8-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 5)

About 10% of the dates between the 5 packaged were rock hard upon first opening, and only about a 1/4 of them were of the softness that I expected. I am severely disappointed. Looking at other reviewers, I am not the only person to have this problem.

If you are looking for dates to snack on, I would not advise getting these, however, for using in dishes they would be great and are certainly affordable. Maybe I got what I paid for.

These dates are delicious IMHO. No pits found thus far. My expiration dates are almost a year and a half in the future. No sugar added (very sweet naturally). Good price. What's not to love? Now if only I can develop the discipline to not eat a whole bag in one day.
The dates were dry and tasteless. Only some of them were edible. Had to throw some from every pack. Its better to pay more and buy good dates.
I've had dates and these are not the best by far. There are better options  There weren't chewed like they should be but hard and unpleasing
I've always loved dates & eat them as a snack to satisfy my sweet tooth. These are moist & plump with the occasional dry or seeded one in the bag. They freeze well, too.

Summary: One pouch had off taste and had to be thrown
Text: Of the 5 packs, one had an off taste (probably from fungal infection) and had to be thrown. I'm just glad I tasted it myself before giving to my small child. Of the other pouches, some had sticky dates and some had drier dates - somewhat variable in terms of consistency.  The second problem is that the packaging is not clear - so you cannot see clearly inside. Food packaging should always have clear windows so you can note the quality of the product before opening the package. I prefer dry dates and this product did not meet my needs (some consumers complained about dry dates - but I got mostly rather soft dates - ones artificially humidified which in turn probably caused the growth of fungus in one of my pouches).
Surprisingly dry and tough, though well within the "best by date." I'll try another brand next time.
This is a cost effective way to have an iced coffee smoothie without the high cost.  It is very delicious.

I first tasted the Gold Kili ginger tea at a local Thai restaurant. I loved it and after ordering pot after pot asked the waiter what brand they used. Since the restaurant billed it as a tea, I was slightly surprised to get the shipment and realize tea wasn't involved and that the packets resembled a mix. Don't let that concern you - the ginger drink tastes awesome. When piping hot, I notice the honey taste more and as it cools down ginger becomes the predominant flavor. Ignore the preparation directions - you can easily get a whole pot out of one packet.

My classmate whose a nurse gave me this ginger tea. It sat in my kitchen cabinet for 2 months before I finally tried it. I was not convinced at first knowing how ginger taste however with my frequent asthma attacks, I decided to give it a try and I am so thankful that I did. It was very helpful. I highly recommend this to those who have asthma. Very, very effective. I can't thank my classmate enough who happens to have asthma too.

Perfect at home or on the go, Gold Kili Ginger Drink has been enjoyed by us for years.

A wonderful companion when traveling (simply order hot water), the honey sweetness of this beverage may be adjusted easily by increasing H2O per cup serving.

Note that 'price' in comparison to 'quantity' of this product varies greatly on this site.

Summary: Great product, but a little sweet
Text: This is a great tasting, easy to use ginger tea mix.  It disolves quickly and tastes great.  It also helps settle an upset stomach very well.  But it has a lot of sugar in it for my taste.  I've had some similar products in Thailand with no sugar added, but haven't been able to find them in the US.

I love this product and have been using it for years.  There is nothing that can sooth an upset stomach like this drink, and I really like the taste.  Sometimes I'll disolve it in club soda and it tasts very much like ginger beer. It is quite strong and I've offered it to some people who didn't like it because of that, but that's one of the reasons I like it so much. Compared to other similar products, Gold Kili is the best.  It's the only one I found where ginger is listed as the first ingrediant and not sugar.

I just love this ginger drink.  I discovered it in Western Beef, but, it seems to sell out so quickly, that now I buy it on Amazon.  It's refreshing, and the next best thing to drinking a cup of coffee in the morning!

I was pleased to find this product on Amazon. I would have had to travel 60+ miles to the nearest oriental market. I've had 2 back surgeries between May & June '12. Traveling was impossible. Ginger has tremendous healing qualities to it. My incision on my back has healed 2x faster than it should have because I am diabetic and had to heal the old fashion way. Ginger tea has saved me, helped me heal very fast and prevented me from having infections. It's a bit bitter but you get used to it, esp if you drink unsweetened tea.

Summary: An excellent hot or cold beverage!
Text: This tea was very deliciuos.You can brew it hot with a little sweetener or leave it to chill and serve over ice.It tastes equally good either way and has that nice non-caffeine refreshing effect.

Love love love this ginger drink with a passion, I live in a small city and don't have any African store to purchase this item from. I am so glad amazon have it. I order the 20 count of 3 pack. I have 60 of this suckers and enjoying every bit and cup of it. Love love love this especially in the winter, the ginger clears my throat and just the best thing invented for tea. If you love ginger you will def love this product. :-) am happy happy happy with this product and plus it ships on time. :-))

Summary: Calming with a Little Bit of Kick!
Text: I love this ginger tea! Using the whole package is a little bit strong for me, so I used to only put 1/3 in per cup, but now I'm up to 1/2. Give it a try though, I think you'll like it :)

I love this drink. I searched high & low until I found it on Amazon. I am ready to order more. One of my colleagues has since ordered a batch also. Great drink!
Thanks Amazon.

Wow!  You get a boat load of this stuff for the price.  I love this tea or at least I did when I first tried it.  It has a very effervescent, gingery kinda taste.  Now I think my taste buds have gone numb to the stuff.  And it's about 80 calories per cup, which is way too much for a cup of tea...really.  So I will probably use it only once in a blue moon.  But, no worries, each tea bag is nicely sealed in an aluminum paper-like bag which are all then sealed again in a larger aluminum paper-like bag.  I'm tell'in you this stuff could last through the Great Tribulation and still be fresh.
I love this drink, it has a strong ginger flavor that is balanced by sweetness.  It's convenient and easy to use.
A friend made me a cup of this tea and I fell in love with it! I was so happy to find it on Amazon.com and under prime shipping!

Summary: Royal Canin is fit for a King! (or Queen)
Text: I have a female 1 year old Ragdoll named BB. She comes from 7 generations of champions, all which have been raised on Royal Canin. We all love her and would buy whatever she needs. As with most cats, she LOVES moist canned cat food and eats dry fine but doesn't scarf it down. However, when we put this dry Royal Canin in front of her, it's as if we opened a can of her favorite wet cat food! I don't have to tell you the health benefits since Royal Canin is a industry leader in high quality healthful cat food! The fact that our champion Ragdoll acts like dinner is a special treat makes this cat food worth every penny you pay for it! Best of all there is a formula for just about any cat! Thanks Royal Canin!

I have two Burmese cats, and both of them are being or were raised on this kitten formula (one is 13 months, the other is 8 months). They have been on it since they were 4 months old. I did a lot of research into food recommended by my breeder since we spent a lot of money on the cats. I ultimately decided on this brand because of the research they have done. I plan on putting both of them on the Persian formula (that is for Himalayans and Burmese too) because these types of cats are prone to getting a certain type of UTI and need their urine a different pH.
Their fur has never been softer, they are so active and always chasing each other, they are very playful with us. We always comment on how soft the older one is, just like a pillow, and the younger one is getting closer every day. They eat the food I leave out for them every day, so I'm assuming it is satisfying. I just love this brand and plan on sticking with them, even when we get dogs.

I adopted two kittens and they would not eat any food besides wet food. i bought them pretty much every kind of dry kitten food i could afford and this one was the winner. it decreased their gas which they had with other dry foods such as purina and friskies. they love it Royal Canin and it's the only one they'll eat, I could not be more pleased.

This food does have very good nutrition (and is thus the most expensive), but all of the kittens (six) I fostered over three summers did not like the taste at all, and thus practically had to be forced to eat it. Three different pairs of different breeds (that I had at different times) did not like it.

The first can I opened contained one (yes one!) jumbo whole oyster (about 1.5") and the remainder were chunks of oysters. These weren't whole and then broke into pieces during the canning process, these were chunks that were packed along with the only large oyster in the can! No way you can fit many jumbo oysters in these tuna-sized cans. It would have been better to put these jumbo oysters in one big square can and arrange them like your typical canned smoked oysters and charge $26/can.  For now the consumers would have to settle with the chunks, not whole giant oysters as one would expect for about $7 a pop. Not worth it at all.

I tried a can of SeaBear Smoked Pacific Oysters when I ordered some other stuff directly from SeaBear. I loved the oysters and when I found them on Amazon the price was really good especially with the subscription. The oysters are caught in the Northwest USA and smoked. Summary: of all the varieties, *THIS* is the one you want....
Text:

Summary: Swanson Broth -- the staple of a Southern kitchen
Text: Swanson Chicken Broth is a great product and a definite for the Southern kitchen.  I love these resealable containers although there are so many uses for Swanson Chicken Broth that you really won't find yourself having any leftover broth!  This particular product has less sodium which lends itself well to cooking.  Swanson's truly has the best chicken broth and using it can make a difference in the taste of your finished product.  If you need a quick throw together meal after a long day at work, warm up some broth and add some cornstarch (2T) (pre-mixed with water); add frozen peas and carrots and a can of chicken;  mix all together and pour into a refrigerator pie crust.  Bake at 375 until the crust is brown (about 30 minutes).  You'll have a delicious chicken pot pie without much effort.  Enjoy!

Text:

I wish the price was a little lower on these, but otherwise I think they are great. I highly recommend that you try them.

Summary: Good Coffee, but not espresso grind
Text:
Ok, so I'm a huge fan of Arabica, and I needed something temporary while a part for my grinder is on delivery. So I ordered this in hopes of having something good enough to use for Espresso without having to regrind. . .

First, the beans are pretty good. Very full body, and holding true to that Arabica taste and smell I've grown to love in a nice medium roast. However, I was quite disappointed when I saw the grind quality. The grind is fine enough for drip coffee, french press, and Moka very well. But for pressurized espresso machines, it was a nightmare trying to generate enough pressure, even with a 50lb tamp on my puck.

Again, the beans a GREAT smell and taste, and will do perfect for Drip, Moka, and French Press. However, I needed them to be much finer of a grind to achieve good espresso results. I wanted to put this out there just incase someone had a question about the grind size. I'll upload a photo later showing it on white paper.

This is very good coffee and makes excellent Espresso, especially if you use a stove stop Espresso maker. I use a 6 cup Espresso maker with two heaped tea spoons of coffee to make a full mug full, topped off with fat free Half & Half. Yum.

It's strong (obviously), full flavored and very smooth. One of the best coffees I have ever tasted and so reasonably priced. I've been buying this stuff for years, drink a mug or two every morning and it never gets old. In fact, I look forward to my coffee each morning.

I've recently starting buying it from Amazon because my local World Market closed down. Both my orders so far have contained one brick which was pierced. All the other bricks were solid and hard to the touch because their vacuum seal was still intact. However, the one brick was soft to the touch because the seal had been compromised somewhere.

The first time this happened, I put it down to bad luck and just one of those things. However, my second order suffered the same problem. I'm not a big fan of pierced packages. For one, you don't know what pierced it and for another, the flavor won't be as good because air has got into the package.

I don't know if Amazon themselves received it like this or if something happened to it after Amazon stored it in their facility. Either way, not good.

5 stars for the coffee. 3 stars for the less than perfect packaging. 4 stars overall.

Summary: The ground espresso blend I have found so far
Text:

My personal favorite is cafe con leche as they make it in Spain, where they mix espresso and milk (half and half) and the resulting cup of coffee is strong but has no bitterness whatsoever and no unpleasant aftertaste. So far, I tried 3 Italian espresso blends:
1) Danesi Classic (this is a dark roast, came out very bitter, no matter what I did. I hate bitterness so I had to throw it out).
2) Musetti Caffe Macinato Espresso (red brick) - a bit better than Danesi, but also a bit bitter; average aroma. I was not impressed.
3) LavAzza Qualita Rossa - this was exactly what I was looking for: strong, but not bitter. I had wonderful aroma and the classic European taste. I want to also try the various Kimbo blends, as I heard those are also very good. But this Lavazza Rossa will be hard to beat. Cappuccino or espresso from Starbucks does not even come close! I highly recommend this blend.

Summary: Product appears expired, but truth lost in translation.  Excellent Coffee.
Text:
Based on reviews I decided to try this, and panicked when I received it and the expiration date appeared to be April 2010. Things became worse when I tried to do an automated return, and found it wasn't possible, not with coffee. Thank goodness for Amazon Customer Service Chat! (Something I have never needed before but was thrilled to find they had under CONTACT US).

The rep explained to me the following pasted from the chat: "The date is the production date, not the expiration date. The first letters is the lot number, the next letter is the production month (A=Jan, B=Feb, etc.). The product has a two year shelf life. For a package with the date "API610," the expiration date is September 16th, 2012. The 'best by' date is printed on the left in the format: ddmmyy."

My code was AP1710. I wasn't sure how P=Sept since P is the 16th letter in the alphabet and Sept is the 9th month. But on the left, the code was 300812, so the expiration is August 30, 2012. Somehow the Italian math works.

Opened the coffee and Yum! Great product.

In case anyone is wondering what a melitta cup is, it is a cone made from plastic or ceramic (mine is ceramic) and it has a hole at the bottom. I adjust the coffee filter to fit it and then put the espress coffee in it and then pour my hot water from the tea kettle into it. I add a little nut milk into the coffee and I am ready to enjoy a wonderful taste. It beats dealing with a coffee maker any day. Each person in the family can have their own melitta cup as it is so quick to do.

Summary: Great aroma, rich body and lingering aftertaste...
Text:
I decided to try Lavazza given the many enthusiastic reviews and the fact that this Qualita Rossa is Italy's bestselling coffee. The wonderful scent that emerged upon first opening the brick packaging in the kitchen was overwhelming and took barely ten seconds to engulf the living room too! I mainly drink espresso using fresh-ground coffeebeans and I wouldn't be able to pick out this Rossa from my own fresh-grounds as a prepackaged ground coffee. The scent is that awesome.

I brewed it using an espresso machine and a moka pot. In both cases I got one of the blackest espressos ever with a heady aroma that simply dominated the entire airspace! It tastes delicious too, with a richer body than illy (the only other ground coffee I take). However the strong aftertaste didn't agree with my tastebuds. It lingered on for so long and had an astringent effect on my tongue that I needed to use a tongue-cleaner to clear its traces.

I had been drinking 100% arabica and this Rossa is the first time I'd returned to a robusta blend in a long while. I would attribute that strong aftertaste to the robusta beans. There is none of the velvety feeling on the tongue I get from drinking illy.

This is still a great coffee though and I can see why it is so well-loved in Italy and the rest of the world. NB: It is a very strong blend and it not for the faint-hearted! I will definitely try Lavazza's Qualita Oro someday. That is 100% arabica (sweeter as promised by Lavazza) and probably more suited for my personal tastes.

No regrets about trying this Rossa though. The aroma is worth the price of admission alone!
This is not as good as Lavazza oro, but much better than all those ground coffees you can buy in USA regular stores.

In a separate dish, I mix 1 1/2 t. chick pea, adzuki, red pepper miso, or a combination with 3/4 c. room temp distilled water and a dab of chili paste. I take a couple spoons of hot soup and pour it over the miso, then mix the miso into the soup. Now I don't feel hungry at all between meals. Summary: The closest to real homemade stock
Text:
I've tried more than ten different brands. I've tried things billed as "stock" and things billed as "broth." I've tried powdered and cubed and pastes and the liquid in a box. So one day I tried these.

I was totally shocked. The flavor was large and complex, not overly salty, and the most like real homemade chicken stock of anything I've tried.

The packs look about like what you would find in a BBQ dipping packet from a fast food restaurant, and are about the same size. It comes out of the pack gelatinous, just like real stock is when it is cold (though I suspect some industrial food magic is involved there). It gradually dissolves in the hot water. I found that it dissolved completely with no difficulty.

I have so far used it to flavor grains when cooking them, in a slowcooker with roasted chicken, and as soup. Delicious every way. Highly recommended.

This is an excellent stock! I am so very pleased with the simplicity of preparation and the taste. For those who are salt restricted, this may not be the product for you. There is 730 mg of sodium in one cup once prepared. That is very high. Knorr should consider producing a low sodium stock. I purchase many products by Knorr and I have yet to be disappointed. I made a chicken noodle soup. Thanks to the stock, the soup is delicious. I even boiled my noodles using one of the containers of chicken stock. This definitely added to the flavor of the soup. So, if you are not salt restricted, purchase it. You will not be disappointed.

I was going to buy this product here at Amazon but when I found it at my local supermarket on sale for $2.99 (as opposed to $8.17 per package here on Amazon), I bought it. In short, this is a great product and VERY economical. Overall, it has a very good flavor and did not have that artificial or tinny taste that some do.

As stated above, I found this on sale. Its regular shelf price was $3.99. So, where the $32.69 (for 4 packages) comes from, I have no idea. It is, also, really economical and "green" minded. Each little tub, reconstituted as suggested on the package, yields 3 1/2 cups of stock. That is one ounce short of 2 cans of broth from the grocery store and 4 ounces short of one of those 32 ounce cartons. So, one little package represents almost 8(!) cans or 4 packages and taking up a small fraction of the shelf space. Also, this is stock, not broth. So, there is a more complex flavor profile. Bravo Knorr!!!

Maybe someone here at Amazon will wake-up and realize that no one in their right mind will purchase this product...not when they can buy it at their local store for less than half of the regular price.

ProfileName: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
Text:
I recently found this Knorr Homestyle Stock when looking in the soup aisle for my favorite chicken broth; I noticed that this says "stock" instead of broth and decided to take this home to compare the two. Turns out there is no comparison as this is definitely more akin to stock than a simple broth so comparing would be more of an apples to oranges kind of thing.

This concentrated stock comes with four little packs slightly larger than those little creamers you get at diners with your coffee. The texture is a little gelatinous straight out of the container but melts quickly when mixed with very hot or boiling water. I wouldn't say this tastes "homemade" exactly, but it does have a very good balance of flavors that taste like it's been made with the traditional mix of onion, carrots, and celery, not just a boiled bird.

This stock makes a nice start to something as simple as chicken soup without needing a whole lot of doctoring up. I tried this reconstituted with just noodles added and it definitely tasted more like chicken noodle *soup* as opposed to when I've made the same with just broth which tasted a little dishwater plain. To me, this tastes much better than bouillon cubes as well. Other pluses:

Very convenient - my usual broth comes in large packages which are bulky and heavy in comparison. Much more efficient to store in the pantry (about 5.5 in x 2in).

Earth Friendly: This is also a pretty "green" product; much less energy spent packaging and transporting these tiny containers than cans or aseptic packages.

Easy substitution - most of my recipes are able to use stock or broth interchangeably.

One small quibble is the salt content; my broth was a lower sodium version so I'll have to watch and make adjustments to added salt in my recipes. Not a deal breaker for me though.

I can find this locally so I always compare prices first.

Very pleased with this product and recommended except for those with salt restrictions.

As far as soup bases and/or flavor enhances go, this product, the "Knorr Homestyle Stock" is by far the best that I have ever purchased on the common market. The packaging is just perfect...."little tubs". When you open a tub by taking the sealed paper off the top, the product smells just like a freshly baked chicken. I would recommend this product to everyone that wants to enhance their homemade soups. "Yum"! I actually found this product at "Amazon.com" by accident when I was scrolling for another product.
