Summary: Quality White Tea at a Great Price
Text:
For those of you unfamiliar with white tea, it comes from the same plant as green tea, and has all the health benefits. White tea is picked during a small period of the year, before the buds and leaves have opened. This gives it a much more delicate flavor (read: doesn't taste like cabbage the way green tea does).

For those of you who are tea snobs, this is Bai Mu Dan (aka white peony), which is picked from March 15-April 10 of each year. It is not quite as rare as silver needle, and has a bit more flavor.

I was looking for some white tea for a regular morning cup, and I came across this bag, with a very low cost per ounce. I'd ordered Numi before and liked it so I took a chance and was not disappointed. Mine came in a large black, resealable bag, rather than the paper one pictured. It is quite a bit of tea for the price. The leaves and buds are in good condition, large and mostly unbroken (see my user image for an example), and dried to a nice green color like they should be.

The tea has a great flavor, more substantial than silver needle, but still very light and drinkable. I'd definitely order this again, but I'll be a while going through the 1lb bag.

This tea is has a very delicate flavor, pleasant aroma, and does not leave the after-taste I associate with green tea. I will definately purchase again. I have shared this tea with several co-workers and all of them have also liked the flavor.

This is a pleasant white tea with sweet and flowery flavors balanced by some of the gentle earthy and grassy flavors of green tea.  Because the flavors are so light and delicate, you must use good-quality water and very clean brewing equipment to avoid imparting any off-flavors. This is a relatively low grade of white tea, but it's still an excellent bargain at this price and a great introduction for white tea newbies.

This tea is a mixture of all shapes of leaves, loosely packed and minimally processed.  It has a very good tea taste.  The term "white tea" seems to have a lot of latitude to it--I've had other white teas that are far different.  Overall, it is very good.
This tea does not taste or look like any white tea I have ever had, I will stick with silver needle in the future.  Will not buy again.

I was very pleased when I got an email from this retailer advising me of the potential problem with my order that I had not even considered.  The problem was the unbearable heat that the East coast was suffering. She was afraid that my order,which was chocolate, would melt if not accepted right away. She even upgraded my shipping  and packed the product in frozen gel packs, and planned the ship date to assure that it wouldn't sit in a warehouse over the weekend! I was so grateful and so pleased with the customer service (esp on a small order)I will definately use them again! The product was chocolate rocks. My Nieces and nephews love them! They came fresh, and unmelted!  The kids loved them, and I am still the favorite Aunt!!

Look just like river pebbles. Tastes like M&Ms - milk chocoale covered by a thin candy shell! Great stuff - I keep a jar by my workdesk. Great for a pickup when you feel empty or just need some chocolate.

I was ordering Trail's Best Bacon Jerky, because I am now addicted. I love jerky and love bacon. Tried the Bacon Jerky from a local retailer and loved it. Saw the maple bacon jerky and thought, "Why not try it?" since I love maple bacon. I received it yesterday and it was horrible. It was sticky, fatty, and awful! I was so disappointed. If you love bacon, stick with Trail's Best.

Summary: Too Sweet. Too Fatty. Too Little.
Text:
I bought this bacon jerky after having been delighted with the bacon jerky available at Walgreens. This bacon jerky was about twice as expensive, but I thought that it might be worth it due to delicious sweet maple flavor. I was wrong. First of all, the maple flavor is overwhelming. Instead of complimenting the smokiness of the bacon, the two flavors seem to be in direct competition. Further, the bacon jerky was incredibly fatty and sticky from the maple syrup. It made it incredibly difficult to eat without constantly wanting some kind of moist towelette.

For the small amount of bacon jerky you get, it's simply not worth the price. As sad as it sounds, I'll be going back to Walgreens for their "Nice" brand bacon jerky.

These are the best around. We have 5 dogs and these are the best especially for small dogs. They are not hard like Milk Bones can be. Even our Chihuahuas can eat these easily without fear of breaking teeth. Our only problem, which is an Amazon issue, is that these have exp. dates which were not far enough out for us to be able to use these up by. This info should be posted on listing page. Iams rep says that they should not be used beyond that date and was nice enough to offer coupon for any unused boxes. Exp. dates should be listed on all items that have them. Not sure why they don't do this. GREAT COOKIES otherwise.

I have a golden retriever puppy who will eat anything...anything put in front of him or anything he finds.  I bought these because I trust the Iams name and because they came in a case, I have enough for awhile.  He loves these.  Every time he goes outside he waits for one and when he comes in he waits for one.  Obviously he likes them and while I am still in the housebreaking training, these work great.  I'll keep buying these until he is no longer a puppy then probably change to the adult biscuits.

Summary: Iams Proactive Health Puppy Biscuits, 2.6-Pound Boxes (Pack of 6)
Text:
I have 4 dogs that range from a tiny little one to a large one.
They are totally crazy about these biscuits!!! They won't eat any
other biscuits but these.

Summary: The filling is more viscous than molasses.
Text: Don't get these if you value your teeth. The tartlet filling is very viscous. It will stick to your teeth and you could probably use it to glue pieces of plywood together.
roland tartlettes are difficult to find, particularly as i am partially handicapped. it is really good to find them on line at amazon.com.

Summary: One of the three best coffee candies & one of the worst
Text:
These are a semi hard candy--not hard like a Lifesaver, but like a hard toffee that will soften somewhat in your mouth. The flavor, when it's good, is that of a medium bodied coffee; not nearly as piquant or as strong as the Bali or Kopiko brands but pleasant. However, I have found that from one case to the next the flavor can be wildly different, varying from a nice full bodied coffee flavor to what I imagine coffee would taste like if you boiled it for a while with an old leather belt in the pot. So some cases rate 5 stars and some rate 1. It's a gamble at best.

The pieces are larger than the Bali, smaller than the Kopiko and I doubt most folks would find them uncomfortably large. They are not nearly as large as the Coffee Nips brand, which are annoyingly big on size and disappointingly small on flavor.

The unwrap easily, which is a plus if you like them.

_______________Coffee Flavor_____________Texture
Bali...........piquant/rich/strong.............hard sugar
Rio............moderate-varies by batch......hard toffee
United.........moderate.......................hard sugar
Kopiko.........piquant/rich strong............hard sugar
Coffee Nips....weak/bland.....................hard toffee

Summary: WOW! will be a regular in my candy jar from now on
Text:
Coffee Rio Original Roast is a dark brown, tube-shaped, firmly chewy candy. When you first put it in your mouth, it almost feels like a hard candy. But as it remains in your mouth a while it begins to get a little softer; not enough softer to stop being a danger to loose fillings and crowns. It too is not overly sweet, I might like it a little sweeter. Since coffee is the #6 ingredient on a list of 8, it seems strange that Coffee Rio Original has as much strong tasting coffee flavor as United and Kopiko, but it does. Be sure and have your dentist's phone # handy.
8 out of 10
FYI- United, Kopiko and Coffee Rio were the top finishing coffee candies in my taste test.
God bless. Mike

To cut to the chase, this produces a very good MEDIUM roast style cup of coffee...period. Some folks tend to compare all coffees to one another no matter what the bean is and how it's roasted. I do roast my own green beans (home roaster) when I brew a pot of coffee every morning and use the K-Cups when only a single cup is needed. If you don't like that 'in your face' dark roast, dense, heavy style of coffee in the morning (or any time for that matter) this is definitely the coffee for you. It's not bitter, a bit floral, with a true pure coffee taste. Does it match Dunkin Donuts style coffee in taste? I'd say YES to that when using the middle cup size setting on the Keurig brewer....which I use for folks that take milk in their cup, I use the larger cup setting because I drink my coffee black and like that taste profile. The new packaging is OK (you get 2 extra K-Cups for the $$) as long as you have the room in your kitchen to store the larger single box....as opposed to storing the two 24 cartridge boxes.

NOTE: The description of this coffee uses the words "Medium Extra Bold" in it's packaging as opposed to the two 24 boxes version which lead me to think there was now two DIFFERENT varieties of this Donut Shop coffee....so I ordered both (wanted 98/100 anyway) but it turns out that both were the same. Amazon should correct that description and take out 'Extra Bold' so they match each other.

Summary: My Favorite by a Landslide so Far
Text: I must admit that I have gone a little overboard with my k-cup sampling.  So far I must have tried about 50 different blends.  OVerall I must say that the vast majority of them have been pleasant, better than what I used to make in my coffee brewer.  Then I tried the Donut Shop brand.  When I first tried this I was not expecting much, it sounds bland, plain, everyday type of coffee.  Don't get me wrong, I have had some pretty good cups of coffee in donut shops but nothing to write home about.  When I took my first sip, I thought wow, this is amazing.  Smooth, not much of an acid taste, about as close to perfect as I could describe.  My love for this k-cup continued and continues to this day.  Many times you find a k-cup which at first is very good, but after a couple of cups you get a little sick of them; not with this one.  It has been and continues to be my absolute favorite.  I will still search for something better, but I doubt I will find it.  I hope you like -- no strike that -- I hope you love this coffee as much as I do.

I've had my Keurig brewer for 5 months and have tried a lot of brands and the Coffee People Donut Shop regular is among my favorites. Green Mountain Nantucket Blend and Timothy's Italian Blend are also favorites.

One reviewer remarked about Subscribe & Save costing less. It's only a dollar and a few pennies cheaper than this packaging and Subscribe and Save does not offer Donut Shop "regular" but instead has "Extra Bold". Also, this packaging gives you 50 k-cups as opposed to 48 (2) 24 count packages in Subscribe & Save.

Another reviewer complained about not having the standard boxes to dispense the coffee. I purchased a K-Cup carousel, available on Amazon for $19.95 that holds 26 k-cups; it looks nicer by my Keurig than cardboard boxes.

We purchased a Keurig brewing system early this year, so we've been trying out as many different varieties of coffee as possible. This coffee is -- BAR NONE -- the best of the bunch. It is rich, syrupy and just a bit sweet. My experience, thus far, has been that the K-Cups listed as "extra bold" produce the best cups of coffee, but many of those are only available in dark roasts, while I prefer a medium roast. If you're a fan of a good, old fashioned diner-style cup of coffee (like what you can get if you go to Dunkin Donuts or somewhere like that), then this is the brew for you. We love it and make sure we always have some on hand.

My favorite K-Cup flavor! A mild rather than a strong coffee strength, it really has a flavor reminiscent of a local donut shop or Denny's cup of coffee.
Highly recommended!

Summary: Great taste - poor packaging wastes k-cups
Text:
I love the taste of this coffee. But apparently they have poor quality control. These K-cups come too full and they tend to not brew properly. You can always tell when you got a bad cup, because the grounds are so packed in the cup that the water doesn't come out completely and your cup of coffee will have less liquid than you are used to. Sure enough, when you go to lift the K-cup out of the Keurig for disposal, you will find it is very heavy compared to others. We also know this is a problem with Coffee People DOnut Shop k-cups only, because my husband drinks a different brand and never has this problem.

It doesn't happen all the time, and I have found if I shake the k-cup before putting it in the Keurig, it happens less frequently, but it still happens.

I've tried ordering from Coffee People multiple times to see if it was a one time manufacturing glitch, but it appears every time I buy a box of their K-cups I have a problem with 10-15% of them.

Fortunately, another brand is offering a donut shop coffee which I tried with this last order and I find it just as pleasing.

My husband and I are crazy about Coffee People k-cups.  A friend gave us a box of the "Donut Shop" cups and they are spectacular.  Very rich and bold, not bitter, but packs a nice punch.  Reminds me of coffee from an old-fashioned percolator.  A good, strong cup of coffee is hard to come by when you are using some of these newer brewing machines, but the Keurig system is definitely the exception and this variety of k-cup is the best we have ever tasted.

Summary: A perfect "Anytime" coffee that is sure to please.
Text:
I have tried many, many brands and blends in my Keurig coffee maker and this is definetely one of my favorites. The type of coffe I drink depends on my mood. Sometimes I want a strong, bold cup like, Newman's Own Extra-bold Special Blend K-cups, 80 Pk for Keurig Brewers and sometimes I want something more mild like, Green Mountain K-Cup Single-Serving Coffee 108-ct.- Nantucket Blend But ever since I have had my Keurig I have been looking for one of my favorite coffees. The Dunkin Donut brand.

This coffee is superb and very much like the Dunkin Donut brand. Not bold or bitter. Not weak or under flavored. It is smooth and very flavorful. It is the perfect crowd pleasing blend for any time of day or night.

I have shopped all over and you can't beat the variety or the price here on Amazon when you join their club. A great value.

I do wish that Amazon would change the name by removing "Extra Bold". It is not. It is, at most, a medium roast. Even when brewed with the smallest setting of the Keurig I would not concider it bold. It comes out great on the medium size setting. Very remanicent of that great cup of Joe you would get in the old days at your favorite diner.

This coffee is exactly what you would get at a coffee shop. Sweet and aromatic, not bitter or too bold. I like the pack of 50 and it comes in one box, so there is no waste of packaging or more trash to throw away. If they only made a box of with 100... We love the K-Cups and get great consistent coffee every day without wasting half a pot. My favs are Timothy's German Chocolate (desert coffee!), Donut Shop (mid Morning) and Emeril's Big Bold Easy (first thing in the morning!).

Just left packaging feedback, but upon review, the issue appears to be quality control.  I ordered 2 boxes, 50 count each.  In both boxes, the foil lids were not positioned correctly and the seal was not 100%, causing coffee grounds to coat every K-Cup, the frustration free boxes and the box they were shipped in.  Worse, about 20% of the K-Cups no longer have the full amount of coffee in them.  Additionally, I am not sure that these loose grounds won't impact the Keurig.  I hope the folk at Coffee People can rectify this situation, as this is my favorite coffee, but I will not order this product again without some resolve on their side.
Their dried candied fruit was good and their shipping was fast.  My only complaint is that the pieces of fruit were not cut up very small like I am used to.

I purchased 5 pounds of this product directly from Barry Farms for my grandmother's recipe fruitcakes.  I was so disappointed in the quality of what I received.  Of the 5 pounds, 2 pounds was of yellow pineapple that was inedible and had to be discarded.  The pith of the pineapple was used rather than the good part of the fruit.  There was no way I was going to use that in these high quality expensive cakes.  Also, there was a lot of syrup in each tub, so I definitely did not get a pound of fruit. I ended up having to replace the bad pineapple at a local grocery store for twice the cost.  I guess I got what I paid for.  I will not purchase from them again.  I just went to their web-site and there is nothing there.  Maybe they have gone out of business.  If this is an example of their product, I'm not surprised.

Wonderful, I have tried everywhere to find these products but no one sells except at the holidays.

Thank you!!!!

this candied fruit stuff , i remember years ago, was in every grocery fruit/ produce section of large supermarkets always. now i wanted to make the wonderful  sicilian desert called cassatta that calls for it- the stuff is no where to be found in central california. i bought two tubs of this stuff just to keep in my freezer- dont even try to make your own candied fruit - it so much work. this brand is great and of course, i found it on amazon.

This would be a real review but for one little thing,the item in question was shipped to Belize,but the packing was real nice, delivery time to me was overly long should have been at least a week sooner,am glad that I ordered early.
As to quality of candied fruit I guess it was adequite,will let you know when I get back from Belize,

I have used this brand of cumin for years. It is a delicious, flavorful addition to both East Indian and Mexican dishes. Since I use a great deal of this spice, this large, economy size is perfect for me. It is in a plastic container, which isn't ideal, but other than that, I have no complaints.
My little yorkie loves these treats. He recognizes the bag now and gets excited to hear treat. It helps to potty train him and teaching him commands like 'sit', 'shake' etc.

Though it's really not a macaroni, it's shape and it's ability to hold cheese sauce makes it superior as the sauce goes inside and it's a nice bite size piece of pasta, being about three times larger than a macaroni.  Here's a very simple recipe for Cavatappi and Cheeze.  Use Trader Joe's Shredded Mexican Blend cheese mixed into a very warm Organic heavy cream.  Not too thick or thin (use either more cheese or cream to change the consistency).  De Cecco's pastas are the best dried pastas.

Summary: Tasty pasta in a different shape
Text: The pasta arrived promptly and was properly packaged. I used already two boxes and was excited about using pasta in a different shape. I will order this again.

My boy friend could not find this in the stores. He is a self proclaimed Chef. Well I checked on Amazom and low and behold I found it. He was one happy man. We bought a lot but we eat a lot of pasta so it all worked out.
This Cavatappi is hard to find but what a lifesaver for the Amazon website and its sellers. Keep it coming.
One of my favorite Bentley's teas. However, be aware that this is BULK. The tea bags are not in individual packets.

I am not usually a great drinker of "berry-flavored" teas, and was therefore a bit hesitant to purchase this product (especially because of having to buy it in bulk), but it has now become one of my daily favorites. There are many grades/qualities of tea, and though this is not "the best" quality tea out on the market, it is a great choice for tea lovers whose taste for tea is also slightly limited by their pocket book. The tea has a very nice blueberry flavor that is not overly strong. Not only is the flavor satisfying, but you also have the added health benefits of green tea.

We used to love Trader Joes' blueberry green tea, as it had a great blueberry taste when served hot. I bought this, hoping it'd be as good. It is not when served hot and so we gave away one of the canisters. However we did find that it made an excellent iced tea. So if you like ice cold green tea, then I really recommend it. But as hot green tea, it is disappointing.

We had the hardest time finding this brand of oatmeal anywhere in the states.  We fell in love with it when we visited Ireland.  Had it everyday for breakfast. Very creamy and filling.  Much better than american oats.  So glad to find it here!!!

Bought this on a spur of a moment without knowing anything about it or the company.  I could not believe how delicious oatmeal could be!  I agree completely with the comments below--light, airy, flavorful!  No comparison to what I had been using--the standard brands.  Buy this and you will never go back.
This is honestly the best tasting oatmeal I've ever had. I buy it by the case for family and friends. Also love their steel cut oats!!

I'd had no idea oatmeal could vary so much in flavor & quality before trying Flahavan's. I'd tried regular & specialty brands here in the U.S. including organic, steel-cut, and specialty-mill varieties.
Flahavan's came on the radar by chance & now there is no turning back.
It's difficult to understand how oatmeal could have such a creamy, airy, & delicate aromatic quality but Flahavan's does it. Obviously this is not news to the Irish--but would guess most of us Americans have no clue what we're missing!

This is the best oatmeal that I have ever tasted.  Same as what is served in Europe and on the cruise ships.  I use less oatmeal than specified and cook it 6 minutes rather than 3; has a nice soft consistency.

Summary: Juice = awesome but get a version that ships free
Text:
Nutritionists recommend that you get a serving of vegetables with every meal, but how to accomplish that with a breakfast has always been a tough one for me since I don't like starchy vegetables like potatoes, and aside from cutting up a tomato, few other things go well with yogurt, egg whites, oatmeal, or any of the other stuff I like in the morning. A simple glass of V8 works perfectly. I've always loved V8 juice for that reason, but found it just a tad too salty. The low sodium version has made V8 perfect in my opinion. It has more flavor than most tomato juices, with a nice hint of celery seed. (It also makes a mean Bloody Mary!).

I've only given this particular version 3 stars because the shipping costs are not worth it. With the many PRIME eligible options available for V8, save yourself some cash and get one that ships for free.

Ok, I admit it.  I go a bit overboard for my kitty sometimes.  He was eating Wellness brand pouches for a while, but I felt like he was getting tired of the same 4 (grain free) flavors.  I decided to try this, although I was hesitant about the pumpkin soup aspect.  My boy loves it!  The "soup" is just gravy, and there is a good amount of it which pleases me since I'm concerned about hydration.  The chicken actually looks and smells like shredded chicken that I would eat myself!  My kitty gobbled it all up at once.  I've since tried all the other flavors with similar results. (with the exception of the Polynesian  dinner flavor, which my boy didn't like.)  No fillers, good quality meat/seafood, lots of variety.  I'm pleased!

Summary: Healthy food for your furry babies
Text:
I started really reading labels on our foods last year when my husband started culinary school.
I was appalled at some of the things stuck in our everyday foods so they'll still have taste after
being over-processed, fillers to stretch them and chemicals to make them last for a couple years
on the shelf.

Then I moved on to our cat food. Same scenario!
Cats are carnivores. Despite how great it sounds to see "balanced diet" on the front of
our cat food packages, cats do not need the SAME diet that humans do! They do NOT need grains,
especially corn and corn fillers. Yet, you'll see package after package with the main ingredient
being corn meal or wheat by products. No wonder our kitties get itchy skin, dull coats and
get chubby (fillers fatten them up, just like it does to people!)

I thought I'd try this food, because of the fiber content. Our oldest cat was having some problems
with constipation. Since he really didn't appreciate the petroleum jelly on a Q-tip to help him out,
I started looking for foods or treats that might help. Then I found this food.

I would have never imagined a cat would like pumpkin, but they do! This has sort of a pumpkin soup
base, with real shredded chicken meat. (I took a photo, but it didn't turn out too great. I'll try
again next time I serve it.) Both cats seemed to really take to it, and our littlest cat didn't leave a speck
of pumpkin in the bowl. Neither one really seemed to finish off the chicken for some reason.

I can't serve this brand all the time, simply because of the cost. I know quality costs more, but it is still
a little hard on my budget right now. But, I'll keep getting it when I can, and treating them whenever possible.
I'd definitely recommend it.

Summary: Finding Soulistic is like hitting the kitty jackpot!
Text: If you have a furry feline who deserves nothing but the best, especially if she/he has a renal (kidney) issue, Soulistic is like a 7-7-7 at the slots. Since watching my cat's phosphorus, magnesium, sodium and protein levels like a hawk, I've been lucky to have this tasty, quality, human-grade food to supply my baby with the moisture and yummy taste that he deserves. Any cat would welcome similar spoiling--and this food prolongs his life and awards him a happy demeanor at the same time. Like many others on this board, I take the time to read labels and decide for myself whether or not something is of real quality. With Soulistic, I pull out the magic bullet blender and combine pouch flavors (blue + grey OR red + green), then add some extra tablespoons of water, and produce a nice shake to dole out in his daily feedings. This process makes it easy to add in his L-Lysine powder (from grinding the tablets in a mortar and pestle) and glucosamine to mix everything up and mask any remaining aftertaste. A recent trip to the vet proves that his creatinine levels have dropped considerably, and that even though he will need to be checked regularly for his kidney issues, that we are on the right path. Clearly you don't have to go to the lengths I do for your pet to love these creations. But don't underestimate how much you and your cat will love this food! Finally, the pouches make for the easiest disposal and less volume in the garbage. Only Petco and Amazon carry this food. Great job, Soulistic!

I have 1 female & 2 male 10 year old tabby cats. Both of my males have had a problem with constipation. My vet suggested to regulary give pumpkin and hairball jelly to help them. I want to give my cats only good healthy food so I researched different foods and this brand seemed to be the best. I bought the pouches & the cans. All 3 cats love it! I mix it with their vet food a few times a week and they gobble it up. I also give them the hairball jelly every morning as a preventitive and they haven't had any more constipation problems. I am very happy with this food and will continue to buy it.

Summary: Literally Just What I Asked For
Text: I should have named my Yellow Lab Thief because he seeks only to kill and destroy. (Gospel of John 10:10). He ate the outlets off the back of my house. He ate part of my car...You get the idea. The only toys  he can play with are the solid Nylabone (no rubber , no matter how hard). He even breaks through bones and figured out how to chew the top off a Kong to get the treat inside. But he loves hidden treats. So I begged Nylabone to make a hollow Nylabone and sure enough they did. My Lab absolutely LOVES it. He carries it around and the only thing that comes close is his Frisbee. Can't recommend this enough. There are plenty of teeth marks on the trunk but it's still great and keeps him busy trying to get treats out of the "log." I even tweeted Nylabone a photo. This is literally just what I asked for? You'll love how your furry friend will love it!
We have two dogs and probably ten Nylabones laying around the house.  This is the one they now fight over.  Not really, but if one lays it down the other one is going to pick it up.

I love Nylabone products, but I don't like this one!  My dog loves to chew, and Nylabone makes great products.  This is the worst one.  After chewing on this bone for a while, the little red "plugs" or pieces come out.  This posses either a potential choking hazard, or a possible obstruction for a dog.  I will continue to buy Nylabone products, but this one is dangerous!

My dogs are 55lbs and 25lbs, within a few days they chewed through this bone which started to fall to pieces because it is hollow. If your dog is not a super chewer it might be good for them, but if your dogs gnaw nylabones into shanks like my dogs do, I would not recommend this.

We bought this item for our dog (a pit/lab mix) as a christmas gift. Straight out of the box, he loved it. Its been almost a month and the toy is still going strong, which is saying something because our dog really loves to chew. Be warned, though, it does smell strongly of bacon scent so if you are scent sensitive, you might be turned off.

Summary: Something for the super chewy dog
Text:
I have purchased many nylabones and have had success with dogs that love to chew toys.

I got a new dog who doesn't like chew toys but does like food, a lot. And at the same time, if he does chew something he could easily destroy it. I thought that if I put peanut butter or something like that in this hollow part of the dura chew he'd enjoy working at getting the food and not destroy the nylabone in the process. In addition it has 'branches' for him to help hold the chew bone in place.

It didn't work out the way I expected. It's too heavy for him to want to carry around and he can't get his tongue very far in the hole so he gets frustrated. I'd almost say it's a little too indestructable. Once he gets the food that is accessable to him out he puts it aside.

It's a good toy for dogs that like nylabones. The hollowed out part didn't work like I thought it would.

I ordered these for my two Boston terriers, both of whom chew and tearup most soft toys. Now I only get them powerful chewing toys, but the chew product must have a flavor or they lose interest fast. These are bacon flavor which they like. The dogs have not lost interest, but I have to get them out of the toy bin, so they remember them

I have several dogs in several sizes.  Nylabone products are always the ones that last.  When my pit bit off an arm of this toy I almost fell off the couch.  He bit off a Nylabone!  It wasn't until I found the toy outside a few days later and picked it up, realizing that it's not solid.  Makes me wonder what other toys are not solid from NB.  We still love the brand, but I would examine new toys carefully before buying them to see if I can tell if they are solid or not.

Summary: Our dog totally adored this, but destroyed it in about 48 hours
Text: We picked up one of these bones at a local pet store last week. Our dog picked it out herself; I held out two different shaped bones for her to sniff to see if she had a preference, and she actually grabbed this one's package out of my hand. She's never shown that much interest in something in the distracting environment of a store, so it came home with us. For two days, it was her constant companion, she absolutely LOVED this bone. She'd grab the whole thing around the middle and chew it on her back teeth with her head tilted back, so that she was chewing the red part more than the nubs. This might account for it's early demise... at the end of the second day I found it on her dog bed in three pieces, including one that was just the right size for an intestinal obstruction, and I quietly made it disappear while she wasn't watching. She's still looking for it two days later, sadly, and I thought about trying another one in the largest size available, but I don't think I want to risk it. We got the wolf-size the first time, and our dog is a 48 lb. Boykin Spaniel/Pit Bull mix. She is is a pretty serious chewer - she's the only dog I've ever had chew a Nylabone Galileo down to a nub that had to be thrown away and replaced - so this might not be a problem for most dogs.

My dogs are 55lbs and 25lbs, within a few days they chewed through this bone which started to fall to pieces because it is hollow.  If your dog is not a super chewer it might be good for them, but if your dogs gnaw nylabones into shanks like my dogs do, I would not recommend this.

Summary: My dog loves this, but is already destroying it
Text: I have a 70 lb lab/hound mix who loves to chew, so I always buy her the Nylabone Durachew toys. This is my first time buying this one for her and it arrived today. She's had it for about 4 hours and is already destroying it and I literally just saw her eating pieces of it as I'm typing this. It's going in the trash. Summary: My dog absolutely loves it and I don't. I should have ordered her another Galileo; it might shed little white flecks on the floor or injure my children when she flings it across the floor, but it's a lot more durable and safer for her to chew on than this one (and she loves it).

My dog is a serious chewer and loved this so much I am purchasing another.  It was her favorite toy and lasted a few months until small red pieces that connect to the outside nubs started to break off.  The toy provided several months of daily chewing and amusement and even though it didn't last forever, it was a good purchase.

I have a two year old German Shorthaired Pointer who is a very powerful chewer.  Nylabone is her toy of choice so I ordered this one after having previous success with other Nylabones.  This toy lasted all of 4 days!  The ends are made of the usual durable Nylabone material, but the center is not.  The material in the center is MUCH weaker.  My dog found this out and was able to chew right through the center.  What a waste of money!

Not as hard as the white Nylabone chews but my chewer likes it better. It clearly will last a long time. The cavity for placing food products is not useful as cleaning it is problematic and as it becomes chewed, is difficult to insert stuff. Overall it is a good chew stick.

This Nylabone chew-toy stick is great for my pit.  She loves to chew things but gets tired of the regular shaped bones.  This Nylabone stick is perfect.  It's durable and my pit likes the hollow stick-shape for some reason.  I think the bacon scent also attracts her.  I definitely would recommend this toy for anybody that has a big dog that loves to chew!

Summary: best substitute for the real stick from the yard!
Text: My dogs love, love, love this chew toy. They enjoy regular nylabones but this one offers a little something different.

Summary: Great toy, its lasted and my dogs love it.
Text: This is a great toy.  Nylabone consistently makes durable chew toys, that even my strong chewing dogs cant destroy right away. I would buy this again.

This is one of Pippin's favorite dog bones. He will chew on this thing for a long time. Sometimes I hide it from him as a game, and he always finds it. I highly recommend the Nylabone Dura Chew Double Bone.
I am always on the lookout for chew toys for my dogs. They are both big chewers. Most toys last about two days. This one has lasted all week! I am impressed.

Summary: My German shepherd loves this even though I bought the small one by mistake
Text:
He started chowing down on this as soon as I opened it. Fair warning, though. He spits out the plastic, he doesn't swallow it. Those little chewed plastic pieces hurt like heck when you step on them with bare feet.

I'd definitely buy this again, I just need to make sure I buy the larger one.
These products have been great for my Rottweilers.  They actually last a long time and the "kids" enjoy them.  I have used Nyabone products for over 5 years.

I bring my dog to PetSmart daycamp twice a week and was told by the staff that she loves to play with this particular toy during camp. So I bought one for her to play with here at home. Nylabone is great, my dog always has to have at least one or two around at all times!
My 105 pound American Bulldog and 80 pound Boxer have not been able to destoy this toy and I have had it for nearly a month. I would recommend it to anyone with a large breed dog!

We decided to try this Nylabone product based on the positive reviews and could not be happier on the purchase. Although the hollow stick seems a little heavy for him to carry around, he loves holding it and chomping away.  You can stick treats inside for more activity, but depending on your dog's chewing habit it might not be necessary. We'll definitely purchase the Souper size one again!

Summary: Nothing beats a Nylabone for our Borador
Text: Our labrador/border collie mix is a pretty vigorous chewer.  He gnawed on this for several weeks before it finally had to be discarded.  All in all ... a pretty durable chew toy.

Summary: Dogs love it, but may not be tough enough
Text: My two American bulldogs love Nylabones. I have to buy them dura chew items because they just shred all others. They like the texture, shape, and taste of this item a lot, but we're able to pop off one of the four ends pretty quickly. It became a smaller part that I was glad they didn't get a chance to eat whole. Not recommended for aggressive chewers.

The petite one is tiny which wasn't easily discernible from the description - they should include sample dog breeds for each size do you know which one to buy. But the product seems well-made despite the description being lacking, in my opinion. No smell and the color/shape keeps my pupp very interested.

The petite one is for very small dogs - chihuahua, min-pin, etc. Think: under 15 pounds.

The regular size (wolf) is for medium dogs. Beagles on the small end up to 50-65 pounds.

The giant size (souper) is for very large dogs over 65 pounds.
My two dogs love to chew on these.  I bought two but they still fight over them.  They are pretty durable.

My family got this for me over a month ago and I still love it! I hold it between my front paws and chew away, even in front of the TV. Not sure why it's always inside because I keep bringing it outside, but whatever. It tastes great and I love it, love it, love it!
My dogs loves chewing on this toy! It's cute to watch them chase each other for it. This is the first time I bought this toy and I think it was a good buy.

My dachshund is a powerful chewer for a 20 pound dog.  Although he loves any good chew toy (and especially one he can tear up and spread around the house), the Nylabone DuraChew Double Bone Bacon in the Wolf size is the only one he will select first every time and will stay with the longest.  It lasts longer than every other chew toy I've purchased.  The only drawbacks I see are the price -- in many stores they sell for over $12 each -- and the fact they seem to go on backorder regularly in those stores where they are discounted.

Summary: Another HUGE HIT By Nylabone! A Sensational Dog Toy!
Text:
Our six year old 92 pound Old English Bulldog and his partner in crime our 6 month old puppy of the same breed - are the certified kings when it comes to destroying even the toughest toys. A long time fan of Nylabone products - because they design toys with the dog in mind and not humans, and have been producing some of the finest, most durable dog toys here in the United States for over 50 years.

A rarity among dog toys that beg for our attention with an army of adorable kitty cats, bunnies and an endless parade of cute toys.
With the majority of them resembling road kill in a very short time.That said, we had a feeling this particular toy being made of the so rock solid Dura Chew material and scented like Bacon - they would be a huge hit.And boy, were they ever. Our Bulldogs simply LOVE this toy!

Our oldest Bulldog "Harley" is finicky about toys and loses interest after a hours, but kept this chew bone in his mouth for hours - even walking around the house with it looking like he was puffing on a big fat ole' stogie.Elvis, our 6 month old Godzilla chewer couldn't leave it alone for one second - and managed to do some serious damage.

This toy is just Great.

1) Huge size makes it fun for any medium - giant size dog.

2) Can be carried around (or dragged) if your pooch is strong to lift it.

3) Holds up very well, the material is surprisingly strong and resilient.

4) Quality construction means no seams - no pulling the top cover off.

5) Bacon flavor is very subtle and adds to cranking up the crazy. Making this toy even more fun for your dog.

6) Wood texture is molded into toy

7) Thick but Hollow so adding a treat to crank up the crazy is effortless to do.

If you're looking for an excellent toy, that can stand up to big time chewers - you can't go wrong with huge stick from Nylabone.
Like any dog toy supervision is key and an effort should be made to enjoy this toy along with your pooch under a watchful eye.

5 PAWS UP!

I have a 110 lb chocolate lab and its hard to find him toys that will last more than a few minutes. I ordered this nylabonef for him for xmas and its still one of his favorite toys! These Nylabones are the best and last long for big dogs and aggressive chewers!

And even with shipping, we got it considerably cheaper at Amazon.com than in any local pet store, even PETsMART...

It is his favorite even a month later when he only has a part of it left. If he wasn't such a strong chewer I would definitely get this toy again.

The problem with many Nylabone products is that they are plastic or rubber and their flavor is not particularly attractive to the dog.  As a result, my dog is often quick to abandon them for the furniture, my sneakers or any of the other things that we buy them these products to prevent them from chewing. Summary: Which is better, the Lavazza Gold or Black can variety?  Well, I'll tell you.
Text:
The major difference between the Lavazza Qualita Oro Espresso (the gold can) and the Lavazza Italian Coffee, Caffe Espresso (the black can) coffees is that the Gold can Lavazza uses 100% Arabica beans from two different countries and the Black can Lavazza uses 100% Arabica coffee beans from only one country.

The Lavazza Gold AND Black canned coffees BOTH are:
1. Lavazza coffee
2. Made using 100% Arabica coffee beans
3. Blended from 100% Arabica beans.
4. Blended to make espresso
5. Roasted and Packaged in Italy.

Differences:
The Lavazza Gold can coffee uses 100% Arabica beans from two countries:
1. Central America and,
2. Africa.
Note: Lavazza states that the Central American beans in this blend contributes a floral aroma.

The Lavazza Black can coffee uses 100% Arabica beans from only one country:
1. South America.
Note: Lavazza states that the South American beans in this blend are sweet and aromatic.

Opinion: Both coffees are excellent. They have different characteristics and while everyone pretty much agrees that both are excellent coffees, some will favor the Black Can variety over the Gold Can - and vice-versa. NEITHER are bad coffees, they just appeal to different tastes and one might perform better in your coffee making procedure/equipment than the other. That still doesn't make either one "bad", it just makes one variety better suited to a particular brewing procedure and to personal taste.

I prefer one variety to the other MOST of the time - primarily because of the excellent result/taste I get from one using my primary coffee making procedure. When I use a completely different system AND procedure for making coffee, I prefer the other variety. BOTH are excellent coffees but one is more likely to perform better in your coffee making method and system and give you better results than the other. Properly made, I sincerely believe that BOTH coffees are EXCELLENT! Now, please excuse me while I go make myself a fresh mug of Joe (quadruple espresso, nothing added). MMMmmmmmmmmmm....
The Lavazza black is better and cheaper than the gold.  It is also smoother and less acidic.  I've tried both and the black is definitely better.  You won't be disappointed with the black.

If you love true Italian Espresso and have a good pump machine but don't want to mess with grinding your own coffee - THEN this is the coffee!!!  Great aroma, excellent flavor and rich crema!! Qualita ORO makes a great espresso or cappuccino.  FIVE STARS!

Usually purchased at my brick and mortar stores, I am so glad to find Oro on Amazon.  Looking at the best by dates, the Amazon cans are much fresher, though they look different from that on the site as the cans are smooth rather than ribbed.  Though the smooth can which was delivered was not as pretty as the one pictured, who cares?  The coffee was fresher and it delivered the perfect smooth balance that Oro does in a Bialetti Moka Pot.  This is the perfect late/cappucino style smooth and sweeter blend than Black, and is certainly a crowd pleaser.  Thankfully I no longer need to buy out all the cans at the store anymore thanks to the Amazon subscription service!

The Gold too gives a great espessso hit, gives you a coffee/espresso richness, but the taste over all is WONDERFUL! I look forward to each brew because it truly is a tasty experience. YES, GOLD is my choice of Lavazza!!  Happy Cupfulls to All.

I'll be ordering this again and again, just because I find it the best I've experienced.

i was very happy with my espresso coffee.  lavaza has a strong but not bitter taste.  i will buy again.

Kimbo, also from Naples, is usually a bit stronger and takes second place in my heart.

Yes, I am from Naples, Italy, and I do need at least a couple of espresso cups per day...

Illy had been my preferred brand of espresso, but after moving recently the closest source was 15 miles away and exorbitantly expensive. After shopping around for alternatives, I decided to give the Lavazza a try.

To be clear, I am not an espresso snob. I may roast my own beans for drip coffee, but my espresso generally goes into milk and syrup. That said, I do think there is a noticeable quality difference between the Illy and Lavazza, with the Illy clearly coming out on top.

If you are drinking straight espresso and have a good machine, you might want to look for alternatives. If you're primarily making coffee drinks and aren't too picky, the Lavazza is a fine choice for about half the price of Illy.

Summary: Great for making expresso or cappuccino
Text: I have tried a variety of expresso for making capuccino and expresso and this is on the best one!!!!
Excellent flavor. Arabica beans is the only way to go for an espresso or cappuccino having the same flavor as the ones made in Italy.

Summary: Great quality coffee, the best for my taste
Text:
I've ordered and tried several kinds- Qualita Rosso, Caffe Espresso, Crema e Gusto, Qualita Oro, Bar, and Tierra.
I like strong coffee(2 teaspoonfuls per cup), but not too bitter. This one has a smooth silky taste and a little bit sour. I liked this one the best and signed up for regular delivery. They are all good coffees, but not sure reviews of others will help you much. You might have to try several of them yourself and pick one for your taste.

When looking at the pictures, I was deceived by them and thought the can was actually bigger. My own fault for not checking the volume. I was disappointed by the price, and felt it was overpriced. It is great coffee, but costs less than one third in Italy. Clearly we are not there, but I find it difficult to believe that importing it should raise the price by 300%
Low end coffee's usually give you headaches if you drink too much. I never had low-end coffee side affect with Lavazza. It gives caffeine high without side affect.

Summary: great coffee but what happened to prime shipping?
Text: I always order this coffee on Thursday and get it delivered prime by Saturday. Last Thursday I ordered it and they had taken away prime and charged me $7.00 shipping. It is Wednesday and I am still waiting for my coffee. I will not order again, unless they prime ship again!

Summary: Coffee was fine; packacking was not...twice
Text: The coffee is fine.  But, the first box I received was badly damaged, with four of the eight cans having beed crushed open. The reason: pooly packed with no bubble wrap or protection. My dog is the pickiest ever. He smells everything before eating it and actually turns away from most treats, BBQ meat, hotdogs, etc....you get the point. But he loves these treats! I recommend them highly and they are natural and healthy! A big plus!

This stuff is delicious and incredibly useful.  I've macerated berries in it (it's wonderful with strawberries); marinated pork with it; added it to sauces; as well as made salad dressings. In every dish, it was a star. I just wish it came in a bigger bottle.

Summary: Watch the size, these are small cans!

Seriously. 10.5 oz cans?? 1.86 a peice? .18 an ounce, man.

ripoff.

This was always one of my favorite Chunky soups.  However it seems that when Campbell started advertising their new 'leaner cuts' they interpreted those words to mean quantity rather than quality. Guess it was a way to cut down on production costs but not price. I like to get what, I hope at least, I'm paying for.  I complained to Campbell but never heard back on my e-mail. Since then I have switched to Progresso and other brands.

Summary: I could (and sometimes do) eat this right out of the can !
Text:
Meaty, LOTS of veggies, in a thick gravy-like soup stock. This is stick to your ribs meat and potatoes stuff -- I love it -- the only "beef" I have with this is the Sodium Content. Not everyone can handle that much sodium and unfortunately that problem runs in my family.

And yes, those reviewers are right -- give me the LARGE can any time!!!!
The cans are small & I can get larger ones at wal mart for less. I gave this 4 stars because the soup is Very Good, one of my favorites & I eat it alot. Get bigger cans at wal mart & eat soup!

Summary: One of the BEST Chunky Soups!
Text:
I LOVE this Soup! Little "burgers" with thick gravy float in a sea of hearty vegetables. Unlike many other canned soups, these have real meat and veggies of "size" that you can sink your teeth into!

You do have to be careful of "can size" when comparing prices (for quantity). Summary: My son has been eating this for over 20 years!
Text:

years ago when I would take him to her house to stay. Now it is a given for him; a must in our pantry!
It is healthy and it remains his favorite meal.

Great soup...I sometimes eat one for lunch when I am feeling like I need something filling.  Other reviewer is right...much cheaper at Wal-Mart...that said, Amazon is shipping it to me on their dime.  This stuff is heavy.  5 stars for the product with a 1 star ding for the cost due to shipping...

My husband loves this soup, he can eat a whole can of it for lunch. It is very hearty, with big chunks of meat and vegetables. The seasoning is really good, not too salty or too bland, perfect balance. Great with homemade bread or biscuits.

Reason this gets a 4 is because of the price. Can probably buy the bigger can at walmart for less money per can, but while trying to lose weight, the smaller can is nicer.

A really good cheap meal with a half a cup of brown rice made in a rice cooker. put it in a bowl, add a little garlic powder, add can of soup, mix it in, and microwave for 3 minutes. Really good and filling. Add it with a glass of v8 for a really filling and healthy meal.

Besides price, only other drawback i see is a lot of sodium. But I'm a big guy and still learning about this stuff.
I thought I was getting a good deal, but these are the small cans, not the large ones you see at the supermarket.
My dogs were destroying my wooden fence when agitating back and forth the neighbor's dogs.  Installed this to keep them off of the fence and the problem was solved.

I bought this after my two labs decided that the neighbors yard was more fun than my yard. My neighbor didn't mind the company but then they decided to expand their travels into his neighbors yard! And from there they had access to the street and beyond. I have a long length of chain link fence that I could not prevent them from digging under. This put a stop to their unauthorized playdates! It was easy to install - it does not require much experience or handyman abilities. I used some pvc pipe to thread the wire through in areas I did not want anyone getting zapped, such as the gate entry. I also insulated the wire in areas where there are bushes and grass growing. It produces a memorable, effective but not injury producing zap. My dog got zapped once and has since stayed a few feet away from the fence. When he got zapped he was startled and jumped back.
Tips for setting up - the wire can't touch the chain link or supporting metal posts. Use flexible irrigation hose or pvc pipe in areas where the wire might get grounded and them become ineffective.
NEGATIVE: It is not weather proof. It puzzles me that a product obviously designed for outdoor use is sensitive to moisture. It is not always practical to put the control indoors. I have it inside a plastic "shoe box". They really should consider where this product will be used and make it more durable.

Summary: Not for outdoor use!  Really Havahart?
Text: The product was easy to install and operate.  Some fiddling with the ground was needed to get a good circuit.  It worked - while it lasted which was 3 days, then it rained.  Now it's dead.  Our bad for not realizing it wasn't meant to be installed outdoors.  In my opinion that's ridiculous, who would ever install this indoors, and have the wires run through the house to the outdoors?  For that reason, 2 stars out of 5.

I have installed this product per the instructions. It has produced maybe 5 shocks in the past 2 months. Most of the time you can hold onto the wire and nothing happens. Unfortunately the fur from the dogs insulates them from the wire. The only time i have seen it take effect is when the dogs sniff the wire and even then its not consistent at all. Once they know it doesnt do anything they simply run straight through it. In fact most of the time they stand under the wire with it touching their backs - the light is flashing as it should and still nothing. I have 3 dogs (2 LABS AND A PUG) and not one is remotely afraid of walking straight through the wire. Trouble shooting says its more than likely a bad ground. I have 2' metal rod driven into the ground and it still doesnt work. Like I said... if your pet has hair on it (as most do) this product is useless. Even if they were bald this product would be useless. Dont waste your money!
This product works only if the pet's skin contacts wire, but the hair works as a electrical isolator. Not a good product. My dogs keeps scaping.

Summary: Worth Every Penny - Wellness CORE dry and Wellness Grain Free canned
Text:
Over the last two years, our older cat (now 11 years old) had ongoing issues with diarrhea and vomiting. After several trips to the vet and numerous tests that found nothing wrong, we were left thinking that this was her lot in life, sensitive to hairballs with a testy stomach. We changed her to a vet-recommended food and went on with life, but as you can imagine, she was still suffering.

She was dehydrated, her coat was rough, she was losing muscle and constantly hungry because she was essentially living life as a non-voluntary bulimic. At one point, I hoped a test for her thyroid would be positive so we could just figure out what on earth was wrong with her.

Last month I decided I didn't have anything else to lose so I started researching holistic treatments for her various symptoms. I happened upon a description of grain allergies in cats and I was astounded at the number of symptoms she had. Her eyes were always watery, her lips and gums a little swollen, and these were things her vet and I had attributed to "getting older" or her "hairball sensitivity" since none of the test had pinpointed a problem.

After some research to select a quality brand, I ordered Wellness Core Dry and Wet food. I didn't bother to transition her, just started her on it right away. Besides, she wasn't keeping down much of the other food anyway. She took to it right away, and she's a picky one.
Within two days, the diarrhea was gone. Within a week, she brought up a hairball that would shame a lesser cat. It's been a month now and the only bad thing I can say is that I wish I'd found this food sooner. No more watery eyes, no more swollen lips, and no more noxious fumes from the litter box. My husband and I cannot believe that fact, but it is true. A high-quality food WILL reduce litter box odor. I didn't believe it until I...well...didn't smell it.

I'm transitioning our other cat to it now and he already looks better for it. The food has a stronger odor than store-brand cat food. You'll also want to note that it doesn't have preservatives, so it's bound to have a stronger smell. The wet food actually smells good, for cat food. We use the Wellness Core 3oz Grain-Free Chicken. I'm sure our experiences will vary, but I've watched a cat who was the epitome of finicky, who would turn her nose up at Fancy Feast if the same flavors were served back to back, gobble the same flavor everyday for the last 30 days without complaint, and most notably, without vomit. So I'd say she gives her claw of approval.

Bottom line? It's pricy, sure. But it's worth it for us. Considering the money we're saving in paper towel clean up expenses alone, we're probably saving a buck or two. I should also thank Amazon for making it Prime eligible, so it's easier to buy it here than to find it in the store. So now, instead of begging me to feed them, our cats can start mauling the UPS man.

We tried this food after our 1-year-old Bengal kitten began to develop symptoms of food allergies (gas, bloating, constipation, vomiting).
We've been feeding Core for about 4 months now, and she has been symptom-free since the end of the first week!

In addition, our 7-year-old cat has also had remarkable and unexpected results. She has dropped weight, her eyes are bright, kitty acne on her chin has cleared, and she acts like a playful kitten again!

Other notes about this food:
-Core costs more than our previous food (Pet Promise), but they don't scarf it down like the old food. They get excited and eat for a few minutes any time the bowl is filled, but then they just return to nibble from time to time. So, a bag of Core lasts longer. Perhaps this is because they are getting the protein they need without having to eat pounds of food!
-This food smells like fish meal, and tends to give them slightly stinky breath, but it is not overpowering.
-Small, round kibble is crunchy, but not as hard and dry as most commercial dry foods. Our picky eater had no problem with the transition.

Overall, I would strongly recommend this food. I'm in awe of the truly priceless health changes we have seen in our cats, and only wish we had made the switch years ago!

As soon as I brought the bag inside, my cats were swarming all over it like flies, meowing and sniffing and scratching trying to get it open, something they've never done with other dry foods! I barely got it into the kitchen cabinet without the cats. Needless to say, they HEARTILY APPROVE of the flavor and size of the kibble and scarf this stuff down. Cats are happy, I'm happy! I can also feel good about feeding them one of the few very high protein dry cat foods on the market with premium, wholesome ingredients. As soon as I switched them to CORE, their coats got much softer and silkier and their eyes cleared up, and I know it's not my imagination. They have had ZERO vomiting or stool problems as well. My cats are on their second bag of CORE and will be happily eating CORE for the forseeable future.

Cons: The bag's plastic seal is hard to re-seal, it's expensive, and it has a strong fishy odor which my cats love and I don't mind, but it may bother some humans.

My 11-year-old cat is very pioky. She will allow nothing to pass her lips except dry cat food and water...no canned cat food, milk, meat, cheese, treats...nada.  So it is almost impossible to give her any kind of medication.  She had developed a cough and showed some other signs of aging.  After reading about the benefits of a grain-free diet I got Wellness Core for her, which she enjoyed right from the beginning .  But I got too enthusiasitic about finding something she enjoyed so much, and increased the percentage of the new food too fast.  She got the first stomach upset of her life with diarrhea and vomiting and feeling bad for a day, but recovered after a 24-hour fast.  I backed up with the new food, and now, after about six weeks, I am up to about half the Wellness and the rest her old dry food.  She is doing fantasticly!  Her coat is lovely and silky, and she plays more than ever.  The coughing has stopped.  Her stools are great and there has been no vomiting except for two fur balls.  I am delighted with the results of the change to Wellness Core.

Summary: Wellness Core adult and kitten food
Text:
This is indeed a much better alternative to the mainstream dry cat food. That said, the reaction of our family's cats to this was mixed, a couple really liked it, others who are not fond of fish only nibbled at it. The pet store we were buying Innova from started replacing Innova with Innova EVO, and my cats would eat it-- but they were breaking out on their chin from it. They offered other things, but I ended up using this. It was a special order, but I'd sampled the bag and the cat acne disappeared.

We thought he wanted more attention. He was still playing with our other cat. We ignored it. Then he started shaking while trying to walk to the litter box. We took him to the vet at 4a. He had a blocked bladder. Per our vet, he'd been hearing this a lot from male cats who are eating Wellness core. Honestly, I think the only reason he didn't have symptoms sooner is that I was giving him Innova EVO wet food for awhile in addition to the dry food. The other cat didn't eat it, so I didn't want to get food that both of them couldn't enjoy.

Fixing a blocked bladder is VERY expensive. Also, there is no guarantee that your cat will be completely unblocked after treatment. Thus far, our guy is doing well. We still crate him to make sure he's peeing, eating, and drinking. It's hard to monitor this with two cats otherwise.

Our male cat is now on a Prescription diet from the vet recommended brand that I'm not too fond of... He seems okay. We've switched our other cat onto the same diet.

I will never purchase Wellness CORE again.

Summary: Wellness is More than a Brand Name
Text:
I did a lot of research about cat food before I adopted a new kitten last year. Guess what? Surprise! A lot of major brands of cat food are the equivalent of deep-fried chicken and fast-food cheeseburgers for humans. Many of the brands that advertise a lot and sponsor cat shows are the worst offenders.

Cats are predators, and predator = high meat-based protein diet. Grain-based protein sources are high in carbohydrates and gluten. You'll never see see wild tigers in animal documentaries eating white bread and corn on the cob, even if they knew where to get them.

I feed my adolescent cat a combination of wet Wellness canned food and Wellness Core dry food. I did try another brand of dry cat food before purchasing Wellness Core, but she would just beg for more wet food and only eat enough of the dry to stop her hunger pangs. No problem with Wellness Core. She seems to like it.

I trust the Wellness brand. All I have to do is look at my cat and see why: her coat is glossy, her eyes are clear and bright, and she has a lot of energy (maybe too much)!

Here's another tip: Read the list of ingredients of dry cat foods. If you see a lot of sulphur and sulfate compounds, be prepared for VERY unpleasant number two cat box odor. These compounds are guaranteed to turn the smell dial all the way up to maximum. You can't totally avoid sulfates - they're necessary for cat health, but Wellness has them in moderation. The dry food I tried before buying Wellness Core had LOTS of sulphates - and LOTS of bad odor. Don't blame your cat when you're the one feeding her/him.

So Wellness products cost more...so what? If you eat well, your cat should too. Health problems caused by cheap cat food are expensive, painful - and avoidable. Save your vet dollars for things you can't control. You can economize by shopping for the best price and/or buying in larger quantities. Save your nose too!

Wellness Core is a really terrific brand of cat food. It's one of the highest rated cat foods I've found. I love that it's made from natural ingredients and is grain-free. I do like to supplement this with a little canned food (Wellness of course). My cat's fur is really soft and luxurious. Plus the cat loves the food so much so that she ripped open the bag and started stealing the food because I unknowingly did not stash the food in a sealed container. All open cat food and treats are stashed in a weighted down sealed container to prevent more cat burglar activity.

I'm a new cat owner as you can tell.

The only Con is it's pretty expensive, but it's well worth it to have a healthy pet.

This has resulted in a number of returns, which really made me appreciate the company's guaranteed satisfaction promise!  I'm trying to narrow it down, but I think they both don't like either the smell or taste of potatoes, rosemary extract, or cranberries. Obviously, very cat has their own taste preferences just like us humans, but I just wanted to caution other owners to try a sample before buying a large, expensive supply...

My eight year old cat is indoor/outdoor and likes dry food. Occasionally, we would feed him some canned food. For at least two years we noticed symptoms of diarrhea. The vet de-wormed the cat several times, but the diarrhea persisted. We decided to check the listed ingredients on the labels of the dry and canned food our cat eats. We were quite surprised that most protein in the popular brands comes from wheat and corn gluten, a protein that is known to cause intestinal problems in some people. Grains and grain gluten are also listed as ingredients of most brands of cat canned food.

I just got the Wellness Core Grain-free Fish & Fowl food today, so it is too early to see if it will cure our cat from diarrhea. Nevertheless, our cat was very happy with this new food and devoured all that we gave him.

Just like other reviewers, my cat also went on a hunger strike rather than eat this food. I DID gradually switch foods and yet when only the Wellness food was left, he would refuse to eat it. He lost over a lb over this whole ordeal. The only way I could get him to eat was to sprinkle some other cat food on top. (Someone randomly gave me some since he knew I had a cat.) What ended up happening for the past month was that the cat would pick around the Wellness pellets and eat everything else. I finally had enough and bought the food he's been eating for the past year (also grain-free, also expensive). He acted like it was Christmas and gobbled down the whole bowl, just like old times.

My cat is NOT a finicky eater by the way. He is a stray that we found last year. Up until this purchase, he has eaten everything we set in front of him. Maybe your cat will love this food. Maybe not. Try a sample first because I'm pretty mad about wasting $30.
Vet told us to get cats off grains so we tried many non-grain products. This is the only one that they really like. And, it is so handy to be able to order on line.

Two households and 7 cats later, I still have an almost full bag of this stuff.  I put it out because I ran out of their regular food, and couldn't make it to the store right away.  My 4 cats, despite not having eaten in almost a whole day, won't go near this stuff.  It just sits in their bowl.  When I first brought it into the house, they tried it, but haven't eaten it since.  I would not recommend it, despite the good ingredients

Summary: Great nutrition, but my cat won't eat it.
Text: I really wanted my cat to like this food (especially considering how expensive it is), but she just doesn't want to eat it. I introduced the food to her by mixing it in with her old "junk food" dry kibble, as recommended. She simply eats around the Wellness kibble, and I find little bits of it slightly chewed up/spit out by her bowl. I've been testing to see what happens if I don't feed her again until she clears her little bowl of food, but she just mopes around howling (something she normally doesn't do) and starves herself instead of eating the Wellness kibble. What a waste. :(

Summary: Good quality, just didn't work for us.
Text: Well each cat is different, and ours didn't care for this food one bit. The price for the small bag is a bit steep (compared the larger size of the same product), and the smell was not pleasant (but it's cat food not an air freshener) - otherwise the product was of good quality. You can't blame a product for a picky cat.

Summary: Great ingredients, and loved by my cat.
Text:
My little guy loves this stuff, and I have nothing to complain about with the ingredients. It's expensive, but since my schedule makes it difficult to him feed an all-wet diet (I do a combo of wet and dry), it's worth it to me to make sure his dry food is as healthy and cat-appropriate as possible.

Just remember is that this food has a higher caloric density than most, so you don't need to feed as much as you would most dry food. The feeding guidelines on the back are too much for most indoor-only cats, so adjust accordingly.

We heard a lot about this product from some friends.  We decided to switch from Science Diet since Wellness Core has much more protein, which should hopefully decrease the chance for diabetes or other diseases related to too many carbs.  Our cat didn't like it at first (it has a strong smell), but she adjusted to it in a couple days.  She loves it now!
My indoor cat does not like it, I mix it up with another brand and he would leave the nuggets of the CORE there he does like the smell of it not the taste.

My 6 month old male Tuxedo cat likes Wellness Kitten Health Dry Kitten Food, but does not seem to like Wellness CORE.  I think he's a "chicken" eater.  I rate the Wellness Core 3 Stars, as I haven't completely given up yet on mixing it in with other foods he likes: California Natural Chicken and Rice Dry Cat and Kitten Food; Innova Cat and Kitten Food; Premium Edge Dry Cat Food for Kittens; and Blue Buffalo Wilderness Grain Free Dry Cat Food, Chicken Recipe.  The Wellness plastic bag is one of the nicest kibble, dry cat food bags on the market, featuring a resealable strip, which is a nice feature that some other kibble cat food bags, that are seemingly more paper based, do not have.

Summary: Caused my 15 year old cat to have diarrhea for first time in his life.
Text: I have a 15 year old neutered male domestic short hair kitty who is overall very healthy and happy. I was excited to put him on this food after doing extensive research because it was high in protein, grain-free and had several great reviews. I had him on Innova Senior, but it was a little dry and he didn't really "love" the food. However, since starting to feed Wellness CORE a few days ago, my kitty has had diarrhea every time he uses the litterbox. I've owned him his whole life, and he's never had diarrhea before and it's the only thing that's changed in his diet (he also gets Wellness wet food at night). Although I already have him on a high protein, low carb diet, I think the even higher level of protein in this food might be too much for his digestive tract to handle. I'm going to give it a few more days to see if the condition improves and maybe is just a side effect of the transition, but I'm not pleased by the initial experience. We'll see what happens.
My cat went on a hunger strike rather than eat this food.  I think it's the fishy smell, which is very disagreeable.  Save your money!  The ingredients are fine, but what a waste of money!

I was skeptical when I first heard of this product but decided to give it a try.  Amazingly, it works!! While it isn't the best chocolate cake I have ever had, for gluten free it is pretty darn good, at least good enough to satisfy a chocolate craving. This would be a great product for kids with celiac to take along to a birthday party or while traveling because all you really need is water and a microwave. Just don't make the same mistake I did and microwave the lid because it is NOT microwave safe, though the directions clearly state this.
I purchased this as a gift, I am told that the tea's had a horrible taste!
Go figure....my cats are going nuts for this stuff. They leave no peas and carrots in their plates. I am not kidding. Highly recommended.
They were supposed to send 12 cans, they sent one and credited my account.  Fussy cat and she did not eat it.
Couldnt find these any where in stores, i ordered 3 boxes to get my fix. Great packaging and sealed for shipping. was nice to finally endulge in Buncha Crunch... IM a fatas* lol
These are tasty with just the right amount of salt. I eat a few of these each day. They are worth the price.

Brazil nuts fans, ever try to find these to purchase separately at the grocery store? I could only find them in mixed cans. These were shipped promptly, and the quality was great. I got the lightly salted ones. I have ordered twice now, and will order regularly.
Amazon is a great way to find hard to get items!

The sardine are hard and dry and have an off, metallic taste to them. The sauce is nice, but not what's swimming in them. The sardines don't fill the can, and really are unpleasant. These also contain MSG, maltodextrin, and xanthan gum which isn't mentioned in the ingredient list which of course is incorrect. I saw a brand name and really expected better quality than these. Avoid!!!

Since Amazon doesn't carry the hot and spicy sardines I love, I thought I would try these.  For whatever reason, this product has a very metallic taste.  All but the first can are still in my pantry.  They will probably end up in the next neighborhood food drive...

This product would be better, but somehow the taste seem to have been altered. Its got a boxy taste to it, or maybe I got an outdated item. I am still trying to figure out why, or what had gone wrong with the sardines. They taste different than the ones I use to love to eat.
Very good product, just wish it were a bit hotter. I would purchase again though. Very fast shipping and packed well.

I love canned sardines, but these suck hardcore. They're small, tough, and the hot sauce tastes terrible. If you want yummy canned sardines for a decent price, I'd go with Beachclif. They fill the whole can, are tender, and are delicious. Never buying Chicken Of The Sea sardines ever again. Ugh.

Summary: Big fish, and lots of not so spicy sauce
Text:
The fish are quite big, about 3 in the can.
The vertebrae are big enough to pop when you bite into them, a little unpleasant...
Lots of thin sauce, which is not very spicy.

I was hoping for a tin that was ready to eat, but for me these need some more prep work, cleaning the spine out and adding more sauce.

I purchased Chicken of the sea sardines in mustard and in hot sauce. I didnt buy them from amazon but from a local store. I hated them so much I had to come on here and write a review. They are absolutely terrible. The sauce is thin and doesnt really taste like anything at all. There are scales all though the sauce and on the sardines. The scales get in your teeth and all through your mouth. I felt like I was biting into an uncooked trout. Don't buy these.
Sticking with the Beach Cliff brand sardines, much better.

Summary: Ate the entire can just to write this review...
Text: This item tasted like what I expect a carp would taste.  Typically purchase King Oscar products, but wife believes in garage sale items infested with bed bugs and thinks the overflowing sale bins are great deal items - not items that don't sell for a reason.  The "hot sauce" is nothing but hot and I've had fewer bones in Shad.  There were a total of 3 "sardines", or whatever these were, in the can. I bought a case and the expiration date is 18 months away so I have no problem saving some money and getting the same great quality and flavor as the standard buttermilk mix. I appreciate amazon havong products like this as part of prime for us west coasters that grew up in the east and miss east coast products!
